`client/src/og_detect.c`:

```c
/* cheat-signatures module: matches the signed signature package the server sends (OG_S_SIGS) against running
 * processes, loaded modules, windows, files in the client folder, kernel drivers and the GRFs of DATA.INI, and
 * reports modules loaded from outside the client and Windows folders. Every hit is reported once per connection
 * (OG_C_DETECT); the server decides what happens (signature confidence, severity, action, warn mode).
 * Allowlist entries (OG_KIND_ALLOW_SHA256 / OG_KIND_ALLOW_PATH) are never reported. */
#include "og.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <tlhelp32.h>

#define HASH_CACHE 256
#define GRF_HASH_MAX (256u * 1024 * 1024) /* larger archives (data.grf) are not hashed */

static uint8_t g_reported[65536 / 8];
static char g_reported_mods[64][MAX_PATH];
static int g_nreported_mods;
static og_signature g_sig[OG_MAX_SIGS];
static int g_nsig;

typedef struct { char path[MAX_PATH]; DWORD size_lo, size_hi; FILETIME mtime; char hex[65]; } hash_entry;
static hash_entry g_cache[HASH_CACHE];
static int g_ncache;

void og_detect_reset(void)
{
    memset(g_reported, 0, sizeof g_reported);
    g_nreported_mods = 0;
}

static int seen_peek(uint16_t id) { return (g_reported[id >> 3] >> (id & 7)) & 1; }
static int seen(uint16_t id) { int r = (g_reported[id >> 3] >> (id & 7)) & 1; g_reported[id >> 3] |= (uint8_t)(1 << (id & 7)); return r; }

static void detect(uint16_t id, uint8_t kind, const char *text)
{
    uint8_t m[300];
    size_t n = strlen(text);
    if (n > 255) n = 255;
    m[0] = OG_C_DETECT;
    m[1] = (uint8_t)id; m[2] = (uint8_t)(id >> 8);
    m[3] = kind;
    memcpy(m + 4, text, n);
    og_net_broadcast_control(m, n + 4);
    og_log("detect kind %d id %d: %s", kind, id, text);
}

/* sha256 of a file, cached by path, size and modification time */
static const char *file_hash(const char *path, DWORD max_size)
{
    WIN32_FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DATA a;
    int i;
    if (!GetFileAttributesExA(path, GetFileExInfoStandard, &a) || (a.dwFileAttributes & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY)) return NULL;
    if (a.nFileSizeHigh || a.nFileSizeLow > max_size) return NULL;
    for (i = 0; i < g_ncache; i++) {
        hash_entry *e = &g_cache[i];
        if (!_stricmp(e->path, path) && e->size_lo == a.nFileSizeLow && e->size_hi == a.nFileSizeHigh &&
            CompareFileTime(&e->mtime, &a.ftLastWriteTime) == 0)
            return e->hex;
    }
    i = g_ncache < HASH_CACHE ? g_ncache++ : (int)(GetTickCount() % HASH_CACHE);
    if (!og_sha256_file(path, g_cache[i].hex)) { g_cache[i].path[0] = 0; return NULL; }
    strncpy(g_cache[i].path, path, MAX_PATH - 1);
    g_cache[i].size_lo = a.nFileSizeLow;
    g_cache[i].size_hi = a.nFileSizeHigh;
    g_cache[i].mtime = a.ftLastWriteTime;
    return g_cache[i].hex;
}

static int allowed_hash(const char *hex)
{
    int i;
    if (!hex) return 0;
    for (i = 0; i < g_nsig; i++)
        if (g_sig[i].kind == OG_KIND_ALLOW_SHA256 && !_stricmp(g_sig[i].pattern, hex)) return 1;
    return 0;
}

static void match_hash(const char *hex, const char *where)
{
    int i;
    if (!hex || allowed_hash(hex)) return;
    for (i = 0; i < g_nsig; i++)
        if (g_sig[i].kind == OG_KIND_FILE_SHA256 && !_stricmp(g_sig[i].pattern, hex) && !seen(g_sig[i].id))
            detect(g_sig[i].id, OG_KIND_FILE_SHA256, where);
}

static int has_kind(uint8_t kind)
{
    int i;
    for (i = 0; i < g_nsig; i++) if (g_sig[i].kind == kind) return 1;
    return 0;
}

static BOOL CALLBACK enum_win(HWND w, LPARAM lp)
{
    char title[256], cls[256];
    int i;
    (void)lp;
    title[0] = cls[0] = 0;
    GetClassNameA(w, cls, sizeof cls);
    if (IsWindowVisible(w)) GetWindowTextA(w, title, sizeof title);
    for (i = 0; i < g_nsig; i++) {
        og_signature *s = &g_sig[i];
        if (s->kind == OG_KIND_WINDOW && title[0] && og_contains_i(title, s->pattern) && !seen(s->id)) detect(s->id, OG_KIND_WINDOW, title);
        else if (s->kind == OG_KIND_WINDOW_CLASS && cls[0] && !_stricmp(cls, s->pattern) && !seen(s->id)) detect(s->id, OG_KIND_WINDOW_CLASS, cls);
    }
    return TRUE;
}

static void scan_processes(void)
{
    PROCESSENTRY32 pe;
    HANDLE snap = CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_SNAPPROCESS, 0);
    int i;
    if (snap == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return;
    pe.dwSize = sizeof pe;
    if (Process32First(snap, &pe)) do {
        for (i = 0; i < g_nsig; i++)
            if (g_sig[i].kind == OG_KIND_PROCESS && og_contains_i(pe.szExeFile, g_sig[i].pattern) && !seen(g_sig[i].id))
                detect(g_sig[i].id, OG_KIND_PROCESS, pe.szExeFile);
    } while (Process32Next(snap, &pe));
    CloseHandle(snap);
}

/* loaded modules: name signatures, file hashes, and modules from outside the client and Windows folders */
static int scan_modules(void)
{
    MODULEENTRY32 me;
    char win[MAX_PATH];
    int i, unknown = 0, want_hash = has_kind(OG_KIND_FILE_SHA256);
    HANDLE snap = CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_SNAPMODULE | TH32CS_SNAPMODULE32, GetCurrentProcessId());
    if (snap == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return 0;
    GetWindowsDirectoryA(win, sizeof win);
    me.dwSize = sizeof me;
    if (Module32First(snap, &me)) do {
        const char *hex = NULL;
        for (i = 0; i < g_nsig; i++)
            if (g_sig[i].kind == OG_KIND_MODULE && og_contains_i(me.szModule, g_sig[i].pattern) && !seen(g_sig[i].id))
                detect(g_sig[i].id, OG_KIND_MODULE, me.szExePath);
        if (want_hash || g_nsig) hex = file_hash(me.szExePath, 64u * 1024 * 1024);
        if (want_hash) match_hash(hex, me.szExePath);
        if (_strnicmp(me.szExePath, og_client_dir, strlen(og_client_dir)) && _strnicmp(me.szExePath, win, strlen(win)) &&
            !og_path_tolerated(me.szExePath) && !allowed_hash(hex)) {
            int k, dup = 0;
            unknown++;
            for (k = 0; k < g_nreported_mods; k++) if (!_stricmp(g_reported_mods[k], me.szExePath)) { dup = 1; break; }
            if (!dup && g_nreported_mods < 64) {
                snprintf(g_reported_mods[g_nreported_mods++], MAX_PATH, "%s", me.szExePath);
                detect(0, OG_KIND_INJECT, me.szExePath);
            }
        }
    } while (Module32Next(snap, &me));
    CloseHandle(snap);
    return unknown;
}

/* files in the client folder (top level): names and hashes */
static void scan_files(void)
{
    char mask[MAX_PATH], full[MAX_PATH];
    WIN32_FIND_DATAA fd;
    HANDLE h;
    int i, want_name = has_kind(OG_KIND_FILE_NAME), want_hash = has_kind(OG_KIND_FILE_SHA256);
    if (!want_name && !want_hash) return;
    snprintf(mask, sizeof mask, "%s\\*", og_client_dir);
    h = FindFirstFileA(mask, &fd);
    if (h == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return;
    do {
        if (fd.dwFileAttributes & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY) continue;
        snprintf(full, sizeof full, "%s\\%s", og_client_dir, fd.cFileName);
        if (want_name)
            for (i = 0; i < g_nsig; i++)
                if (g_sig[i].kind == OG_KIND_FILE_NAME && !_stricmp(fd.cFileName, g_sig[i].pattern) &&
                    !allowed_hash(file_hash(full, 64u * 1024 * 1024)) && !seen(g_sig[i].id))
                    detect(g_sig[i].id, OG_KIND_FILE_NAME, fd.cFileName);
        if (want_hash && fd.nFileSizeHigh == 0 && fd.nFileSizeLow <= 64u * 1024 * 1024) match_hash(file_hash(full, 64u * 1024 * 1024), fd.cFileName);
    } while (FindNextFileA(h, &fd));
    FindClose(h);
}

static void scan_grfs(void)
{
    char ini[MAX_PATH], key[8], val[MAX_PATH], full[MAX_PATH];
    int i, k;
    if (!has_kind(OG_KIND_GRF_SHA256)) return;
    snprintf(ini, sizeof ini, "%s\\DATA.INI", og_client_dir);
    for (k = 0; k < 32; k++) {
        const char *hex;
        snprintf(key, sizeof key, "%d", k);
        GetPrivateProfileStringA("Data", key, "", val, sizeof val, ini);
        if (!val[0] || strchr(val, '\\') || strchr(val, '/')) continue;
        snprintf(full, sizeof full, "%s\\%s", og_client_dir, val);
        if (!(hex = file_hash(full, GRF_HASH_MAX))) continue;
        for (i = 0; i < g_nsig; i++)
            if (g_sig[i].kind == OG_KIND_GRF_SHA256 && !_stricmp(g_sig[i].pattern, hex) && !seen(g_sig[i].id))
                detect(g_sig[i].id, OG_KIND_GRF_SHA256, val);
    }
}

static void scan_drivers(void)
{
    SC_HANDLE scm;
    ENUM_SERVICE_STATUSA *buf;
    DWORD need = 0, count = 0, resume = 0, i;
    int k;
    if (!has_kind(OG_KIND_DRIVER)) return;
    if (!(scm = OpenSCManagerA(NULL, NULL, SC_MANAGER_ENUMERATE_SERVICE))) return;
    EnumServicesStatusA(scm, SERVICE_DRIVER | SERVICE_WIN32, SERVICE_ACTIVE, NULL, 0, &need, &count, &resume);
    if (need && (buf = (ENUM_SERVICE_STATUSA *)HeapAlloc(GetProcessHeap(), 0, need))) {
        resume = 0;
        if (EnumServicesStatusA(scm, SERVICE_DRIVER | SERVICE_WIN32, SERVICE_ACTIVE, buf, need, &need, &count, &resume))
            for (i = 0; i < count; i++)
                for (k = 0; k < g_nsig; k++)
                    if (g_sig[k].kind == OG_KIND_DRIVER && !_stricmp(buf[i].lpServiceName, g_sig[k].pattern) && !seen(g_sig[k].id))
                        detect(g_sig[k].id, OG_KIND_DRIVER, buf[i].lpServiceName);
        HeapFree(GetProcessHeap(), 0, buf);
    }
    CloseServiceHandle(scm);
}

/* named kernel objects a tool creates (single-instance mutexes, events, shared memory) */
static int object_exists(const char *name)
{
    HANDLE h;
    if ((h = OpenMutexA(SYNCHRONIZE, FALSE, name))) { CloseHandle(h); return 1; }
    if ((h = OpenEventA(SYNCHRONIZE, FALSE, name))) { CloseHandle(h); return 1; }
    if ((h = OpenFileMappingA(FILE_MAP_READ, FALSE, name))) { CloseHandle(h); return 1; }
    return 0;
}

static void scan_objects(void)
{
    char g[300];
    int i;
    for (i = 0; i < g_nsig; i++) {
        if (g_sig[i].kind != OG_KIND_MUTEX || seen_peek(g_sig[i].id)) continue;
        snprintf(g, sizeof g, "Global\\%s", g_sig[i].pattern);
        if ((object_exists(g_sig[i].pattern) || object_exists(g)) && !seen(g_sig[i].id)) detect(g_sig[i].id, OG_KIND_MUTEX, g_sig[i].pattern);
    }
}

/* registry keys a tool leaves behind: "HKCU\\path" or "HKLM\\path" (32- and 64-bit views) */
static void scan_registry(void)
{
    int i;
    for (i = 0; i < g_nsig; i++) {
        const char *p = g_sig[i].pattern;
        HKEY root, k;
        if (g_sig[i].kind != OG_KIND_REGISTRY || seen_peek(g_sig[i].id)) continue;
        if (!_strnicmp(p, "HKCU\\", 5)) root = HKEY_CURRENT_USER;
        else if (!_strnicmp(p, "HKLM\\", 5)) root = HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE;
        else continue;
        if (RegOpenKeyExA(root, p + 5, 0, KEY_READ, &k) == ERROR_SUCCESS ||
            RegOpenKeyExA(root, p + 5, 0, KEY_READ | KEY_WOW64_64KEY, &k) == ERROR_SUCCESS) {
            RegCloseKey(k);
            if (!seen(g_sig[i].id)) detect(g_sig[i].id, OG_KIND_REGISTRY, p);
        }
    }
}

int og_detect_scan(void)
{
    int unknown;
    EnterCriticalSection(&og_policy_lock);
    g_nsig = og_policy.nsig;
    memcpy(g_sig, og_policy.sig, sizeof(og_signature) * g_nsig);
    LeaveCriticalSection(&og_policy_lock);
    unknown = scan_modules();
    if (!g_nsig) return unknown;
    scan_processes();
    EnumWindows(enum_win, 0);
    scan_files();
    scan_grfs();
    scan_drivers();
    scan_objects();
    scan_registry();
    return unknown;
}
```

`client/src/og_env.c`:

```c
#include "og.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <intrin.h>

static int reg_contains(const char *key, const char *val, const char **needles, char *hit, size_t cap)
{
    HKEY k;
    char buf[256];
    DWORD type, sz = sizeof buf - 1;
    int i, found = 0;
    if (RegOpenKeyExA(HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE, key, 0, KEY_READ | KEY_WOW64_64KEY, &k) != ERROR_SUCCESS) return 0;
    if (RegQueryValueExA(k, val, NULL, &type, (BYTE *)buf, &sz) == ERROR_SUCCESS && type == REG_SZ) {
        buf[sz] = 0;
        for (i = 0; needles[i]; i++)
            if (strstr(buf, needles[i])) { snprintf(hit, cap, "firmware:%s", buf); found = 1; break; }
    }
    RegCloseKey(k);
    return found;
}

/* CPUID hypervisor bit, and as second source the firmware strings (the bit is not visible under x86
   emulation on ARM, e.g. Parallels on Apple Silicon) */
int og_is_vm(char *why, size_t cap)
{
    static const char *vendors[] = { "Parallels", "VMware", "VirtualBox", "innotek", "QEMU", "KVM", "Xen", "Bochs",
                                     "Virtual Machine", "BHYVE", "Hyper-V", NULL };
    int r[4];
    __cpuid(r, 1);
    if (r[2] & (1 << 31)) {
        char v[13];
        __cpuid(r, 0x40000000);
        memcpy(v, &r[1], 4); memcpy(v + 4, &r[2], 4); memcpy(v + 8, &r[3], 4); v[12] = 0;
        snprintf(why, cap, "hypervisor:%s", v);
        return 1;
    }
    if (reg_contains("HARDWARE\\DESCRIPTION\\System\\BIOS", "SystemManufacturer", vendors, why, cap) ||
        reg_contains("HARDWARE\\DESCRIPTION\\System\\BIOS", "SystemProductName", vendors, why, cap) ||
        reg_contains("HARDWARE\\DESCRIPTION\\System\\BIOS", "BIOSVendor", vendors, why, cap))
        return 1;
    why[0] = 0;
    return 0;
}

/* N named mutexes act as slots shared by all processes on the machine (all sessions).
   The handle stays open for the lifetime of the process; the slot is freed when the process exits. */
int og_window_slot_acquire(int max_windows)
{
    static HANDLE slots[64];
    static int used;
    HANDLE h;
    char name[64];
    int i;
    if (max_windows <= 0) return 1;
    for (i = 0; i < max_windows && used < 64; i++) {
        snprintf(name, sizeof name, "Global\\OdinGuard_Slot_%d", i);
        h = CreateMutexA(NULL, FALSE, name);
        if (!h) {
            snprintf(name, sizeof name, "Local\\OdinGuard_Slot_%d", i);
            h = CreateMutexA(NULL, FALSE, name);
            if (!h) continue;
        }
        if (GetLastError() == ERROR_ALREADY_EXISTS) { CloseHandle(h); continue; }
        slots[used++] = h;
        (void)slots;
        return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}
```

`client/src/og_guard.c`:

```c
/* heartbeat module: guard thread with the window limit, the detection scan (cheat-signatures module), integrity
 * flags (integrity module) and the heartbeat (OG_C_ALIVE) with the exe code hash and the guard's own code +
 * read-only data hash (self integrity incl. the embedded profile). Flags that can come from harmless software
 * (hardware breakpoints, API hooks) are only sent when two scans in a row see them. */
#include "og.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>

static HANDLE g_wake;
static uint32_t g_seq;
static int g_window_slot_done;
static int g_grf_reported, g_api_reported;
static uint8_t g_prev_flags;
static volatile LONG g_generation, g_seen_generation;

/* a new server connection gets every current detection again */
void og_guard_new_connection(void) { InterlockedIncrement(&g_generation); og_guard_scan_now(); }

void og_guard_scan_now(void) { if (g_wake) SetEvent(g_wake); }

static void report(uint8_t kind, const char *text)
{
    uint8_t m[300];
    size_t n = strlen(text);
    if (n > 255) n = 255;
    m[0] = OG_C_DETECT;
    m[1] = 0; m[2] = 0;
    m[3] = kind;
    memcpy(m + 4, text, n);
    og_net_broadcast_control(m, n + 4);
    og_log("report kind %d: %s", kind, text);
}

static void apply_window_limit(void)
{
    int max;
    if (g_window_slot_done || !og_policy.received) return;
    max = og_policy.max_windows ? og_policy.max_windows : og_cfg.max_windows;
    g_window_slot_done = 1;
    if (max > 0 && !og_window_slot_acquire(max)) {
        og_log("window limit %d reached", max);
        og_message("The maximum number of game windows on this computer is reached.", MB_OK | MB_ICONSTOP);
        TerminateProcess(GetCurrentProcess(), 1);
    }
}

static void heartbeat(void)
{
    uint8_t m[OG_ALIVE_LEN];
    char detail[MAX_PATH + 32];
    int unknown;
    uint8_t flags = 0, raw;
    if (!og_net_active_connections()) return;
    if (g_seen_generation != g_generation) {
        g_seen_generation = g_generation;
        og_detect_reset();
        og_assets_reset();
        g_grf_reported = g_api_reported = 0;
    }

    unknown = og_detect_scan();
    if (!og_net_hooks_intact()) flags |= OG_ALIVE_HOOKS_TAMPERED;
    raw = og_integrity_flags();
    flags |= raw & g_prev_flags;               /* confirmed by two scans */
    g_prev_flags = raw;
#if OG_MOD_INTEGRITY
    if ((flags & OG_ALIVE_API_HOOKED) && !g_api_reported) { g_api_reported = 1; report(OG_KIND_API_HOOK, og_integrity_detail); }
#endif
    if (og_assets_check(detail, sizeof detail)) {
        flags |= OG_ALIVE_GRF_VIOLATION;
        if (!g_grf_reported) { g_grf_reported = 1; report(OG_KIND_GRF, detail); }
    }

    memset(m, 0, sizeof m);
    m[0] = OG_C_ALIVE;
    g_seq++;
    og_wr32(m + 1, g_seq);
    og_hash_module_code(GetModuleHandleA(NULL), OG_CANON_CODE, m + 5);
    og_wr16(m + 37, (uint16_t)unknown);
    m[39] = flags;
    og_hash_module_code(og_instance, OG_CANON_CODE | OG_CANON_RDATA, m + 40);
    og_net_broadcast_control(m, sizeof m);
}

static DWORD WINAPI guard_thread(LPVOID p)
{
    (void)p;
    SetThreadPriority(GetCurrentThread(), THREAD_PRIORITY_BELOW_NORMAL);
    for (;;) {
        DWORD interval = og_policy.alive_interval > 0 ? (DWORD)og_policy.alive_interval * 1000 : 30000;
        WaitForSingleObject(g_wake, og_net_active_connections() ? interval : 2000);
        apply_window_limit();
        heartbeat();
    }
    return 0;
}

void og_guard_start(void)
{
    g_wake = CreateEventA(NULL, FALSE, FALSE, NULL);
    CloseHandle(CreateThread(NULL, 0, guard_thread, NULL, 0, NULL));
}
```

`client/src/og_hwid.c`:

```c
#include "og.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <intrin.h>
#include <iphlpapi.h>
#include <winioctl.h>

static void add(og_component *c, int *n, int max, const char *name, const char *salt, const void *data, size_t len)
{
    og_sha256_ctx s;
    uint8_t out[32];
    if (*n >= max || !len) return;
    og_sha256_init(&s);
    og_sha256_update(&s, salt, strlen(salt));
    og_sha256_update(&s, name, strlen(name));
    og_sha256_update(&s, data, len);
    og_sha256_final(&s, out);
    strncpy(c[*n].name, name, sizeof c[*n].name - 1);
    c[*n].name[sizeof c[*n].name - 1] = 0;
    og_hex(out, 32, c[*n].hex);
    (*n)++;
}

static int reg_str(HKEY root, const char *key, const char *val, char *out, DWORD cap)
{
    HKEY k;
    DWORD type, sz = cap - 1;
    int ok = 0;
    if (RegOpenKeyExA(root, key, 0, KEY_READ | KEY_WOW64_64KEY, &k) != ERROR_SUCCESS) return 0;
    if (RegQueryValueExA(k, val, NULL, &type, (BYTE *)out, &sz) == ERROR_SUCCESS && type == REG_SZ) { out[sz] = 0; ok = 1; }
    RegCloseKey(k);
    return ok;
}

/* Several independent sources, each hashed with a per-server salt. The server matches fuzzily (k of n), so one
   changed part (new disk, new Windows install) does not create a new identity. */
int og_hwid_collect(og_component *c, int max, const char *salt)
{
    int n = 0;
    char buf[256];
    DWORD serial = 0;
    int regs[4];

    if (reg_str(HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE, "SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Cryptography", "MachineGuid", buf, sizeof buf))
        add(c, &n, max, "machine_guid", salt, buf, strlen(buf));
    if (reg_str(HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE, "HARDWARE\\DESCRIPTION\\System\\BIOS", "SystemProductName", buf, sizeof buf))
        add(c, &n, max, "bios_product", salt, buf, strlen(buf));
    if (reg_str(HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE, "HARDWARE\\DESCRIPTION\\System\\BIOS", "BaseBoardProduct", buf, sizeof buf))
        add(c, &n, max, "board", salt, buf, strlen(buf));
    if (reg_str(HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE, "HARDWARE\\DESCRIPTION\\System\\BIOS", "BIOSReleaseDate", buf, sizeof buf))
        add(c, &n, max, "bios_date", salt, buf, strlen(buf));

    {
        char root[4] = "C:\\";
        char sysdir[MAX_PATH];
        if (GetSystemDirectoryA(sysdir, sizeof sysdir)) root[0] = sysdir[0];
        if (GetVolumeInformationA(root, NULL, 0, &serial, NULL, NULL, NULL, 0))
            add(c, &n, max, "volume_serial", salt, &serial, sizeof serial);
    }

    {
        /* serial number of the first physical disk (no admin rights needed for the descriptor) */
        HANDLE d = CreateFileA("\\\\.\\PhysicalDrive0", 0, FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE, NULL, OPEN_EXISTING, 0, NULL);
        if (d != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
            STORAGE_PROPERTY_QUERY q;
            uint8_t out[1024];
            DWORD got = 0;
            memset(&q, 0, sizeof q);
            q.PropertyId = StorageDeviceProperty;
            q.QueryType = PropertyStandardQuery;
            if (DeviceIoControl(d, IOCTL_STORAGE_QUERY_PROPERTY, &q, sizeof q, out, sizeof out, &got, NULL) && got >= sizeof(STORAGE_DEVICE_DESCRIPTOR)) {
                const STORAGE_DEVICE_DESCRIPTOR *sd = (const STORAGE_DEVICE_DESCRIPTOR *)out;
                if (sd->SerialNumberOffset && sd->SerialNumberOffset < got) {
                    const char *sn = (const char *)out + sd->SerialNumberOffset;
                    size_t len = strnlen(sn, got - sd->SerialNumberOffset);
                    while (len && sn[len - 1] == ' ') len--;
                    while (len && *sn == ' ') { sn++; len--; }
                    if (len) add(c, &n, max, "disk_serial", salt, sn, len);
                }
            }
            CloseHandle(d);
        }
    }
    {
        /* MAC of the first physical Ethernet or Wi-Fi adapter */
        ULONG size = 0;
        if (GetAdaptersInfo(NULL, &size) == ERROR_BUFFER_OVERFLOW) {
            IP_ADAPTER_INFO *ai = (IP_ADAPTER_INFO *)HeapAlloc(GetProcessHeap(), 0, size), *a;
            if (ai && GetAdaptersInfo(ai, &size) == NO_ERROR) {
                for (a = ai; a; a = a->Next) {
                    if ((a->Type == MIB_IF_TYPE_ETHERNET || a->Type == IF_TYPE_IEEE80211) && a->AddressLength == 6 &&
                        !strstr(a->Description, "Virtual") && !strstr(a->Description, "VPN") && !strstr(a->Description, "Loopback")) {
                        add(c, &n, max, "mac", salt, a->Address, 6);
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (ai) HeapFree(GetProcessHeap(), 0, ai);
        }
    }
    {
        /* SMBIOS system UUID (structure type 1) */
        UINT size = GetSystemFirmwareTable(0x52534D42u, 0, NULL, 0);
        uint8_t *t = size ? (uint8_t *)HeapAlloc(GetProcessHeap(), 0, size) : NULL;
        if (t && GetSystemFirmwareTable(0x52534D42u, 0, t, size) == size && size > 8) {
            const uint8_t *p = t + 8, *end = t + size;
            while (p + 4 <= end) {
                uint8_t type = p[0], len = p[1];
                const uint8_t *q;
                if (len < 4) break;
                if (type == 1 && len >= 0x18 && p + 0x18 <= end) {
                    static const uint8_t ff[16] = {0xff,0xff,0xff,0xff,0xff,0xff,0xff,0xff,0xff,0xff,0xff,0xff,0xff,0xff,0xff,0xff};
                    static const uint8_t zz[16];
                    if (memcmp(p + 8, ff, 16) && memcmp(p + 8, zz, 16)) add(c, &n, max, "smbios_uuid", salt, p + 8, 16);
                    break;
                }
                q = p + len;
                while (q + 1 < end && (q[0] || q[1])) q++;
                p = q + 2;
            }
        }
        if (t) HeapFree(GetProcessHeap(), 0, t);
    }

    __cpuid(regs, 0);
    {
        char vendor[13];
        memcpy(vendor, &regs[1], 4); memcpy(vendor + 4, &regs[3], 4); memcpy(vendor + 8, &regs[2], 4); vendor[12] = 0;
        add(c, &n, max, "cpu_vendor", salt, vendor, 12);
    }
    {
        int r[12];
        char brand[49];
        __cpuid(r, 0x80000000);
        if ((unsigned)r[0] >= 0x80000004u) {
            __cpuid(r, 0x80000002); memcpy(brand, r, 16);
            __cpuid(r, 0x80000003); memcpy(brand + 16, r, 16);
            __cpuid(r, 0x80000004); memcpy(brand + 32, r, 16);
            brand[48] = 0;
            add(c, &n, max, "cpu_brand", salt, brand, strlen(brand));
        }
        __cpuid(r, 1);
        add(c, &n, max, "cpu_signature", salt, &r[0], 4);
    }
    {
        SYSTEM_INFO si;
        MEMORYSTATUSEX ms;
        GetNativeSystemInfo(&si);
        ms.dwLength = sizeof ms;
        GlobalMemoryStatusEx(&ms);
        {
            DWORD ram_gb = (DWORD)(ms.ullTotalPhys >> 30);
            add(c, &n, max, "cpu_cores", salt, &si.dwNumberOfProcessors, sizeof si.dwNumberOfProcessors);
            add(c, &n, max, "ram_gb", salt, &ram_gb, sizeof ram_gb);
        }
    }
    return n;
}

void og_hwid_unique(const og_component *c, int n, char hex[65])
{
    og_sha256_ctx s;
    uint8_t out[32];
    int i;
    /* only the stable, strongest components identify the machine */
    static const char *core[] = { "machine_guid", "smbios_uuid", "disk_serial", "board", "cpu_brand" };
    og_sha256_init(&s);
    for (i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        size_t k;
        for (k = 0; k < sizeof core / sizeof *core; k++)
            if (!strcmp(c[i].name, core[k])) { og_sha256_update(&s, c[i].hex, 64); break; }
    }
    og_sha256_final(&s, out);
    og_hex(out, 32, hex);
}

/* identity for the server hello: unique id and the hashed components (cached) */
void og_identity(uint8_t uid[32], og_component *comp, int *ncomp)
{
    static og_component cache[OG_MAX_COMPONENTS];
    static int ncache = -1;
    static char uid_hex[65];
    if (ncache < 0) {
        char salt[64];
        og_profile_hwid_salt(salt, sizeof salt);
        ncache = og_hwid_collect(cache, OG_MAX_COMPONENTS, salt);
        SecureZeroMemory(salt, sizeof salt);
        og_hwid_unique(cache, ncache, uid_hex);
    }
    og_unhex(uid_hex, uid, 32);
    memcpy(comp, cache, sizeof(og_component) * ncache);
    *ncomp = ncache;
}
```

`client/src/og_input.c`:

```c
/* Optional input filter: drops synthetic (SendInput / keybd_event / mouse_event) keyboard and mouse input while
 * the game window has focus. Hardware input and other applications are not affected. */
#include "og.h"
#include <string.h>

static volatile LONG g_on;
static HANDLE g_thread;
static DWORD g_tid;
static DWORD g_last_report;

static int game_has_focus(void)
{
    DWORD pid = 0;
    HWND fg = GetForegroundWindow();
    if (!fg) return 0;
    GetWindowThreadProcessId(fg, &pid);
    return pid == GetCurrentProcessId();
}

static void report(const char *what)
{
    DWORD now = GetTickCount();
    uint8_t m[64];
    size_t n = strlen(what);
    if (now - g_last_report < 60000 && g_last_report) return;
    og_log("%s", what);
    g_last_report = now;
    m[0] = OG_C_DETECT; m[1] = 0; m[2] = 0; m[3] = OG_KIND_INPUT;
    memcpy(m + 4, what, n);
    og_net_broadcast_control(m, n + 4);
}

static LRESULT CALLBACK kb_proc(int code, WPARAM wp, LPARAM lp)
{
    if (code == HC_ACTION && g_on) {
        const KBDLLHOOKSTRUCT *k = (const KBDLLHOOKSTRUCT *)lp;
        if ((k->flags & (LLKHF_INJECTED | LLKHF_LOWER_IL_INJECTED)) && game_has_focus()) {
            report("synthetic keyboard input blocked");
            return 1;
        }
    }
    return CallNextHookEx(NULL, code, wp, lp);
}

static LRESULT CALLBACK mouse_proc(int code, WPARAM wp, LPARAM lp)
{
    if (code == HC_ACTION && g_on) {
        const MSLLHOOKSTRUCT *m = (const MSLLHOOKSTRUCT *)lp;
        if ((m->flags & (LLMHF_INJECTED | LLMHF_LOWER_IL_INJECTED)) && game_has_focus()) {
            report("synthetic mouse input blocked");
            return 1;
        }
    }
    return CallNextHookEx(NULL, code, wp, lp);
}

static DWORD WINAPI input_thread(LPVOID p)
{
    MSG msg;
    HHOOK kb = SetWindowsHookExA(WH_KEYBOARD_LL, kb_proc, GetModuleHandleA(NULL), 0);
    HHOOK ms = SetWindowsHookExA(WH_MOUSE_LL, mouse_proc, GetModuleHandleA(NULL), 0);
    (void)p;
    og_log("input filter %s", kb && ms ? "active" : "failed");
    while (GetMessageA(&msg, NULL, 0, 0) > 0) { }
    if (kb) UnhookWindowsHookEx(kb);
    if (ms) UnhookWindowsHookEx(ms);
    return 0;
}

void og_input_enable(int on)
{
    InterlockedExchange(&g_on, on ? 1 : 0);
    if (on && !g_thread) g_thread = CreateThread(NULL, 0, input_thread, NULL, 0, &g_tid);
}
```

`client/src/og_integrity.c`:

```c
#include "og.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <tlhelp32.h>
#include <intrin.h>
#include "../../third_party/monocypher.h"

/* Canonical image of a loaded module: the sections og_pe_section_included() selects, in section order, each as
   large as in memory, with every HIGHLOW relocation slot zeroed. Identical to og_pe_canonical() on the file, so
   the server can verify code range challenges against the release file (guard) or a reference dump (exe). */
static uint8_t *canon(HMODULE m, int which, size_t *size)
{
    const uint8_t *base = (const uint8_t *)m;
    const IMAGE_DOS_HEADER *dos = (const IMAGE_DOS_HEADER *)base;
    const IMAGE_NT_HEADERS32 *nt;
    const IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER *sec;
    const IMAGE_DATA_DIRECTORY *rd, *iat;
    size_t total = 0, pos = 0;
    uint8_t *img;
    int i;

    *size = 0;
    if (!m || dos->e_magic != IMAGE_DOS_SIGNATURE) return NULL;
    nt = (const IMAGE_NT_HEADERS32 *)(base + dos->e_lfanew);
    if (nt->Signature != IMAGE_NT_SIGNATURE) return NULL;
    sec = IMAGE_FIRST_SECTION(nt);
    rd = &nt->OptionalHeader.DataDirectory[IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_BASERELOC];
    iat = &nt->OptionalHeader.DataDirectory[IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_IAT];
    for (i = 0; i < nt->FileHeader.NumberOfSections; i++) {
        DWORD sz = sec[i].Misc.VirtualSize ? sec[i].Misc.VirtualSize : sec[i].SizeOfRawData;
        if (og_pe_section_included(sec[i].Characteristics, which)) total += sz;
    }
    if (!total || total > 256u * 1024 * 1024) return NULL;
    img = (uint8_t *)HeapAlloc(GetProcessHeap(), HEAP_ZERO_MEMORY, total);
    if (!img) return NULL;
    for (i = 0; i < nt->FileHeader.NumberOfSections; i++) {
        DWORD va = sec[i].VirtualAddress, sz = sec[i].Misc.VirtualSize ? sec[i].Misc.VirtualSize : sec[i].SizeOfRawData;
        DWORD done = 0;
        if (!og_pe_section_included(sec[i].Characteristics, which)) continue;
        while (done < sz) {
            MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION mbi;
            DWORD chunk;
            if (!VirtualQuery(base + va + done, &mbi, sizeof mbi)) break;
            chunk = (DWORD)((const uint8_t *)mbi.BaseAddress + mbi.RegionSize - (base + va + done));
            if (chunk > sz - done) chunk = sz - done;
            if (mbi.State == MEM_COMMIT && !(mbi.Protect & (PAGE_NOACCESS | PAGE_GUARD)))
                memcpy(img + pos + done, base + va + done, chunk);
            done += chunk;
        }
        /* the import address table is written by the loader even when its section is read-only */
        if (iat->Size && iat->VirtualAddress < va + sz && iat->VirtualAddress + iat->Size > va) {
            DWORD a = iat->VirtualAddress > va ? iat->VirtualAddress : va;
            DWORD b = iat->VirtualAddress + iat->Size < va + sz ? iat->VirtualAddress + iat->Size : va + sz;
            memset(img + pos + (a - va), 0, b - a);
        }
        if (rd->Size) {
            const IMAGE_BASE_RELOCATION *br = (const IMAGE_BASE_RELOCATION *)(base + rd->VirtualAddress);
            const uint8_t *end = (const uint8_t *)br + rd->Size;
            while ((const uint8_t *)br < end && br->SizeOfBlock >= sizeof *br) {
                const WORD *e = (const WORD *)(br + 1);
                DWORD n = (br->SizeOfBlock - sizeof *br) / 2, k;
                for (k = 0; k < n; k++) {
                    DWORD off = br->VirtualAddress + (e[k] & 0xFFF);
                    if ((e[k] >> 12) == IMAGE_REL_BASED_HIGHLOW && off >= va && off + 4 <= va + sz)
                        memset(img + pos + (off - va), 0, 4);
                }
                br = (const IMAGE_BASE_RELOCATION *)((const uint8_t *)br + br->SizeOfBlock);
            }
        }
        pos += sz;
    }
    *size = total;
    return img;
}

/* diagnostics (selftest canon): writes the canonical image, so an operator can compare it with og_pe_canonical()
   of the release file when a self-integrity report looks wrong */
int og_canon_dump(HMODULE m, int which, const char *path)
{
    size_t n;
    uint8_t *img = canon(m, which, &n);
    FILE *f;
    if (!img) return 0;
    f = fopen(path, "wb");
    if (f) { fwrite(img, 1, n, f); fclose(f); }
    HeapFree(GetProcessHeap(), 0, img);
    return f != NULL;
}

int og_hash_module_code(HMODULE m, int which, uint8_t out[32])
{
    size_t n;
    uint8_t *img = canon(m, which, &n);
    memset(out, 0, 32);
    if (!img) return 0;
    crypto_blake2b(out, 32, img, n);
    HeapFree(GetProcessHeap(), 0, img);
    return 1;
}

int og_module_range(HMODULE m, int which, uint32_t off, uint32_t len, const uint8_t nonce[16], uint8_t out[32])
{
    size_t n;
    uint8_t *img = canon(m, which, &n);
    crypto_blake2b_ctx c;
    if (!img) return OG_CH_ST_MISSING;
    if ((size_t)off > n || len > n - off || len == 0) { HeapFree(GetProcessHeap(), 0, img); return OG_CH_ST_RANGE; }
    crypto_blake2b_init(&c, 32);
    crypto_blake2b_update(&c, nonce, 16);
    crypto_blake2b_update(&c, img + off, len);
    crypto_blake2b_final(&c, out);
    HeapFree(GetProcessHeap(), 0, img);
    return OG_CH_ST_OK;
}

/* ---- anti-debug and API hook checks (hurdles; reported to the server, which decides) ---- */

static int hw_breakpoints(void)
{
    CONTEXT ctx;
    HANDLE t = OpenThread(THREAD_GET_CONTEXT | THREAD_QUERY_INFORMATION, FALSE, og_main_thread);
    int hit = 0;
    if (!t) return 0;
    ZeroMemory(&ctx, sizeof ctx);
    ctx.ContextFlags = CONTEXT_DEBUG_REGISTERS;
    if (GetThreadContext(t, &ctx)) hit = (ctx.Dr0 | ctx.Dr1 | ctx.Dr2 | ctx.Dr3) != 0 && (ctx.Dr7 & 0xFF) != 0;
    CloseHandle(t);
    return hit;
}

/* where does a patched function jump to? 0 = not patched */
static const uint8_t *jump_target(const uint8_t *p)
{
    if (p[0] == 0xE9) return p + 5 + *(const int32_t *)(p + 1);
    if (p[0] == 0xFF && p[1] == 0x25) return **(const uint8_t *const *const *)(p + 2);
    if (p[0] == 0x68 && p[5] == 0xC3) return *(const uint8_t *const *)(p + 1);
    return NULL;
}

static int api_hooked(char *what, size_t cap)
{
    static const struct { const char *mod, *fn; } api[] = {
        { "kernel32.dll", "GetTickCount" }, { "kernel32.dll", "GetTickCount64" }, { "kernel32.dll", "QueryPerformanceCounter" },
        { "kernelbase.dll", "GetTickCount" }, { "kernelbase.dll", "QueryPerformanceCounter" }, { "ntdll.dll", "NtQueryPerformanceCounter" },
        { "ntdll.dll", "RtlQueryPerformanceCounter" }, { "winmm.dll", "timeGetTime" }, { "user32.dll", "GetAsyncKeyState" },
    };
    char win[MAX_PATH], path[MAX_PATH];
    size_t i;
    GetWindowsDirectoryA(win, sizeof win);
    for (i = 0; i < sizeof api / sizeof *api; i++) {
        HMODULE mod = GetModuleHandleA(api[i].mod), owner = NULL;
        const uint8_t *f, *dst;
        MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION mbi;
        if (!mod || !(f = (const uint8_t *)GetProcAddress(mod, api[i].fn))) continue;
        if (!VirtualQuery(f, &mbi, sizeof mbi) || mbi.State != MEM_COMMIT) continue;
        if (!(dst = jump_target(f))) continue;
        if (!VirtualQuery(dst, &mbi, sizeof mbi) || mbi.State != MEM_COMMIT) continue;
        if (!GetModuleHandleExA(GET_MODULE_HANDLE_EX_FLAG_FROM_ADDRESS | GET_MODULE_HANDLE_EX_FLAG_UNCHANGED_REFCOUNT, (LPCSTR)dst, &owner)) {
            snprintf(what, cap, "%s!%s -> unmapped code", api[i].mod, api[i].fn);
            return 1;
        }
        if (owner == og_instance) continue;
        GetModuleFileNameA(owner, path, sizeof path);
        if (_strnicmp(path, win, strlen(win)) == 0 || og_path_tolerated(path)) continue;
        snprintf(what, cap, "%s!%s -> %s", api[i].mod, api[i].fn, path);
        return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}

char og_integrity_detail[MAX_PATH + 64];

uint8_t og_integrity_flags(void)
{
    uint8_t f = 0;
    BOOL remote = FALSE;
    const uint8_t *peb = (const uint8_t *)__readfsdword(0x30);
    CheckRemoteDebuggerPresent(GetCurrentProcess(), &remote);
    if (IsDebuggerPresent() || remote || (peb && (*(const DWORD *)(peb + 0x68) & 0x70))) f |= OG_ALIVE_DEBUGGER;
    if (hw_breakpoints()) f |= OG_ALIVE_HW_BREAKPOINT;
    if (api_hooked(og_integrity_detail, sizeof og_integrity_detail)) f |= OG_ALIVE_API_HOOKED;
    return f;
}

int og_scan_files(const char *dir, char *out, size_t cap)
{
    static const char *pat[] = { "\\*.exe", "\\*.dll" };
    size_t used = 0;
    int p, count = 0;
    for (p = 0; p < 2; p++) {
        char mask[MAX_PATH], full[MAX_PATH], hex[65];
        WIN32_FIND_DATAA fd;
        HANDLE h;
        snprintf(mask, sizeof mask, "%s%s", dir, pat[p]);
        h = FindFirstFileA(mask, &fd);
        if (h == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) continue;
        do {
            if (fd.dwFileAttributes & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY) continue;
            snprintf(full, sizeof full, "%s\\%s", dir, fd.cFileName);
            if (!og_sha256_file(full, hex)) continue;
            used += snprintf(out + used, cap - used, "%s=%s\n", fd.cFileName, hex);
            count++;
            if (used + 128 >= cap) break;
        } while (FindNextFileA(h, &fd));
        FindClose(h);
    }
    return count;
}

static int starts_with_i(const char *s, const char *prefix)
{
    size_t n = strlen(prefix);
    return n && _strnicmp(s, prefix, n) == 0;
}

/* Lists every loaded module; "unknown" counts modules that are neither in the client directory nor in the Windows directory. */
int og_scan_modules(char *out, size_t cap, int *unknown)
{
    char win[MAX_PATH];
    MODULEENTRY32 me;
    HANDLE snap = CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_SNAPMODULE | TH32CS_SNAPMODULE32, GetCurrentProcessId());
    size_t used = 0;
    int count = 0;
    if (unknown) *unknown = 0;
    if (snap == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return 0;
    GetWindowsDirectoryA(win, sizeof win);
    me.dwSize = sizeof me;
    if (Module32First(snap, &me)) do {
        int known = starts_with_i(me.szExePath, og_client_dir) || starts_with_i(me.szExePath, win);
        if (!known && unknown) (*unknown)++;
        if (used + MAX_PATH + 8 < cap)
            used += snprintf(out + used, cap - used, "%s%s\n", known ? "" : "? ", me.szExePath);
        count++;
    } while (Module32Next(snap, &me));
    CloseHandle(snap);
    return count;
}
```

`client/src/og_log.c`:

```c
#include "og.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdarg.h>
#include <string.h>

static FILE *g_log;
HINSTANCE og_instance;
og_policy_t og_policy;
CRITICAL_SECTION og_policy_lock;

void og_log_open(const char *dir)
{
    char p[MAX_PATH];
    snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s\\odinguard.log", dir);
    g_log = fopen(p, "a");
}

void og_log(const char *fmt, ...)
{
    va_list ap;
    SYSTEMTIME t;
    if (!g_log) return;
    GetLocalTime(&t);
    fprintf(g_log, "%04d-%02d-%02d %02d:%02d:%02d ", t.wYear, t.wMonth, t.wDay, t.wHour, t.wMinute, t.wSecond);
    va_start(ap, fmt);
    vfprintf(g_log, fmt, ap);
    va_end(ap);
    fputc('\n', g_log);
    fflush(g_log);
}

/* message box with the guard icon and the operator name as caption */
int og_message(const char *text, UINT type)
{
    MSGBOXPARAMSA p;
    ZeroMemory(&p, sizeof p);
    p.cbSize = sizeof p;
    p.hInstance = og_instance;
    p.lpszText = text;
    p.lpszCaption = "OdinGuard Anti Cheat - " OG_PROFILE_OPERATOR;
    p.dwStyle = (type & ~MB_ICONMASK) | MB_USERICON | MB_TOPMOST | MB_SETFOREGROUND;
    p.lpszIcon = MAKEINTRESOURCEA(1);
    return MessageBoxIndirectA(&p);
}

int og_contains_i(const char *hay, const char *needle)
{
    size_t n = strlen(needle), h = strlen(hay), i;
    if (!n || n > h) return 0;
    for (i = 0; i + n <= h; i++)
        if (_strnicmp(hay + i, needle, n) == 0) return 1;
    return 0;
}

int og_path_tolerated(const char *path)
{
    static const char *ok[] = { "\\Warsaw\\", "\\GAS Tecnologia\\", "\\Diebold\\", "\\Topaz OFD\\",
                                "\\NVIDIA Corporation\\", "\\AMD\\", "\\Steam\\", "\\Discord\\", "\\Overwolf\\",
                                "\\Parallels\\", "\\Microsoft\\", "\\Windows Defender\\", "\\RivaTuner", "\\MSI Afterburner\\" };
    size_t i;
    int k, hit = 0;
    for (i = 0; i < sizeof ok / sizeof *ok; i++) if (og_contains_i(path, ok[i])) return 1;
    EnterCriticalSection(&og_policy_lock);
    for (k = 0; k < og_policy.nsig && !hit; k++)
        if (og_policy.sig[k].kind == OG_KIND_ALLOW_PATH && og_contains_i(path, og_policy.sig[k].pattern)) hit = 1;
    LeaveCriticalSection(&og_policy_lock);
    return hit;
}
```

`client/src/og_main.c`:

```c
/* Entry point, profile values and the exported ABI. Every protection switch comes from the server policy; the
 * ini next to the exe may only change cosmetic and diagnostic values. */
#include "og.h"
#include "../../third_party/monocypher.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>

og_config og_cfg = { 0, 0, OG_PROFILE_BUILD, OG_PROFILE_PORTS };
char og_client_dir[MAX_PATH];
DWORD og_main_thread;

static volatile LONG g_started;

static const uint8_t g_mask[32] = OG_PROFILE_MASK;
static const uint8_t g_hwid_salt[OG_PROFILE_HWID_SALT_LEN] = OG_PROFILE_HWID_SALT;
static const uint8_t g_proto_salt[OG_SALT_LEN] = OG_PROFILE_PROTO_SALT;
static const uint8_t g_build_secret[32] = OG_PROFILE_BUILD_SECRET;

size_t og_profile_hwid_salt(char *out, size_t cap)
{
    size_t i, n = OG_PROFILE_HWID_SALT_LEN < cap - 1 ? OG_PROFILE_HWID_SALT_LEN : cap - 1;
    for (i = 0; i < n; i++) out[i] = (char)(g_hwid_salt[i] ^ g_mask[i & 31]);
    out[n] = 0;
    return n;
}

void og_profile_proto_salt(uint8_t out[OG_SALT_LEN])
{
    int i;
    for (i = 0; i < OG_SALT_LEN; i++) out[i] = g_proto_salt[i] ^ g_mask[i];
}

void og_profile_build_secret(uint8_t out[32])
{
    int i;
    for (i = 0; i < 32; i++) out[i] = g_build_secret[i] ^ g_mask[i];
}

void og_profile_tag(uint8_t out[OG_TAG_LEN])
{
    static const char label[] = "OdinGuard/tag";
    uint8_t salt[OG_SALT_LEN];
    crypto_blake2b_ctx c;
    og_profile_proto_salt(salt);
    crypto_blake2b_init(&c, OG_TAG_LEN);
    crypto_blake2b_update(&c, (const uint8_t *)label, sizeof label - 1);
    crypto_blake2b_update(&c, salt, OG_SALT_LEN);
    crypto_blake2b_final(&c, out);
    crypto_wipe(salt, sizeof salt);
}

void og_config_load(const char *dir)
{
    char p[MAX_PATH];
    snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s\\odinguard.ini", dir);
    og_cfg.max_windows = GetPrivateProfileIntA("OdinGuard", "MaxWindows", og_cfg.max_windows, p);
    og_cfg.block_vm = GetPrivateProfileIntA("OdinGuard", "BlockVM", og_cfg.block_vm, p);
}

OG_API int OdinGuard_Version(void) { return OG_ABI_VERSION; }

#if OG_MOD_INTEGRITY
/* Human-readable report for the operator's self test (selftest.exe). */
OG_API int OdinGuard_Report(char *out, size_t cap)
{
    char hex[65], why[64];
    uint8_t h[32];
    char *files = (char *)HeapAlloc(GetProcessHeap(), 0, 65536);
    char *mods = (char *)HeapAlloc(GetProcessHeap(), 0, 16384);
    size_t used = 0;
    int unk = 0;

    if (!files || !mods) return 0;
    used += snprintf(out + used, cap - used, "odinguard=%s abi=%d profile=%s\n", OG_VERSION_STR, OG_ABI_VERSION, OG_PROFILE_ID);
    if (og_hash_module_code(GetModuleHandleA(NULL), OG_CANON_CODE, h)) { og_hex(h, 32, hex); used += snprintf(out + used, cap - used, "exe_code=%s\n", hex); }
    if (og_hash_module_code(og_instance, OG_CANON_CODE | OG_CANON_RDATA, h)) { og_hex(h, 32, hex); used += snprintf(out + used, cap - used, "guard_code=%s\n", hex); }
#if OG_MOD_HWID
    {
        og_component comp[OG_MAX_COMPONENTS];
        char salt[64], uid[65];
        int n, i;
        og_profile_hwid_salt(salt, sizeof salt);
        n = og_hwid_collect(comp, OG_MAX_COMPONENTS, salt);
        og_hwid_unique(comp, n, uid);
        used += snprintf(out + used, cap - used, "unique_id=%s\n", uid);
        for (i = 0; i < n; i++) used += snprintf(out + used, cap - used, "component.%s=%s\n", comp[i].name, comp[i].hex);
    }
#endif
    used += snprintf(out + used, cap - used, "vm=%d %s\n", og_is_vm(why, sizeof why), why);
    {
        char detail[MAX_PATH + 64] = "";
        int bad = og_assets_check(detail, sizeof detail);
        used += snprintf(out + used, cap - used, "assets=%s %s\n", bad ? "violation" : "ok", detail);
    }
    og_scan_files(og_client_dir, files, 65536);
    used += snprintf(out + used, cap - used, "[files]\n%s", files);
    og_scan_modules(mods, 16384, &unk);
    used += snprintf(out + used, cap - used, "[modules unknown=%d]\n%s", unk, mods);
    HeapFree(GetProcessHeap(), 0, files);
    HeapFree(GetProcessHeap(), 0, mods);
    return (int)used;
}
#endif

#if OG_MOD_INTEGRITY
OG_API int OdinGuard_CanonDump(const char *path) { return og_canon_dump(og_instance, OG_CANON_CODE | OG_CANON_RDATA, path); }
#endif

#if OG_MOD_CRASH
OG_API void OdinGuard_CrashNow(void) { og_crash_write(NULL, "on demand (!crash)"); }
#endif

OG_API int OdinGuard_Start(void)
{
    char why[64];
    if (InterlockedExchange(&g_started, 1)) return 1;
    og_crash_install();
    if (og_cfg.block_vm && og_is_vm(why, sizeof why)) {
        og_log("vm detected: %s", why);
        og_message("Running in a virtual machine is not allowed on this server.", MB_OK | MB_ICONSTOP);
        TerminateProcess(GetCurrentProcess(), 1);
    }
    og_guard_start();
    og_log("started, profile %s, client dir %s", OG_PROFILE_ID, og_client_dir);
    return 1;
}

static DWORD WINAPI start_thread(LPVOID p) { (void)p; OdinGuard_Start(); return 0; }

BOOL WINAPI DllMain(HINSTANCE inst, DWORD reason, LPVOID res)
{
    (void)res;
    if (reason == DLL_PROCESS_ATTACH) {
        char *s, ini[MAX_PATH];
        DisableThreadLibraryCalls(inst);
        og_instance = inst;
        og_main_thread = GetCurrentThreadId();
        GetModuleFileNameA(NULL, og_client_dir, sizeof og_client_dir);
        s = strrchr(og_client_dir, '\\');
        if (s) *s = 0;
        og_config_load(og_client_dir);
        og_log_open(og_client_dir);
        InitializeCriticalSection(&og_policy_lock);
        /* hooks must be in place before the game opens its first connection */
        if (!og_net_init()) og_log("network layer failed to start");
        if (!og_cmds_init()) og_log("command hooks failed");
        if (!og_text_init()) og_log("text hook failed");
        og_ui_init();
#ifdef OG_TEST_CURSOR
        { void og_test_cursor_init(void); og_test_cursor_init(); }
#endif
#if OG_MOD_SPLASH
        snprintf(ini, sizeof ini, "%s\\odinguard.ini", og_client_dir);
        og_splash_show(inst, (DWORD)GetPrivateProfileIntA("OdinGuard", "SplashMs", OG_PROFILE_SPLASH_MS, ini));
#else
        (void)ini;
#endif
        /* everything else runs off the loader lock */
        CloseHandle(CreateThread(NULL, 0, start_thread, NULL, 0, NULL));
    }
    return TRUE;
}

```

`client/src/og_net.c`:

```c
/* Network layer: hooks on ws2_32 (connect, send, recv, select, closesocket), handshake and encrypted records.
 * alpha.exe resolves send/recv with GetProcAddress and calls them through pointers; inline hooks in ws2_32
 * catch these calls without changing the pointers the client checks. */
#include "og.h"
#include "../../third_party/monocypher.h"
#include "../../third_party/minhook/include/MinHook.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

#define MAX_SOCKS 16
#define HANDSHAKE_TIMEOUT_MS 10000

static const uint8_t og_server_pubkey[32] = OG_PROFILE_SERVER_PUBKEY;

enum { S_FREE = 0, S_NEW, S_ACTIVE, S_FAILED };

typedef struct {
    SOCKET s;
    int state;
    CRITICAL_SECTION lock;
    uint8_t k_c2s[32], k_s2c[32];
    uint64_t ctr_c2s, ctr_s2c;
    uint8_t *in;  size_t in_len, in_cap;     /* encrypted bytes from the server */
    uint8_t *pl;  size_t pl_len, pl_cap;     /* decrypted game bytes for the client */
    uint8_t *out; size_t out_len, out_cap;   /* encrypted bytes not yet sent */
} og_sock;

static og_sock g_socks[MAX_SOCKS];
static CRITICAL_SECTION g_table;

typedef int (WSAAPI *connect_t)(SOCKET, const struct sockaddr *, int);
typedef int (WSAAPI *send_t)(SOCKET, const char *, int, int);
typedef int (WSAAPI *recv_t)(SOCKET, char *, int, int);
typedef int (WSAAPI *select_t)(int, fd_set *, fd_set *, fd_set *, const struct timeval *);
typedef int (WSAAPI *closesocket_t)(SOCKET);

static connect_t o_connect;
static send_t o_send;
static recv_t o_recv;
static select_t o_select;
static closesocket_t o_closesocket;
static void *g_targets[5];
static void *g_detours[5];

/* ---------- small buffers ---------- */

static int buf_append(uint8_t **b, size_t *len, size_t *cap, const void *p, size_t n)
{
    if (*len + n > *cap) {
        size_t c = *cap ? *cap : 4096;
        uint8_t *nb;
        while (c < *len + n) c *= 2;
        nb = (uint8_t *)realloc(*b, c);
        if (!nb) return 0;
        *b = nb; *cap = c;
    }
    memcpy(*b + *len, p, n);
    *len += n;
    return 1;
}

static void buf_consume(uint8_t *b, size_t *len, size_t n)
{
    if (n >= *len) { *len = 0; return; }
    memmove(b, b + n, *len - n);
    *len -= n;
}

static inline void wr16(uint8_t *p, uint16_t v) { p[0] = (uint8_t)v; p[1] = (uint8_t)(v >> 8); }
static inline uint16_t rd16(const uint8_t *p) { return (uint16_t)(p[0] | (p[1] << 8)); }
static inline uint32_t rd32(const uint8_t *p) { return p[0] | (p[1] << 8) | (p[2] << 16) | ((uint32_t)p[3] << 24); }
static inline void wr32(uint8_t *p, uint32_t v) { int i; for (i = 0; i < 4; i++) p[i] = (uint8_t)(v >> (8 * i)); }

static void make_nonce(uint8_t nonce[24], uint64_t ctr)
{
    int i;
    memset(nonce, 0, 24);
    for (i = 0; i < 8; i++) nonce[i] = (uint8_t)(ctr >> (8 * i));
}

/* key rotation (og_proto.h): before record c (c > 0, c % OG_REKEY_RECORDS == 0) */
static void rekey(uint8_t key[32], uint64_t ctr)
{
    static const char label[] = "OdinGuard/rekey";
    crypto_blake2b_ctx c;
    uint8_t next[32];
    if (ctr == 0 || ctr % OG_REKEY_RECORDS) return;
    crypto_blake2b_init(&c, 32);
    crypto_blake2b_update(&c, key, 32);
    crypto_blake2b_update(&c, (const uint8_t *)label, sizeof label - 1);
    crypto_blake2b_final(&c, next);
    memcpy(key, next, 32);
    crypto_wipe(next, 32);
}

int og_random(void *p, size_t n)
{
    typedef BOOLEAN (WINAPI *rtlgenrandom_t)(PVOID, ULONG);
    static rtlgenrandom_t gen;
    if (!gen) gen = (rtlgenrandom_t)GetProcAddress(LoadLibraryA("advapi32.dll"), "SystemFunction036");
    return gen && gen(p, (ULONG)n);
}

/* ---------- socket table ---------- */

static og_sock *sock_find(SOCKET s)
{
    int i;
    for (i = 0; i < MAX_SOCKS; i++)
        if (g_socks[i].state != S_FREE && g_socks[i].s == s) return &g_socks[i];
    return NULL;
}

static void sock_reset(og_sock *k)
{
    crypto_wipe(k->k_c2s, 32);
    crypto_wipe(k->k_s2c, 32);
    k->ctr_c2s = k->ctr_s2c = 0;
    k->in_len = k->pl_len = k->out_len = 0;
}

static void sock_track(SOCKET s)
{
    int i;
    EnterCriticalSection(&g_table);
    if (!sock_find(s)) {
        for (i = 0; i < MAX_SOCKS; i++) {
            if (g_socks[i].state != S_FREE) continue;
            EnterCriticalSection(&g_socks[i].lock);
            sock_reset(&g_socks[i]);
            g_socks[i].s = s;
            g_socks[i].state = S_NEW;
            LeaveCriticalSection(&g_socks[i].lock);
            break;
        }
    }
    LeaveCriticalSection(&g_table);
}

static void sock_untrack(SOCKET s)
{
    og_sock *k;
    EnterCriticalSection(&g_table);
    k = sock_find(s);
    if (k) {
        EnterCriticalSection(&k->lock);
        sock_reset(k);
        k->state = S_FREE;
        k->s = INVALID_SOCKET;
        LeaveCriticalSection(&k->lock);
    }
    LeaveCriticalSection(&g_table);
}

static int port_protected(unsigned short port)
{
    char list[128], *t, *ctx = NULL;
    strncpy(list, og_cfg.ports, sizeof list - 1);
    list[sizeof list - 1] = 0;
    for (t = strtok_r(list, ", ", &ctx); t; t = strtok_r(NULL, ", ", &ctx))
        if (atoi(t) == port) return 1;
    return 0;
}

/* ---------- blocking helpers for the handshake (socket may be non-blocking) ---------- */

static int wait_socket(SOCKET s, int write, DWORD deadline)
{
    for (;;) {
        fd_set set;
        struct timeval tv;
        DWORD now = GetTickCount();
        int r;
        if ((LONG)(deadline - now) <= 0) return 0;
        FD_ZERO(&set);
        FD_SET(s, &set);
        tv.tv_sec = 0; tv.tv_usec = 100000;
        r = o_select(0, write ? NULL : &set, write ? &set : NULL, NULL, &tv);
        if (r > 0) return 1;
        if (r < 0) return 0;
    }
}

static int send_all(SOCKET s, const uint8_t *p, size_t n, DWORD deadline)
{
    while (n) {
        int r = o_send(s, (const char *)p, (int)n, 0);
        if (r > 0) { p += r; n -= r; continue; }
        if (r < 0 && WSAGetLastError() == WSAEWOULDBLOCK) { if (!wait_socket(s, 1, deadline)) return 0; continue; }
        return 0;
    }
    return 1;
}

static int recv_exact(SOCKET s, uint8_t *p, size_t n, DWORD deadline)
{
    while (n) {
        int r = o_recv(s, (char *)p, (int)n, 0);
        if (r > 0) { p += r; n -= r; continue; }
        if (r < 0 && (WSAGetLastError() == WSAEWOULDBLOCK || WSAGetLastError() == WSAENOTCONN)) { if (!wait_socket(s, 0, deadline)) return 0; continue; }
        return 0;
    }
    return 1;
}

/* ---------- records ---------- */

static void seal(og_sock *k, uint8_t type, const uint8_t *p, size_t n)
{
    uint8_t *plain = (uint8_t *)malloc((n < OG_RECORD_MAX ? n : OG_RECORD_MAX) + 1);
    if (!plain) return;
    do {
        size_t chunk = n < OG_RECORD_MAX ? n : OG_RECORD_MAX;
        uint8_t head[18], nonce[24];
        size_t pos;
        plain[0] = type;
        if (chunk) memcpy(plain + 1, p, chunk);
        wr16(head, (uint16_t)(chunk + 1));
        rekey(k->k_c2s, k->ctr_c2s);
        make_nonce(nonce, k->ctr_c2s++);
        pos = k->out_len;
        if (!buf_append(&k->out, &k->out_len, &k->out_cap, head, 18)) break;
        if (!buf_append(&k->out, &k->out_len, &k->out_cap, plain, chunk + 1)) break;
        crypto_aead_lock(k->out + pos + 18, k->out + pos + 2, k->k_c2s, nonce, k->out + pos, 2, plain, chunk + 1);
        p += chunk;
        n -= chunk;
    } while (n);
    crypto_wipe(plain, 1);
    free(plain);
}

/* sends what fits; returns 0 on a hard socket error */
static int flush_out(og_sock *k)
{
    while (k->out_len) {
        int r = o_send(k->s, (const char *)k->out, (int)k->out_len, 0);
        if (r > 0) { buf_consume(k->out, &k->out_len, r); continue; }
        if (r < 0 && WSAGetLastError() == WSAEWOULDBLOCK) return 1;
        return 0;
    }
    return 1;
}

static void control(og_sock *k, const uint8_t *msg, size_t n)
{
    seal(k, OG_REC_CONTROL, msg, n);
    flush_out(k);
}

static void on_sig(void *ctx, uint16_t id, uint8_t kind, const char *pat, size_t len)
{
    og_signature *sg;
    (void)ctx;
    if (og_policy.nsig >= OG_MAX_SIGS) return;
    sg = &og_policy.sig[og_policy.nsig++];
    sg->id = id;
    sg->kind = kind;
    memcpy(sg->pattern, pat, len);
    sg->pattern[len] = 0;
}

static void handle_control(og_sock *k, const uint8_t *p, size_t n)
{
    if (!n) return;
    switch (p[0]) {
    case OG_S_POLICY: {
        og_policy_msg m;
        if (og_wire_policy(p, n, &m) < 0) return;
        EnterCriticalSection(&og_policy_lock);
        og_policy.block_vm = m.block_vm;
        og_policy.max_windows = m.max_windows;
        og_policy.alive_interval = m.alive_interval;
        og_policy.input_filter = m.input_filter;
        og_policy.grf_strict = m.grf_strict;
        LeaveCriticalSection(&og_policy_lock);
        InterlockedExchange(&og_policy.received, 1);
        og_guard_new_connection();
        og_log("policy: vm=%d windows=%d alive=%ds input=%d grf=%d", m.block_vm, m.max_windows, m.alive_interval,
               m.input_filter, m.grf_strict);
        og_input_enable(m.input_filter);
        break;
    }
    case OG_S_SIGS: {
        uint8_t op;
        int cnt;
        if (og_wire_sigs(p, n, &op, NULL, NULL) < 0) { og_log("signature list malformed"); return; }
        EnterCriticalSection(&og_policy_lock);
        if (op == OG_SIGS_REPLACE) og_policy.nsig = 0;
        cnt = og_wire_sigs(p, n, &op, on_sig, NULL);
        LeaveCriticalSection(&og_policy_lock);
        og_detect_reset();
        og_log("signatures: %d received, %d active", cnt, og_policy.nsig);
        og_guard_new_connection();
        break;
    }
    case OG_S_PING: {
        uint8_t m[5];
        if (n < 5) return;
        m[0] = OG_C_PONG;
        memcpy(m + 1, p + 1, 4);
        control(k, m, 5);
        break;
    }
    case OG_S_COLORS: {
        uint8_t kind, op;
        if (og_wire_colors(p, n, &kind, &op, NULL, NULL) >= 0) og_colors_update(kind, op, p + 5, n - 5);
        break;
    }
    case OG_S_CHALLENGE: {
        og_challenge_msg c;
        uint8_t r[OG_RESPONSE_LEN];
        if (og_wire_challenge(p, n, &c) < 0) return;
        og_challenge_handle(&c, r);
        control(k, r, sizeof r);
        break;
    }
    case OG_S_COMMAND: {
        char cmd[64], reply[256];
        uint8_t m[257];
        size_t len = n - 1 < sizeof cmd - 1 ? n - 1 : sizeof cmd - 1, rl;
        memcpy(cmd, p + 1, len);
        cmd[len] = 0;
        reply[0] = 0;
        og_cmd_handle(cmd, reply, sizeof reply);
        rl = strlen(reply);
        if (rl) {
            m[0] = OG_C_REPORT;
            memcpy(m + 1, reply, rl);
            control(k, m, rl + 1);
        }
        break;
    }
    }
}

/* decrypts complete records from k->in; returns 0 when the stream is broken */
static int open_records(og_sock *k)
{
    size_t pos = 0;
    int ok = 1;
    uint8_t *plain = NULL;
    for (;;) {
        const uint8_t *r = k->in + pos;
        uint16_t blen = 0;
        uint8_t nonce[24];
        int st = og_wire_record(r, k->in_len - pos, &blen);
        if (st == 0) break;
        if (st < 0) { ok = 0; break; }
        plain = (uint8_t *)realloc(plain, blen);
        if (!plain) { ok = 0; break; }
        rekey(k->k_s2c, k->ctr_s2c);
        make_nonce(nonce, k->ctr_s2c);
        if (crypto_aead_unlock(plain, r + 2, k->k_s2c, nonce, r, 2, r + 18, blen) != 0) {
            og_log("record from server failed authentication");
            ok = 0;
            break;
        }
        k->ctr_s2c++;
        pos += 18 + blen;
        if (plain[0] == OG_REC_GAME) {
            if (blen >= 5) og_crash_note_packet(0, rd16(plain + 1), (uint16_t)(blen - 1));
            buf_append(&k->pl, &k->pl_len, &k->pl_cap, plain + 1, blen - 1);
        } else if (plain[0] == OG_REC_CONTROL) {
            handle_control(k, plain + 1, blen - 1);
        }
    }
    free(plain);
    buf_consume(k->in, &k->in_len, pos);
    return ok;
}

/* ---------- handshake ---------- */

static int handshake(og_sock *k)
{
    uint8_t hello[OG_CLIENT_HELLO_FIXED + OG_MAX_COMPONENTS * (OG_COMPONENT_NAME + 32)];
    uint8_t e_sec[32], e_pub[32], nonce_c[32], shared[32], keys[64], transcript[64], salt[OG_SALT_LEN];
    uint8_t sh[OG_SERVER_HELLO_FIXED + 512];
    og_component comp[OG_MAX_COMPONENTS];
    int ncomp = 0, i;
    size_t len;
    uint16_t slen;
    DWORD deadline = GetTickCount() + HANDSHAKE_TIMEOUT_MS;
    crypto_blake2b_ctx bc;
    static const uint8_t zero[32];
    static const char label[] = "OdinGuard/v2";
    og_server_hello h;
    char why[64];

    if (!og_random(e_sec, 32) || !og_random(nonce_c, 32)) return 0;
    crypto_x25519_public_key(e_pub, e_sec);

    memset(hello, 0, sizeof hello);
    wr16(hello, OG_HELLO_ID);
    hello[4] = OG_PROTO_VERSION;
    hello[5] = (uint8_t)((og_is_vm(why, sizeof why) ? OG_FLAG_VM : 0) | (IsDebuggerPresent() ? OG_FLAG_DEBUGGER : 0));
    memcpy(hello + 6, e_pub, 32);
    memcpy(hello + 38, nonce_c, 32);
    og_identity(hello + 70, comp, &ncomp);
    og_hash_module_code(GetModuleHandleA(NULL), OG_CANON_CODE, hello + 102);
    strncpy((char *)hello + 134, og_cfg.build, 16);
    og_profile_tag(hello + 150);
    if (ncomp > OG_MAX_COMPONENTS) ncomp = OG_MAX_COMPONENTS;
    hello[OG_CLIENT_HELLO_FIXED - 1] = (uint8_t)ncomp;
    for (i = 0; i < ncomp; i++) {
        uint8_t *c = hello + OG_CLIENT_HELLO_FIXED + i * (OG_COMPONENT_NAME + 32);
        size_t j;
        strncpy((char *)c, comp[i].name, OG_COMPONENT_NAME);
        for (j = 0; j < 32; j++) {
            unsigned v;
            sscanf(comp[i].hex + j * 2, "%2x", &v);
            c[OG_COMPONENT_NAME + j] = (uint8_t)v;
        }
    }
    len = OG_CLIENT_HELLO_FIXED + ncomp * (OG_COMPONENT_NAME + 32);
    wr16(hello + 2, (uint16_t)len);

    if (!send_all(k->s, hello, len, deadline)) { og_log("handshake: send failed (%d)", WSAGetLastError()); goto fail; }
    if (!recv_exact(k->s, sh, 4, deadline)) { og_log("handshake: no answer (server without OdinGuard?)"); goto fail; }
    slen = rd16(sh + 2);
    if (rd16(sh) != OG_HELLO_ID || slen < OG_SERVER_HELLO_FIXED || slen > sizeof sh) { og_log("handshake: bad server hello"); goto fail; }
    if (!recv_exact(k->s, sh + 4, slen - 4, deadline)) { og_log("handshake: server hello truncated"); goto fail; }
    if (og_wire_server_hello(sh, slen, &h) <= 0) { og_log("handshake: bad server hello"); goto fail; }

    crypto_blake2b_init(&bc, 64);
    crypto_blake2b_update(&bc, hello, len);
    crypto_blake2b_update(&bc, sh, 70);
    crypto_blake2b_final(&bc, transcript);
    if (crypto_eddsa_check(sh + 70, og_server_pubkey, transcript, 64) != 0) {
        og_log("handshake: server signature invalid (wrong server or man in the middle)");
        goto fail;
    }
    if (h.version < OG_PROTO_MIN) { og_log("handshake: server protocol %d too old (downgrade refused)", h.version); goto fail; }
    if (sh[5] != OG_STATUS_OK) {
        char msg[513];
        size_t ml = slen - OG_SERVER_HELLO_FIXED;
        memcpy(msg, sh + OG_SERVER_HELLO_FIXED, ml);
        msg[ml] = 0;
        og_log("handshake: refused (%d) %s", sh[5], msg);
        og_message(ml ? msg : "The server refused the connection.", MB_OK | MB_ICONWARNING);
        goto fail;
    }

    crypto_x25519(shared, e_sec, sh + 6);
    if (crypto_verify32(shared, zero) == 0) goto fail;
    crypto_blake2b_init(&bc, 64);
    crypto_blake2b_update(&bc, (const uint8_t *)label, sizeof label - 1);
    og_profile_proto_salt(salt);
    crypto_blake2b_update(&bc, salt, OG_SALT_LEN);
    crypto_wipe(salt, OG_SALT_LEN);
    crypto_blake2b_update(&bc, shared, 32);
    crypto_blake2b_update(&bc, e_pub, 32);
    crypto_blake2b_update(&bc, sh + 6, 32);
    crypto_blake2b_update(&bc, nonce_c, 32);
    crypto_blake2b_update(&bc, sh + 38, 32);
    crypto_blake2b_final(&bc, keys);
    memcpy(k->k_c2s, keys, 32);
    memcpy(k->k_s2c, keys + 32, 32);
    crypto_wipe(keys, 64);
    crypto_wipe(shared, 32);
    crypto_wipe(e_sec, 32);
    k->state = S_ACTIVE;
    og_log("handshake ok on socket %u", (unsigned)k->s);
    return 1;
fail:
    crypto_wipe(e_sec, 32);
    k->state = S_FAILED;
    return 0;
}

/* ---------- hooks ---------- */

static int WSAAPI h_connect(SOCKET s, const struct sockaddr *name, int namelen)
{
    int r = o_connect(s, name, namelen);
    int err = WSAGetLastError();
    if (name && namelen >= (int)sizeof(struct sockaddr_in) && name->sa_family == AF_INET &&
        (r == 0 || err == WSAEWOULDBLOCK) && port_protected(ntohs(((const struct sockaddr_in *)name)->sin_port)))
        sock_track(s);
    WSASetLastError(err);
    return r;
}

static int WSAAPI h_send(SOCKET s, const char *buf, int len, int flags)
{
    og_sock *k = sock_find(s);
    int ret = len;
    if (!k) return o_send(s, buf, len, flags);
    EnterCriticalSection(&k->lock);
    if (k->state == S_NEW) handshake(k);
    if (k->state != S_ACTIVE) {
        LeaveCriticalSection(&k->lock);
        WSASetLastError(WSAECONNRESET);
        return SOCKET_ERROR;
    }
    if (len >= 2) og_crash_note_packet(1, rd16((const uint8_t *)buf), (uint16_t)len);
    seal(k, OG_REC_GAME, (const uint8_t *)buf, len);
    if (!flush_out(k)) { ret = SOCKET_ERROR; k->state = S_FAILED; }
    LeaveCriticalSection(&k->lock);
    if (ret == SOCKET_ERROR) WSASetLastError(WSAECONNRESET);
    return ret;
}

static int WSAAPI h_recv(SOCKET s, char *buf, int len, int flags)
{
    og_sock *k = sock_find(s);
    int n, err = 0, closed = 0;
    if (!k || k->state == S_NEW) return o_recv(s, buf, len, flags);
    EnterCriticalSection(&k->lock);
    if (k->state != S_ACTIVE) {
        LeaveCriticalSection(&k->lock);
        WSASetLastError(WSAECONNRESET);
        return SOCKET_ERROR;
    }
    flush_out(k);
    if (!k->pl_len) {
        char tmp[16384];
        int r = o_recv(s, tmp, sizeof tmp, 0);
        if (r > 0) {
            buf_append(&k->in, &k->in_len, &k->in_cap, tmp, r);
            if (!open_records(k)) { k->state = S_FAILED; err = WSAECONNRESET; }
        } else if (r == 0) closed = 1;
        else err = WSAGetLastError();
    }
    if (k->pl_len) {
        n = (int)(k->pl_len < (size_t)len ? k->pl_len : (size_t)len);
        memcpy(buf, k->pl, n);
        buf_consume(k->pl, &k->pl_len, n);
        LeaveCriticalSection(&k->lock);
        return n;
    }
    LeaveCriticalSection(&k->lock);
    if (closed) return 0;
    WSASetLastError(err ? err : WSAEWOULDBLOCK);
    return SOCKET_ERROR;
}

/* sockets with decrypted data waiting must count as readable, the client checks with select() first */
static int WSAAPI h_select(int nfds, fd_set *rd, fd_set *wr, fd_set *ex, const struct timeval *tv)
{
    SOCKET ready[MAX_SOCKS];
    int nready = 0, i, r;
    if (rd) {
        for (i = 0; i < (int)rd->fd_count; i++) {
            og_sock *k = sock_find(rd->fd_array[i]);
            if (k && k->state == S_ACTIVE && k->pl_len && nready < MAX_SOCKS) ready[nready++] = rd->fd_array[i];
        }
    }
    if (!nready) return o_select(nfds, rd, wr, ex, tv);
    {
        struct timeval zero = { 0, 0 };
        r = o_select(nfds, rd, wr, ex, &zero);
        if (r < 0) {
            r = 0;
            if (rd) FD_ZERO(rd);
            if (wr) FD_ZERO(wr);
            if (ex) FD_ZERO(ex);
        }
        for (i = 0; i < nready; i++) {
            if (!FD_ISSET(ready[i], rd)) { FD_SET(ready[i], rd); r++; }
        }
        return r;
    }
}

static int WSAAPI h_closesocket(SOCKET s)
{
    sock_untrack(s);
    return o_closesocket(s);
}

/* ---------- public ---------- */

void og_net_broadcast_control(const uint8_t *msg, size_t n)
{
    int i;
    for (i = 0; i < MAX_SOCKS; i++) {
        og_sock *k = &g_socks[i];
        if (k->state != S_ACTIVE) continue;
        EnterCriticalSection(&k->lock);
        if (k->state == S_ACTIVE) control(k, msg, n);
        LeaveCriticalSection(&k->lock);
    }
}

int og_net_active_connections(void)
{
    int i, c = 0;
    for (i = 0; i < MAX_SOCKS; i++) if (g_socks[i].state == S_ACTIVE) c++;
    return c;
}

/* every hooked function must still start with our jump (MinHook writes E9 rel32 to the detour or a relay) */
int og_net_hooks_intact(void)
{
    int i;
    for (i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        const uint8_t *p = (const uint8_t *)g_targets[i];
        if (!p) continue;
        if (p[0] != 0xE9) return 0;
    }
    return 1;
}

int og_net_init(void)
{
    HMODULE ws = GetModuleHandleA("ws2_32.dll");
    int i;
    static const char *names[5] = { "connect", "send", "recv", "select", "closesocket" };
    void *det[5] = { (void *)h_connect, (void *)h_send, (void *)h_recv, (void *)h_select, (void *)h_closesocket };
    void **orig[5] = { (void **)&o_connect, (void **)&o_send, (void **)&o_recv, (void **)&o_select, (void **)&o_closesocket };

    InitializeCriticalSection(&g_table);
    for (i = 0; i < MAX_SOCKS; i++) { InitializeCriticalSection(&g_socks[i].lock); g_socks[i].s = INVALID_SOCKET; }
    if (!ws) ws = LoadLibraryA("ws2_32.dll");
    if (!ws) return 0;
    if (MH_Initialize() != MH_OK) return 0;
    for (i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        g_targets[i] = (void *)GetProcAddress(ws, names[i]);
        g_detours[i] = det[i];
        if (!g_targets[i] || MH_CreateHook(g_targets[i], det[i], orig[i]) != MH_OK) {
            og_log("hook %s failed", names[i]);
            return 0;
        }
    }
    if (MH_EnableHook(MH_ALL_HOOKS) != MH_OK) return 0;
    og_log("network hooks installed (ports %s)", og_cfg.ports);
    return 1;
}
```

`client/src/og_sha256.c`:

```c
#include "og.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>

static const uint32_t K[64] = {
0x428a2f98,0x71374491,0xb5c0fbcf,0xe9b5dba5,0x3956c25b,0x59f111f1,0x923f82a4,0xab1c5ed5,
0xd807aa98,0x12835b01,0x243185be,0x550c7dc3,0x72be5d74,0x80deb1fe,0x9bdc06a7,0xc19bf174,
0xe49b69c1,0xefbe4786,0x0fc19dc6,0x240ca1cc,0x2de92c6f,0x4a7484aa,0x5cb0a9dc,0x76f988da,
0x983e5152,0xa831c66d,0xb00327c8,0xbf597fc7,0xc6e00bf3,0xd5a79147,0x06ca6351,0x14292967,
0x27b70a85,0x2e1b2138,0x4d2c6dfc,0x53380d13,0x650a7354,0x766a0abb,0x81c2c92e,0x92722c85,
0xa2bfe8a1,0xa81a664b,0xc24b8b70,0xc76c51a3,0xd192e819,0xd6990624,0xf40e3585,0x106aa070,
0x19a4c116,0x1e376c08,0x2748774c,0x34b0bcb5,0x391c0cb3,0x4ed8aa4a,0x5b9cca4f,0x682e6ff3,
0x748f82ee,0x78a5636f,0x84c87814,0x8cc70208,0x90befffa,0xa4506ceb,0xbef9a3f7,0xc67178f2};

#define ROR(x,n) (((x) >> (n)) | ((x) << (32 - (n))))

static void block(og_sha256_ctx *c, const uint8_t *p)
{
    uint32_t w[64], a, b, cc, d, e, f, g, h, t1, t2;
    int i;
    for (i = 0; i < 16; i++)
        w[i] = (uint32_t)p[i*4] << 24 | (uint32_t)p[i*4+1] << 16 | (uint32_t)p[i*4+2] << 8 | p[i*4+3];
    for (i = 16; i < 64; i++) {
        uint32_t s0 = ROR(w[i-15],7) ^ ROR(w[i-15],18) ^ (w[i-15] >> 3);
        uint32_t s1 = ROR(w[i-2],17) ^ ROR(w[i-2],19) ^ (w[i-2] >> 10);
        w[i] = w[i-16] + s0 + w[i-7] + s1;
    }
    a = c->h[0]; b = c->h[1]; cc = c->h[2]; d = c->h[3];
    e = c->h[4]; f = c->h[5]; g = c->h[6]; h = c->h[7];
    for (i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
        t1 = h + (ROR(e,6) ^ ROR(e,11) ^ ROR(e,25)) + ((e & f) ^ (~e & g)) + K[i] + w[i];
        t2 = (ROR(a,2) ^ ROR(a,13) ^ ROR(a,22)) + ((a & b) ^ (a & cc) ^ (b & cc));
        h = g; g = f; f = e; e = d + t1; d = cc; cc = b; b = a; a = t1 + t2;
    }
    c->h[0] += a; c->h[1] += b; c->h[2] += cc; c->h[3] += d;
    c->h[4] += e; c->h[5] += f; c->h[6] += g; c->h[7] += h;
}

void og_sha256_init(og_sha256_ctx *c)
{
    static const uint32_t i0[8] = {0x6a09e667,0xbb67ae85,0x3c6ef372,0xa54ff53a,0x510e527f,0x9b05688c,0x1f83d9ab,0x5be0cd19};
    memcpy(c->h, i0, sizeof i0);
    c->len = 0; c->n = 0;
}

void og_sha256_update(og_sha256_ctx *c, const void *d, size_t n)
{
    const uint8_t *p = d;
    c->len += n;
    while (n) {
        size_t k = 64 - c->n;
        if (k > n) k = n;
        memcpy(c->buf + c->n, p, k);
        c->n += k; p += k; n -= k;
        if (c->n == 64) { block(c, c->buf); c->n = 0; }
    }
}

void og_sha256_final(og_sha256_ctx *c, uint8_t out[32])
{
    uint64_t bits = c->len * 8;
    uint8_t pad = 0x80, z = 0, lb[8];
    int i;
    og_sha256_update(c, &pad, 1);
    while (c->n != 56) og_sha256_update(c, &z, 1);
    for (i = 0; i < 8; i++) lb[i] = (uint8_t)(bits >> (56 - 8*i));
    og_sha256_update(c, lb, 8);
    for (i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
        out[i*4] = c->h[i] >> 24; out[i*4+1] = c->h[i] >> 16;
        out[i*4+2] = c->h[i] >> 8; out[i*4+3] = c->h[i];
    }
}

void og_hex(const uint8_t *in, size_t n, char *out)
{
    static const char x[] = "0123456789abcdef";
    size_t i;
    for (i = 0; i < n; i++) { out[i*2] = x[in[i] >> 4]; out[i*2+1] = x[in[i] & 15]; }
    out[n*2] = 0;
}

int og_sha256_file(const char *path, char hex[65])
{
    og_sha256_ctx c;
    uint8_t buf[65536], out[32];
    DWORD got;
    HANDLE f = CreateFileA(path, GENERIC_READ, FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE | FILE_SHARE_DELETE, NULL, OPEN_EXISTING, FILE_FLAG_SEQUENTIAL_SCAN, NULL);
    if (f == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return 0;
    og_sha256_init(&c);
    while (ReadFile(f, buf, sizeof buf, &got, NULL) && got) og_sha256_update(&c, buf, got);
    CloseHandle(f);
    og_sha256_final(&c, out);
    og_hex(out, 32, hex);
    return 1;
}

int og_unhex(const char *hex, uint8_t *out, size_t n)
{
    size_t i;
    for (i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int v = 0, k;
        for (k = 0; k < 2; k++) {
            char c = hex[i * 2 + k];
            v <<= 4;
            if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') v |= c - '0';
            else if (c >= 'a' && c <= 'f') v |= c - 'a' + 10;
            else if (c >= 'A' && c <= 'F') v |= c - 'A' + 10;
            else return 0;
        }
        out[i] = (uint8_t)v;
    }
    return 1;
}
```

`client/src/og_splash.c`:

```c
/* Start splash: the OdinGuard card fades in on top of the screen while the client loads, then fades out.
 * Layered, topmost, no taskbar entry, never takes the focus. The operator name of the profile is drawn onto the
 * card at run time, so one splash bitmap serves every operator. */
#include "og.h"

#define SPLASH_BITMAP 100
#define SPLASH_ICON 1

static HINSTANCE g_inst;

static void blend(HWND w, HDC mem, SIZE sz, BYTE alpha)
{
    BLENDFUNCTION bf = { AC_SRC_OVER, 0, alpha, AC_SRC_ALPHA };
    POINT src = { 0, 0 };
    UpdateLayeredWindow(w, NULL, NULL, &sz, mem, &src, 0, &bf, ULW_ALPHA);
}

/* draws the operator name into the premultiplied 32-bit DIB: GDI writes into a grey mask, the mask becomes the
   alpha of a gold colour that is blended over the card */
static void draw_operator(HBITMAP bmp, const BITMAP *bm)
{
    BITMAPINFO bi;
    uint8_t *mask = NULL, *dst = (uint8_t *)bm->bmBits;
    HDC dc;
    HBITMAP mb;
    HFONT font, oldf;
    HGDIOBJ oldb;
    RECT r;
    int x, y, w = bm->bmWidth, h = bm->bmHeight;
    (void)bmp;
    if (!dst || bm->bmBitsPixel != 32) return;
    ZeroMemory(&bi, sizeof bi);
    bi.bmiHeader.biSize = sizeof bi.bmiHeader;
    bi.bmiHeader.biWidth = w;
    bi.bmiHeader.biHeight = h;
    bi.bmiHeader.biPlanes = 1;
    bi.bmiHeader.biBitCount = 32;
    dc = CreateCompatibleDC(NULL);
    mb = CreateDIBSection(dc, &bi, DIB_RGB_COLORS, (void **)&mask, NULL, 0);
    if (!mb) { DeleteDC(dc); return; }
    oldb = SelectObject(dc, mb);
    font = CreateFontA(-17, 0, 0, 0, FW_SEMIBOLD, 0, 0, 0, DEFAULT_CHARSET, 0, 0, ANTIALIASED_QUALITY, 0, "Georgia");
    oldf = (HFONT)SelectObject(dc, font);
    SetBkMode(dc, TRANSPARENT);
    SetTextColor(dc, RGB(255, 255, 255));
    SetRect(&r, 250, h - 74, w - 30, h - 40);
    DrawTextA(dc, OG_PROFILE_OPERATOR, -1, &r, DT_LEFT | DT_SINGLELINE | DT_VCENTER | DT_END_ELLIPSIS | DT_NOPREFIX);
    GdiFlush();
    for (y = 0; y < h; y++) for (x = 0; x < w; x++) {
        uint8_t *m = mask + (y * w + x) * 4, *d = dst + (y * w + x) * 4;
        unsigned a = m[1];
        if (!a) continue;
        /* gold (BGR 0x50, 0xC8, 0xF0), premultiplied, over the card */
        d[0] = (uint8_t)((0x50 * a + d[0] * (255 - a)) / 255);
        d[1] = (uint8_t)((0xC8 * a + d[1] * (255 - a)) / 255);
        d[2] = (uint8_t)((0xF0 * a + d[2] * (255 - a)) / 255);
        d[3] = (uint8_t)(a + d[3] * (255 - a) / 255);
    }
    SelectObject(dc, oldf);
    DeleteObject(font);
    SelectObject(dc, oldb);
    DeleteObject(mb);
    DeleteDC(dc);
}

static DWORD WINAPI splash_thread(LPVOID p)
{
    WNDCLASSA wc;
    HBITMAP bmp;
    BITMAP bm;
    HDC screen, mem;
    HGDIOBJ old;
    HWND w;
    SIZE sz;
    RECT work;
    int i;
    DWORD hold = (DWORD)(UINT_PTR)p;

    bmp = (HBITMAP)LoadImageA(g_inst, MAKEINTRESOURCEA(SPLASH_BITMAP), IMAGE_BITMAP, 0, 0, LR_CREATEDIBSECTION);
    if (!bmp) return 0;
    GetObjectA(bmp, sizeof bm, &bm);
    sz.cx = bm.bmWidth;
    sz.cy = bm.bmHeight;
    draw_operator(bmp, &bm);

    ZeroMemory(&wc, sizeof wc);
    wc.lpfnWndProc = DefWindowProcA;
    wc.hInstance = g_inst;
    wc.lpszClassName = "OdinGuardSplash";
    wc.hIcon = LoadIconA(g_inst, MAKEINTRESOURCEA(SPLASH_ICON));
    RegisterClassA(&wc);

    SystemParametersInfoA(SPI_GETWORKAREA, 0, &work, 0);
    w = CreateWindowExA(WS_EX_LAYERED | WS_EX_TOPMOST | WS_EX_TOOLWINDOW | WS_EX_NOACTIVATE | WS_EX_TRANSPARENT,
                        wc.lpszClassName, "OdinGuard", WS_POPUP,
                        work.left + (work.right - work.left - sz.cx) / 2, work.top + (work.bottom - work.top - sz.cy) / 2,
                        sz.cx, sz.cy, NULL, NULL, g_inst, NULL);
    if (!w) { DeleteObject(bmp); return 0; }

    screen = GetDC(NULL);
    mem = CreateCompatibleDC(screen);
    old = SelectObject(mem, bmp);
    blend(w, mem, sz, 0);
    ShowWindow(w, SW_SHOWNOACTIVATE);
    for (i = 1; i <= 12; i++) { blend(w, mem, sz, (BYTE)(i * 255 / 12)); Sleep(16); }
    {
        DWORD end = GetTickCount() + hold;
        MSG msg;
        while ((LONG)(end - GetTickCount()) > 0) {
            while (PeekMessageA(&msg, NULL, 0, 0, PM_REMOVE)) DispatchMessageA(&msg);
            Sleep(20);
        }
    }
    for (i = 12; i >= 0; i--) { blend(w, mem, sz, (BYTE)(i * 255 / 12)); Sleep(20); }
    DestroyWindow(w);
    SelectObject(mem, old);
    DeleteDC(mem);
    ReleaseDC(NULL, screen);
    DeleteObject(bmp);
    return 0;
}

void og_splash_show(HINSTANCE inst, DWORD hold_ms)
{
    g_inst = inst;
    if (hold_ms) CloseHandle(CreateThread(NULL, 0, splash_thread, (LPVOID)(UINT_PTR)hold_ms, 0, NULL));
}
```
