+/* OdinGuard Anti Cheat – wire protocol v2. Shared by the client DLL (C) and the server module (C++).
+ * All integers little-endian. The parsers for every message live in og_wire.c (pure C, fuzzed natively).
+ *
+ * 1. Client hello (plaintext, first bytes on every game TCP connection):
+ *      u16 id = OG_HELLO_ID ("OG"), u16 len, u8 version, u8 flags,
+ *      u8 eph_pub[32], u8 nonce[32], u8 unique_id[32], u8 exe_code[32], char build[16], u8 profile_tag[16],
+ *      u8 n, n x { char name[16]; u8 hash[32]; }
+ *    profile_tag = BLAKE2b-128("OdinGuard/tag" || proto_salt): a client built for another server is refused
+ *    with a clear message instead of failing on the first record.
+ * 2. Server hello (plaintext):
+ *      u16 id = OG_HELLO_ID, u16 len, u8 version, u8 status,
+ *      u8 eph_pub[32], u8 nonce[32], u8 sig[64], char message[]
+ *    sig = EdDSA(server static key, BLAKE2b-512(client hello || server hello without sig and message)).
+ *    The signed transcript contains both version bytes: a downgrade is detected by both sides.
+ * 3. Keys: BLAKE2b-512("OdinGuard/v2" || proto_salt || X25519(eph) || client_pub || server_pub || nonce_c || nonce_s)
+ *      first 32 bytes = client->server key, last 32 = server->client key
+ * 4. Records (both directions after the hellos):
+ *      u16 body_len, u8 mac[16], u8 body[body_len]
+ *      body = AEAD(XChaCha20-Poly1305, key, nonce = u64 counter || 16 zero bytes, ad = the 2 length bytes)
+ *      plaintext body = u8 type, payload. type 0 = game stream bytes, type 1 = control message.
+ *    Key rotation: before the record with counter c (c > 0, c % OG_REKEY_RECORDS == 0) the direction key becomes
+ *    BLAKE2b-256(key || "OdinGuard/rekey"); the old key is wiped (forward secrecy inside a session).
+ *    Replay: the counter is implicit, a replayed, dropped or reordered record fails authentication.
+ */
+#ifndef OG_PROTO_H
+#define OG_PROTO_H
+
+#define OG_HELLO_ID        0x474F /* bytes "OG" */
+#define OG_PROTO_VERSION   2
+#define OG_PROTO_MIN       2      /* lowest version a v2 peer accepts (downgrade protection) */
+#define OG_HELLO_MAX       2048
+#define OG_COMPONENT_NAME  16
+#define OG_MAX_COMPONENTS  24
+#define OG_RECORD_MAX      60000  /* plaintext payload per record */
+#define OG_RECORD_OVERHEAD (2 + 16 + 1)
+#define OG_REKEY_RECORDS   4096
+#define OG_TAG_LEN         16
+#define OG_SALT_LEN        16
+
+#define OG_CLIENT_HELLO_FIXED (2 + 2 + 1 + 1 + 32 + 32 + 32 + 32 + 16 + OG_TAG_LEN + 1)
+#define OG_SERVER_HELLO_FIXED (2 + 2 + 1 + 1 + 32 + 32 + 64)
+
+/* client hello flags */
+#define OG_FLAG_VM        0x01
+#define OG_FLAG_DEBUGGER  0x02
+
+/* server hello status */
+#define OG_STATUS_OK       0
+#define OG_STATUS_OUTDATED 1
+#define OG_STATUS_REFUSED  2
+#define OG_STATUS_PROFILE  3 /* client built for another server (profile tag) */
+
+/* record types */
+#define OG_REC_GAME    0
+#define OG_REC_CONTROL 1
+
+/* control messages, client -> server */
+#define OG_C_ALIVE    0x01 /* u32 seq, u8 exe_code[32], u16 unknown_modules, u8 flags (OG_ALIVE_*), u8 guard_code[32] */
+#define OG_C_DETECT   0x02 /* u16 signature_id, u8 kind, char text[] */
+#define OG_C_PONG     0x03 /* u32 server_tick */
+#define OG_C_REPORT   0x04 /* char text[]: answer to a command, shown to the player */
+#define OG_C_RESPONSE 0x05 /* u32 challenge_id, u8 type, u8 status (OG_CH_ST_*), u8 digest[32], u32 a, u32 b */
+
+#define OG_ALIVE_LEN            (1 + 4 + 32 + 2 + 1 + 32)
+#define OG_ALIVE_HOOKS_TAMPERED 0x01
+#define OG_ALIVE_DEBUGGER       0x02
+#define OG_ALIVE_GRF_VIOLATION  0x04
+#define OG_ALIVE_API_HOOKED     0x08 /* timing/input APIs patched by a foreign module (speed hacks, macro tools) */
+#define OG_ALIVE_HW_BREAKPOINT  0x10 /* debug registers set on the game thread */
+
+/* control messages, server -> client */
+#define OG_S_POLICY    0x81 /* u8 block_vm, u8 max_windows, u16 alive_interval_s, u8 input_filter, u8 grf_strict,
+                               u16 n (always 0 in v2, signatures come with OG_S_SIGS) */
+#define OG_S_PING      0x82 /* u32 server_tick */
+#define OG_S_COMMAND   0x83 /* char command[] ("vsync", "crash") */
+#define OG_S_COLORS    0x84 /* u8 kind (OG_COLOR_*), u8 op (OG_COLOR_OP_*), u16 n,
+                               n x { u8 r, u8 g, u8 b, u8 len, char text[len] } – names/items drawn in that colour */
+#define OG_S_CHALLENGE 0x85 /* u32 challenge_id, u8 type (OG_CH_*), u8 nonce[16], u8 target, u32 a, u32 b */
+#define OG_S_SIGS      0x86 /* u8 op (OG_SIGS_*), u16 n, n x { u16 id, u8 kind, u8 len, char pattern[len] } */
+
+#define OG_POLICY_LEN    9
+#define OG_CHALLENGE_LEN (1 + 4 + 1 + 16 + 1 + 4 + 4)
+#define OG_RESPONSE_LEN  (1 + 4 + 1 + 1 + 32 + 4 + 4)
+
+#define OG_SIGS_REPLACE 0
+#define OG_SIGS_APPEND  1
+
+#define OG_COLOR_NAME 1
+#define OG_COLOR_ITEM 2
+#define OG_COLOR_OP_REPLACE 0 /* the list replaces all entries of the kind */
+#define OG_COLOR_OP_SET     1 /* add or change entries */
+#define OG_COLOR_OP_REMOVE  2 /* remove entries (colour ignored) */
+
+/* challenge types (OG_S_CHALLENGE) */
+#define OG_CH_NONCE      1 /* digest = BLAKE2b-256(key = build secret, "OG/nonce" || nonce) */
+#define OG_CH_CODE_RANGE 2 /* target 0 = game exe, 1 = guard dll; a = offset, b = length in the canonical code image;
+                              digest = BLAKE2b-256(nonce || bytes) */
+#define OG_CH_TIME       3 /* a = client tick (ms), b = client performance counter (ms); digest as OG_CH_NONCE */
+#define OG_CH_FILE_RANGE 4 /* target = index into the protected file list of the profile; a = offset, b = length;
+                              digest = BLAKE2b-256(nonce || bytes) */
+
+#define OG_CH_ST_OK        0
+#define OG_CH_ST_RANGE     1 /* offset/length outside the image or file */
+#define OG_CH_ST_MISSING   2 /* file or module not present */
+#define OG_CH_ST_UNKNOWN   3 /* challenge type not built into this client */
+
+/* detection / signature kinds (OG_C_DETECT, OG_S_SIGS) */
+#define OG_KIND_PROCESS      1
+#define OG_KIND_WINDOW       2  /* window title contains */
+#define OG_KIND_MODULE       3  /* loaded module name contains */
+#define OG_KIND_INPUT        4  /* synthetic input blocked (report only) */
+#define OG_KIND_GRF          5  /* resource override (report only) */
+#define OG_KIND_INJECT       6  /* unknown module loaded (report only) */
+#define OG_KIND_WINDOW_CLASS 7  /* exact window class name */
+#define OG_KIND_FILE_NAME    8  /* file name in the client folder (case-insensitive, exact) */
+#define OG_KIND_FILE_SHA256  9  /* hex sha256 of a file in the client folder or of a loaded module file */
+#define OG_KIND_DRIVER       10 /* kernel driver / service name */
+#define OG_KIND_GRF_SHA256   11 /* hex sha256 of a GRF listed in DATA.INI */
+#define OG_KIND_API_HOOK     12 /* report only: API patched, text = function and owning module */
+#define OG_KIND_GRF_MODIFIED 13 /* report only: GRF of the operator list differs (text = name) */
+#define OG_KIND_GRF_UNKNOWN  14 /* report only: GRF in DATA.INI that is neither listed nor an allowed mod */
+#define OG_KIND_GRF_MISSING  15 /* report only: required GRF of the operator list missing */
+#define OG_KIND_MUTEX        16 /* named mutex / event / section exists (exact name, Local or Global) */
+#define OG_KIND_REGISTRY     17 /* registry key exists: "HKCU\\path" or "HKLM\\path" */
+/* GRF manifest of the operator (sent with OG_S_SIGS, id 0, never reported themselves):
+ *   GRF_LIST "name|size|tail-sha256|full-sha256 or -|r or o"  accepted version of a GRF in DATA.INI (r = required);
+ *            several entries with the same name = several accepted versions (patch rollouts)
+ *   GRF_MOD  "tail-sha256|note"   allowed optional GRF under any name (skins, darkworld variants)
+ *   OVERLAY  "data\\folder\\"    allowed loose-file folder (in addition to the built-in overlays)
+ * tail-sha256 = SHA-256 of the 46-byte header followed by the bytes from the file table to the end of the file
+ * (fast: every repack or entry change rewrites the table); full-sha256 = SHA-256 of the whole file, checked in
+ * the background. */
+#define OG_KIND_GRF_LIST     18
+#define OG_KIND_GRF_MOD      19
+#define OG_KIND_OVERLAY      20
+#define OG_KIND_ALLOW_SHA256 64 /* allowlist: never report a file or module with this hash */
+#define OG_KIND_ALLOW_PATH   65 /* allowlist: never report a module whose path contains this text */
+
+#endif

+/* OdinGuard Anti Cheat – see og_wire.h. Valid C99 and C++ (the server compiles it through og_wire.cpp). */
+#include "og_wire.h"
+
+#include <stdlib.h>
+#include <string.h>
+
+int og_wire_client_hello(const uint8_t *p, size_t n, og_client_hello *h)
+{
+	uint16_t len;
+	uint8_t nc;
+	if (n < 4) return 0;
+	if (og_rd16(p) != OG_HELLO_ID) return -1;
+	len = og_rd16(p + 2);
+	if (len < OG_CLIENT_HELLO_FIXED || len > OG_HELLO_MAX) return -1;
+	if (n < len) return 0;
+	nc = p[OG_CLIENT_HELLO_FIXED - 1];
+	if (nc > OG_MAX_COMPONENTS || len != OG_CLIENT_HELLO_FIXED + (size_t)nc * (OG_COMPONENT_NAME + 32)) return -1;
+	h->len = len;
+	h->version = p[4];
+	h->flags = p[5];
+	h->eph_pub = p + 6;
+	h->nonce = p + 38;
+	h->unique_id = p + 70;
+	h->exe_code = p + 102;
+	h->build = p + 134;
+	h->tag = p + 150;
+	h->ncomp = nc;
+	h->comp = p + OG_CLIENT_HELLO_FIXED;
+	return len;
+}
+
+int og_wire_server_hello(const uint8_t *p, size_t n, og_server_hello *h)
+{
+	uint16_t len;
+	if (n < 4) return 0;
+	if (og_rd16(p) != OG_HELLO_ID) return -1;
+	len = og_rd16(p + 2);
+	if (len < OG_SERVER_HELLO_FIXED || len > OG_HELLO_MAX) return -1;
+	if (n < len) return 0;
+	h->len = len;
+	h->version = p[4];
+	h->status = p[5];
+	h->eph_pub = p + 6;
+	h->nonce = p + 38;
+	h->sig = p + 70;
+	h->message = p + OG_SERVER_HELLO_FIXED;
+	h->message_len = (size_t)len - OG_SERVER_HELLO_FIXED;
+	return len;
+}
+
+int og_wire_record(const uint8_t *p, size_t n, uint16_t *body_len)
+{
+	uint16_t b;
+	if (n < 2) return 0;
+	b = og_rd16(p);
+	if (b == 0 || b > OG_RECORD_MAX + 1) return -1;
+	if (n < (size_t)18 + b) return 0;
+	*body_len = b;
+	return 1;
+}
+
+int og_wire_policy(const uint8_t *p, size_t n, og_policy_msg *m)
+{
+	if (n < OG_POLICY_LEN || p[0] != OG_S_POLICY) return -1;
+	m->block_vm = p[1];
+	m->max_windows = p[2];
+	m->alive_interval = og_rd16(p + 3);
+	m->input_filter = p[5];
+	m->grf_strict = p[6];
+	return OG_POLICY_LEN;
+}
+
+int og_wire_alive(const uint8_t *p, size_t n, og_alive_msg *m)
+{
+	if (n < OG_ALIVE_LEN || p[0] != OG_C_ALIVE) return -1;
+	m->seq = og_rd32(p + 1);
+	m->exe_code = p + 5;
+	m->unknown_modules = og_rd16(p + 37);
+	m->flags = p[39];
+	m->guard_code = p + 40;
+	return OG_ALIVE_LEN;
+}
+
+int og_wire_challenge(const uint8_t *p, size_t n, og_challenge_msg *m)
+{
+	if (n < OG_CHALLENGE_LEN || p[0] != OG_S_CHALLENGE) return -1;
+	m->id = og_rd32(p + 1);
+	m->type = p[5];
+	m->nonce = p + 6;
+	m->target = p[22];
+	m->a = og_rd32(p + 23);
+	m->b = og_rd32(p + 27);
+	return OG_CHALLENGE_LEN;
+}
+
+int og_wire_response(const uint8_t *p, size_t n, og_response_msg *m)
+{
+	if (n < OG_RESPONSE_LEN || p[0] != OG_C_RESPONSE) return -1;
+	m->id = og_rd32(p + 1);
+	m->type = p[5];
+	m->status = p[6];
+	m->digest = p + 7;
+	m->a = og_rd32(p + 39);
+	m->b = og_rd32(p + 43);
+	return OG_RESPONSE_LEN;
+}
+
+int og_wire_sigs(const uint8_t *p, size_t n, uint8_t *op, og_sig_fn fn, void *ctx)
+{
+	size_t pos = 4;
+	int cnt, i;
+	if (n < 4 || p[0] != OG_S_SIGS) return -1;
+	*op = p[1];
+	cnt = og_rd16(p + 2);
+	for (i = 0; i < cnt; i++) {
+		uint8_t len;
+		if (pos + 4 > n) return -1;
+		len = p[pos + 3];
+		if (pos + 4 + len > n) return -1;
+		if (fn) fn(ctx, og_rd16(p + pos), p[pos + 2], (const char *)p + pos + 4, len);
+		pos += 4 + (size_t)len;
+	}
+	return cnt;
+}
+
+int og_wire_colors(const uint8_t *p, size_t n, uint8_t *kind, uint8_t *op, og_color_fn fn, void *ctx)
+{
+	size_t pos = 5;
+	int cnt, i;
+	if (n < 5 || p[0] != OG_S_COLORS) return -1;
+	*kind = p[1];
+	*op = p[2];
+	cnt = og_rd16(p + 3);
+	for (i = 0; i < cnt; i++) {
+		uint8_t len;
+		if (pos + 4 > n) return -1;
+		len = p[pos + 3];
+		if (pos + 4 + len > n) return -1;
+		if (fn) fn(ctx, ((uint32_t)p[pos] << 16) | ((uint32_t)p[pos + 1] << 8) | p[pos + 2], (const char *)p + pos + 4, len);
+		pos += 4 + (size_t)len;
+	}
+	return cnt;
+}
+
+size_t og_wire_write_challenge(uint8_t out[OG_CHALLENGE_LEN], const og_challenge_msg *m)
+{
+	out[0] = OG_S_CHALLENGE;
+	og_wr32(out + 1, m->id);
+	out[5] = m->type;
+	memcpy(out + 6, m->nonce, 16);
+	out[22] = m->target;
+	og_wr32(out + 23, m->a);
+	og_wr32(out + 27, m->b);
+	return OG_CHALLENGE_LEN;
+}
+
+size_t og_wire_write_response(uint8_t out[OG_RESPONSE_LEN], const og_response_msg *m)
+{
+	out[0] = OG_C_RESPONSE;
+	og_wr32(out + 1, m->id);
+	out[5] = m->type;
+	out[6] = m->status;
+	if (m->digest) memcpy(out + 7, m->digest, 32);
+	else memset(out + 7, 0, 32);
+	og_wr32(out + 39, m->a);
+	og_wr32(out + 43, m->b);
+	return OG_RESPONSE_LEN;
+}
+
+/* ---------------- PE canonical image ---------------- */
+
+#define PE_SCN_CNT_INITIALIZED_DATA 0x00000040u
+#define PE_SCN_MEM_DISCARDABLE      0x02000000u
+#define PE_SCN_MEM_EXECUTE          0x20000000u
+#define PE_SCN_MEM_WRITE            0x80000000u
+
+int og_pe_section_included(uint32_t ch, int which)
+{
+	if (ch & (PE_SCN_MEM_WRITE | PE_SCN_MEM_DISCARDABLE)) return 0;
+	if (ch & PE_SCN_MEM_EXECUTE) return (which & OG_CANON_CODE) != 0;
+	return (which & OG_CANON_RDATA) && (ch & PE_SCN_CNT_INITIALIZED_DATA);
+}
+
+typedef struct { uint32_t va, vsize, raw, rawsize, ch; } pe_sec;
+
+static uint32_t rva_to_off(const pe_sec *s, int ns, uint32_t rva, size_t n)
+{
+	int i;
+	for (i = 0; i < ns; i++)
+		if (rva >= s[i].va && rva < s[i].va + s[i].rawsize && (size_t)s[i].raw + (rva - s[i].va) < n)
+			return s[i].raw + (rva - s[i].va);
+	return 0;
+}
+
+size_t og_pe_canonical(const uint8_t *f, size_t n, int which, uint8_t **out)
+{
+	uint32_t lfanew, opt, nsec, i, rel_rva, rel_size, iat_rva, iat_size, total = 0, pos = 0;
+	uint16_t optsize;
+	pe_sec s[96];
+	uint8_t *img;
+	*out = NULL;
+	if (n < 0x40 || f[0] != 'M' || f[1] != 'Z') return 0;
+	lfanew = og_rd32(f + 0x3c);
+	if ((size_t)lfanew + 24 > n || memcmp(f + lfanew, "PE\0\0", 4) != 0) return 0;
+	nsec = og_rd16(f + lfanew + 6);
+	optsize = og_rd16(f + lfanew + 20);
+	opt = lfanew + 24;
+	if (nsec == 0 || nsec > 96 || (size_t)opt + optsize + nsec * 40u > n || optsize < 96 + 6 * 8) return 0;
+	if (og_rd16(f + opt) != 0x10b) return 0; /* PE32 only (the 2018 client and the guard are 32-bit) */
+	rel_rva = og_rd32(f + opt + 96 + 5 * 8);
+	rel_size = og_rd32(f + opt + 96 + 5 * 8 + 4);
+	/* the import address table is written by the loader even when its section is read-only */
+	iat_rva = optsize >= 96 + 13 * 8 ? og_rd32(f + opt + 96 + 12 * 8) : 0;
+	iat_size = optsize >= 96 + 13 * 8 ? og_rd32(f + opt + 96 + 12 * 8 + 4) : 0;
+	for (i = 0; i < nsec; i++) {
+		const uint8_t *h = f + opt + optsize + i * 40;
+		s[i].vsize = og_rd32(h + 8);
+		s[i].va = og_rd32(h + 12);
+		s[i].rawsize = og_rd32(h + 16);
+		s[i].raw = og_rd32(h + 20);
+		s[i].ch = og_rd32(h + 36);
+		if (!s[i].vsize) s[i].vsize = s[i].rawsize;
+		if ((size_t)s[i].raw + s[i].rawsize > n) s[i].rawsize = s[i].raw < n ? (uint32_t)(n - s[i].raw) : 0;
+		if (s[i].vsize > 64u * 1024 * 1024) return 0;
+		if (og_pe_section_included(s[i].ch, which)) total += s[i].vsize;
+	}
+	if (!total || total > 256u * 1024 * 1024) return 0;
+	img = (uint8_t *)calloc(1, total);
+	if (!img) return 0;
+	for (i = 0; i < nsec; i++) {
+		uint32_t copy, start;
+		if (!og_pe_section_included(s[i].ch, which)) continue;
+		start = pos;
+		copy = s[i].rawsize < s[i].vsize ? s[i].rawsize : s[i].vsize;
+		if (copy) memcpy(img + pos, f + s[i].raw, copy);
+		pos += s[i].vsize;
+		if (iat_size && iat_rva < s[i].va + s[i].vsize && iat_rva + iat_size > s[i].va) {
+			uint32_t a = iat_rva > s[i].va ? iat_rva : s[i].va;
+			uint32_t b = iat_rva + iat_size < s[i].va + s[i].vsize ? iat_rva + iat_size : s[i].va + s[i].vsize;
+			memset(img + start + (a - s[i].va), 0, b - a);
+		}
+		/* zero every HIGHLOW slot inside this section */
+		if (rel_rva && rel_size) {
+			uint32_t r = rva_to_off(s, (int)nsec, rel_rva, n), end;
+			if (r) {
+				end = r + rel_size;
+				if (end > n) end = (uint32_t)n;
+				while (r + 8 <= end) {
+					uint32_t page = og_rd32(f + r), bsize = og_rd32(f + r + 4), k;
+					if (bsize < 8 || r + bsize > end) break;
+					for (k = 8; k + 2 <= bsize; k += 2) {
+						uint16_t e = og_rd16(f + r + k);
+						uint32_t rva = page + (e & 0xFFF);
+						if ((e >> 12) == 3 && rva >= s[i].va && rva + 4 <= s[i].va + s[i].vsize)
+							memset(img + start + (rva - s[i].va), 0, 4);
+					}
+					r += bsize;
+				}
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	*out = img;
+	return total;
+}

+/* OdinGuard Anti Cheat – pure parsers and writers for the wire protocol (og_proto.h) and a portable PE
+ * canonicaliser. No OS calls, no allocation except og_pe_canonical. Used by the client DLL, the server module
+ * (compiled as C++ through og_wire.cpp) and the native fuzz test (tests/fuzz_wire.c).
+ *
+ * Return convention of the parsers: > 0 = number of bytes the message uses, 0 = incomplete (stream framing
+ * only), -1 = malformed (drop the connection or the message). */
+#ifndef OG_WIRE_H
+#define OG_WIRE_H
+
+#include <stddef.h>
+#include <stdint.h>
+
+#include "og_proto.h"
+
+#ifdef __cplusplus
+extern "C" {
+#endif
+
+static inline uint16_t og_rd16(const uint8_t *p) { return (uint16_t)(p[0] | (p[1] << 8)); }
+static inline uint32_t og_rd32(const uint8_t *p) { return (uint32_t)p[0] | ((uint32_t)p[1] << 8) | ((uint32_t)p[2] << 16) | ((uint32_t)p[3] << 24); }
+static inline void og_wr16(uint8_t *p, uint16_t v) { p[0] = (uint8_t)v; p[1] = (uint8_t)(v >> 8); }
+static inline void og_wr32(uint8_t *p, uint32_t v) { p[0] = (uint8_t)v; p[1] = (uint8_t)(v >> 8); p[2] = (uint8_t)(v >> 16); p[3] = (uint8_t)(v >> 24); }
+
+typedef struct {
+	uint16_t len;
+	uint8_t version, flags, ncomp;
+	const uint8_t *eph_pub, *nonce, *unique_id, *exe_code, *build, *tag, *comp; /* comp: ncomp x (16 + 32) */
+} og_client_hello;
+
+typedef struct {
+	uint16_t len;
+	uint8_t version, status;
+	const uint8_t *eph_pub, *nonce, *sig, *message;
+	size_t message_len;
+} og_server_hello;
+
+typedef struct { uint8_t block_vm, max_windows, input_filter, grf_strict; uint16_t alive_interval; } og_policy_msg;
+typedef struct { uint32_t seq; const uint8_t *exe_code; uint16_t unknown_modules; uint8_t flags; const uint8_t *guard_code; } og_alive_msg;
+typedef struct { uint32_t id; uint8_t type; const uint8_t *nonce; uint8_t target; uint32_t a, b; } og_challenge_msg;
+typedef struct { uint32_t id; uint8_t type, status; const uint8_t *digest; uint32_t a, b; } og_response_msg;
+
+typedef void (*og_sig_fn)(void *ctx, uint16_t id, uint8_t kind, const char *pattern, size_t len);
+typedef void (*og_color_fn)(void *ctx, uint32_t rgb, const char *text, size_t len);
+
+int og_wire_client_hello(const uint8_t *p, size_t n, og_client_hello *h);
+int og_wire_server_hello(const uint8_t *p, size_t n, og_server_hello *h);
+/* record framing: 1 = a complete record of 18 + *body_len bytes is at p */
+int og_wire_record(const uint8_t *p, size_t n, uint16_t *body_len);
+
+/* control messages (p[0] is the message type) */
+int og_wire_policy(const uint8_t *p, size_t n, og_policy_msg *m);
+int og_wire_alive(const uint8_t *p, size_t n, og_alive_msg *m);
+int og_wire_challenge(const uint8_t *p, size_t n, og_challenge_msg *m);
+int og_wire_response(const uint8_t *p, size_t n, og_response_msg *m);
+/* returns the number of entries delivered, -1 if malformed (entries before the error were delivered) */
+int og_wire_sigs(const uint8_t *p, size_t n, uint8_t *op, og_sig_fn fn, void *ctx);
+int og_wire_colors(const uint8_t *p, size_t n, uint8_t *kind, uint8_t *op, og_color_fn fn, void *ctx);
+
+size_t og_wire_write_challenge(uint8_t out[OG_CHALLENGE_LEN], const og_challenge_msg *m);
+size_t og_wire_write_response(uint8_t out[OG_RESPONSE_LEN], const og_response_msg *m);
+
+/* Canonical image of a PE file (32-bit): the sections a guard hashes, in section order, each as large as in
+ * memory (zero padded), with every HIGHLOW relocation slot and the import address table zeroed, so it does not depend on the load address.
+ * OG_CANON_CODE: executable, non-writable sections. OG_CANON_RDATA: also read-only initialized data
+ * (not discardable). Returns the size and sets *out (malloc'd, caller frees), 0 if the file is not a usable PE. */
+#define OG_CANON_CODE  1
+#define OG_CANON_RDATA 2
+size_t og_pe_canonical(const uint8_t *file, size_t n, int which, uint8_t **out);
+/* section filter shared by the file and the in-memory variant */
+int og_pe_section_included(uint32_t characteristics, int which);
+

+}
+#endif
+
+#endif

+// OdinGuard checks of the login-server. See og_login.hpp.
+
+#include "og_login.hpp"
+
+#include <string>
+
+#include <common/odinguard.hpp>
+#include <common/showmsg.hpp>
+#include <common/socket.hpp>
+#include <common/sql.hpp>
+
+// same database as the ip ban list (ipban.cpp)
+extern std::string ipban_db_hostname;
+extern uint16 ipban_db_port;
+extern std::string ipban_db_username;
+extern std::string ipban_db_password;
+extern std::string ipban_db_database;
+
+static Sql* og_sql = nullptr;
+
+// components that identify one machine; the others (cpu, board model, ...) are shared by many players
+static const char* og_unique_components[] = { "machine_guid", "volume_serial", "disk_serial", "mac", "smbios_uuid" };
+
+void og_login_init() {
+	if (!og_enabled())
+		return;
+	og_sql = Sql_Malloc();
+	if (SQL_ERROR == Sql_Connect(og_sql, ipban_db_username.c_str(), ipban_db_password.c_str(), ipban_db_hostname.c_str(), ipban_db_port, ipban_db_database.c_str())) {
+		Sql_ShowDebug(og_sql);
+		Sql_Free(og_sql);
+		og_sql = nullptr;
+		ShowError("OdinGuard: no database connection, hardware bans are not checked.\n");
+		return;
+	}
+	for (const char* q : og_sql_ddl())
+		if (SQL_ERROR == Sql_QueryStr(og_sql, q))
+			Sql_ShowDebug(og_sql);
+}
+
+void og_login_final() {
+	if (og_sql != nullptr) {
+		Sql_Free(og_sql);
+		og_sql = nullptr;
+	}
+}
+
+static std::string og_escape(const std::string& s) {
+	std::string out(s.size() * 2 + 1, '\0');
+	out.resize(Sql_EscapeStringLen(og_sql, &out[0], s.c_str(), s.size()));
+	return out;
+}
+
+static bool og_count(const std::string& query) {
+	if (SQL_ERROR == Sql_QueryStr(og_sql, query.c_str())) {
+		Sql_ShowDebug(og_sql);
+		return false;
+	}
+	bool found = Sql_NumRows(og_sql) > 0 && SQL_SUCCESS == Sql_NextRow(og_sql);
+	Sql_FreeResult(og_sql);
+	return found;
+}
+
+static void og_log_event(const s_og_info* info, uint32 account_id, const char* type, const std::string& detail, const char* action) {
+	std::string q = "INSERT INTO `og_event` (`unique_id`,`account_id`,`type`,`detail`,`action`) VALUES ('" + info->unique_id + "'," +
+		std::to_string(account_id) + ",'" + og_escape(type) + "','" + og_escape(detail.substr(0, 255)) + "','" + action + "')";
+	if (SQL_ERROR == Sql_QueryStr(og_sql, q.c_str()))
+		Sql_ShowDebug(og_sql);
+}
+
+int32 og_login_check(int32 fd, uint32 account_id, const char* userid) {
+	if (!og_enabled())
+		return 0;
+	const s_og_info* info = og_info(fd);
+	if (info == nullptr) {
+		if (og_required()) {
+			ShowStatus("OdinGuard: login of '%s' refused, client without OdinGuard.\n", userid);
+			return 5;
+		}
+		return 0;
+	}
+	if (og_sql == nullptr)
+		return 0;
+
+	const std::string& uid = info->unique_id; // hex from the socket layer, safe for SQL
+	const char* active = "(b.`expires` IS NULL OR b.`expires` > NOW())";
+	bool banned = og_count("SELECT 1 FROM `og_ban` b WHERE b.`unique_id` = '" + uid + "' AND " + active + " LIMIT 1");
+	std::string linked;
+
+	if (!banned) {
+		// fuzzy match: enough identifying components equal to those of a banned machine
+		std::string cond;
+		for (const auto& c : info->components) {
+			for (const char* name : og_unique_components) {
+				if (c.first != name)
+					continue;
+				if (!cond.empty())
+					cond += " OR ";
+				cond += "(c.`name` = '" + og_escape(c.first) + "' AND c.`hash` = '" + og_escape(c.second) + "')";
+			}
+		}
+		if (!cond.empty()) {
+			std::string q = "SELECT c.`unique_id` FROM `og_component` c JOIN `og_ban` b ON b.`unique_id` = c.`unique_id` AND " + std::string(active) +
+				" WHERE c.`unique_id` <> '" + uid + "' AND (" + cond + ") GROUP BY c.`unique_id` HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.`name`) >= " +
+				std::to_string(og_ban_match()) + " LIMIT 1";
+			if (SQL_ERROR == Sql_QueryStr(og_sql, q.c_str()))
+				Sql_ShowDebug(og_sql);
+			else {
+				if (SQL_SUCCESS == Sql_NextRow(og_sql)) {
+					char* data;
+					Sql_GetData(og_sql, 0, &data, nullptr);
+					linked = data;
+					banned = true;
+				}
+				Sql_FreeResult(og_sql);
+			}
+		}
+	}
+
+	// registry of machines and their components (needed for bans and fuzzy matching)
+	char ip[16];
+	ip2str(session[fd]->client_addr, ip);
+	std::string q = "INSERT INTO `og_client` (`unique_id`,`account_id`,`last_ip`,`build`,`exe_code`) VALUES ('" + uid + "'," + std::to_string(account_id) +
+		",'" + ip + "','" + og_escape(info->build) + "','" + info->exe_code + "') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE `last_seen` = NOW(), `last_ip` = VALUES(`last_ip`),"
+		" `build` = VALUES(`build`), `exe_code` = VALUES(`exe_code`)";
+	if (SQL_ERROR == Sql_QueryStr(og_sql, q.c_str()))
+		Sql_ShowDebug(og_sql);
+	for (const auto& c : info->components) {
+		q = "REPLACE INTO `og_component` (`unique_id`,`name`,`hash`) VALUES ('" + uid + "','" + og_escape(c.first) + "','" + og_escape(c.second) + "')";
+		if (SQL_ERROR == Sql_QueryStr(og_sql, q.c_str()))
+			Sql_ShowDebug(og_sql);
+	}
+
+	if (!banned)
+		return 0;
+	if (!linked.empty()) {
+		// the new id of a banned machine is banned as well
+		q = "INSERT INTO `og_ban` (`unique_id`,`reason`,`banned_by`) VALUES ('" + uid + "','linked to " + og_escape(linked) + "','OdinGuard')";
+		if (SQL_ERROR == Sql_QueryStr(og_sql, q.c_str()))
+			Sql_ShowDebug(og_sql);
+	}
+	og_log_event(info, account_id, "login-banned", linked.empty() ? uid : "linked to " + linked, "refuse");
+	ShowStatus("OdinGuard: login of '%s' refused, machine %.16s... is banned.\n", userid, uid.c_str());
+	return 4;
+}

+/// OdinGuard: lite ground skills (flat cell tiles from odin.grf). @lgp|@square|@circle|@aoes [on|off|1-14]
+static int32 og_lgp_acmd(map_session_data* sd, const char* command, const char* message, int32 kind) {
+	static const char* ids[] = { "lgp", "square", "circle", "aoes" };
+	if (!og_map_command_allowed(sd, ids[kind], 1000))
+		return -1;
+	(void)command;
+	og_map_lgp_command(sd, kind, message ? message : "");
+	return 0;
+}
+ACMD_FUNC(lgp) { nullpo_retr(-1, sd); return og_lgp_acmd(sd, command, message, 0); }
+ACMD_FUNC(square) { nullpo_retr(-1, sd); return og_lgp_acmd(sd, command, message, 1); }
+ACMD_FUNC(circle) { nullpo_retr(-1, sd); return og_lgp_acmd(sd, command, message, 2); }
+ACMD_FUNC(aoes) { nullpo_retr(-1, sd); return og_lgp_acmd(sd, command, message, 3); }

+/// OdinGuard: permanent name colour (needs OdinGuard on the viewers' clients). @namecolor <RRGGBB|off>[, character]
+ACMD_FUNC(namecolor)
+{
+	char color[16], name[NAME_LENGTH] = "";
+	nullpo_retr(-1, sd);
+	if (!message || sscanf(message, "%15[^,], %23[^\n]", color, name) < 1) {
+		clif_displaymessage(fd, "Usage: @namecolor <RRGGBB|off>[, character]");
+		return -1;
+	}
+	trim(color);
+	map_session_data* pl = *name ? map_nick2sd(trim(name), false) : sd;
+	if (pl == nullptr) {
+		clif_displaymessage(fd, msg_txt(sd, 3)); // Character not found.
+		return -1;
+	}
+	int32 rgb = -1;
+	if (strcmpi(color, "off")) {
+		char* end = nullptr;
+		rgb = (int32)strtol(color[0] == '#' ? color + 1 : color, &end, 16);
+		if (end == nullptr || *end != '\0' || rgb < 0 || rgb > 0xFFFFFF) {
+			clif_displaymessage(fd, "Colour must be RRGGBB, e.g. FFD700.");
+			return -1;
+		}
+	}
+	og_map_set_namecolor(pl, rgb);
+	clif_displaymessage(fd, rgb >= 0 ? "Name colour set." : "Name colour removed.");
+	return 0;
+}
+
+/// OdinGuard: ban the machine (hardware id) of an online character. @ogban <name>[, reason]
+ACMD_FUNC(ogban)
+{
+	char name[NAME_LENGTH], reason[128] = "";
+	nullpo_retr(-1, sd);
+	if (!message || !*message || sscanf(message, "%23[^,],%127[^\n]", name, reason) < 1) {
+		clif_displaymessage(fd, "Usage: @ogban <character name>[, reason]");
+		return -1;
+	}
+	trim(name);
+	trim(reason);
+	map_session_data* pl = map_nick2sd(name, false);
+	if (pl == nullptr) {
+		clif_displaymessage(fd, msg_txt(sd, 3)); // Character not found.
+		return -1;
+	}
+	if (pc_get_group_level(pl) >= pc_get_group_level(sd)) {
+		clif_displaymessage(fd, msg_txt(sd, 81)); // Your GM level don't authorise you to do this action on this player.
+		return -1;
+	}
+	if (!og_map_ban(pl, sd->status.name, *reason ? reason : "GM ban")) {
+		clif_displaymessage(fd, "This character has no OdinGuard session; use @ban for the account.");
+		return -1;
+	}
+	clif_displaymessage(fd, "Machine banned and character kicked.");
+	return 0;
+}
+
+/// OdinGuard: lift the machine bans of all machines an account used. @ogunban <account id>
+ACMD_FUNC(ogunban)
+{
+	uint32 account_id = 0;
+	nullpo_retr(-1, sd);
+	if (!message || sscanf(message, "%u", &account_id) != 1 || account_id == 0) {
+		clif_displaymessage(fd, "Usage: @ogunban <account id>");
+		return -1;
+	}
+	char out[CHAT_SIZE_MAX];
+	safesnprintf(out, sizeof(out), "%d machine ban(s) lifted.", og_map_unban_account(account_id));
+	clif_displaymessage(fd, out);
+	return 0;
+}
+
+/// OdinGuard: open flags of a character / account id, or the most flagged accounts. @ogflags [name|account id]
+ACMD_FUNC(ogflags)
+{
+	nullpo_retr(-1, sd);
+	uint32 account_id = 0;
+	if (message && *message) {
+		map_session_data* pl = map_nick2sd(message, false);
+		account_id = pl != nullptr ? pl->status.account_id : (uint32)strtoul(message, nullptr, 10);
+		if (account_id == 0) {
+			clif_displaymessage(fd, msg_txt(sd, 3)); // Character not found.
+			return -1;
+		}
+	}
+	std::vector<std::string> lines;
+	og_map_flags_text(account_id, lines);
+	if (lines.empty())
+		clif_displaymessage(fd, "No flags.");
+	for (const std::string& l : lines)
+		clif_displaymessage(fd, l.c_str());
+	return 0;
+}
+
+/// OdinGuard: runs the ban wave now. @ogbanwave [dry]
+ACMD_FUNC(ogbanwave)
+{
+	nullpo_retr(-1, sd);
+	bool dry = message && !strcmpi(message, "dry");
+	std::vector<std::string> lines;
+	int32 n = og_map_banwave(dry, &lines);
+	for (const std::string& l : lines)
+		clif_displaymessage(fd, l.c_str());
+	char out[CHAT_SIZE_MAX];
+	safesnprintf(out, sizeof(out), dry ? "%d account(s) would be banned." : "%d account(s) banned.", n);
+	clif_displaymessage(fd, out);
+	return 0;
+}
+
+/// OdinGuard status of a character (default: yourself). @oginfo [name]
+ACMD_FUNC(oginfo)
+{
+	nullpo_retr(-1, sd);
+	map_session_data* pl = sd;
+	if (message && *message && (pl = map_nick2sd(message, false)) == nullptr) {
+		clif_displaymessage(fd, msg_txt(sd, 3)); // Character not found.
+		return -1;
+	}
+	char out[CHAT_SIZE_MAX];
+	og_map_info(pl, out, sizeof(out));
+	clif_displaymessage(fd, out);
+	return 0;
+}

+// OdinGuard on the map-server. See og_map.hpp.
+
+#include "og_map.hpp"
+
+#include <algorithm>
+#include <string>
+
+#include <common/odinguard.hpp>
+#include <common/showmsg.hpp>
+#include <common/socket.hpp>
+#include <common/sql.hpp>
+#include <common/strlib.hpp>
+#include <common/utilities.hpp>
+
+#include <common/og_proto.h>
+
+#include "battle.hpp"
+#include "clif.hpp"
+#include "itemdb.hpp"
+#include "map.hpp"
+#include "pc.hpp"
+#include "pc_groups.hpp"
+#include "script.hpp"
+#include "unit.hpp"

+// character registry keys
+#define OG_REG_FLAGS "og_flags"         // bit 1: lite ground skills, bit 3: only SG/LoV/MS (bit 0 was "hide auras", now src/map/aura.cpp)
+#define OG_REG_LGP_STYLE "og_lgp_style" // 0 = square, 1 = circle, 2..14 = colour set
+#define OG_REG_NAMECOLOR "og_namecolor" // 0x1RRGGBB (bit 24 marks "set")
+#define OG_FLAG_LGP 2
+#define OG_FLAG_LGP_AOES 8
+
+static std::string og_esc(const std::string& s) {
+	std::string out(s.size() * 2 + 1, '\0');
+	out.resize(Sql_EscapeStringLen(mmysql_handle, &out[0], s.c_str(), s.size()));
+	return out;
+}
+
+static map_session_data* og_sd(int32 fd) {
+	if (!session_isValid(fd) || session[fd]->session_data == nullptr)
+		return nullptr;
+	map_session_data* sd = static_cast<map_session_data*>(session[fd]->session_data);
+	return sd->state.active ? sd : nullptr;
+}
+
+static void og_insert_ban(const std::string& uid, const char* by, const char* reason) {
+	std::string q = "INSERT INTO `og_ban` (`unique_id`,`reason`,`banned_by`) VALUES ('" + uid + "','" + og_esc(reason) + "','" + og_esc(by) + "')";
+	if (SQL_ERROR == Sql_QueryStr(mmysql_handle, q.c_str()))
+		Sql_ShowDebug(mmysql_handle);
+}
+
+static void og_map_event(int32 fd, const char* type, const char* detail, e_og_action action, int32 score) {
+	const s_og_info* info = og_info(fd);
+	map_session_data* sd = og_sd(fd);
+	std::string uid = info ? info->unique_id : std::string();
+
+	std::string q = "INSERT INTO `og_event` (`unique_id`,`account_id`,`char_name`,`type`,`detail`,`action`) VALUES ('" +
+		uid + "'," + std::to_string(sd ? sd->status.account_id : 0) + ",'" +
+		og_esc(sd ? sd->status.name : "") + "','" + og_esc(std::string(type).substr(0, 64)) + "','" +
+		og_esc(std::string(detail).substr(0, 255)) + "','" + og_action_name(action) + "')";
+	if (SQL_ERROR == Sql_QueryStr(mmysql_handle, q.c_str()))
+		Sql_ShowDebug(mmysql_handle);
+
+	switch (action) {
+	case OG_ACTION_FLAG:
+	case OG_ACTION_FLAGBAN:
+		// flag now, act later: the player cannot tell which check fired (ban-system module)
+		og_map_flag(sd, uid.c_str(), type, score, action == OG_ACTION_FLAGBAN, detail);
+		break;
+	case OG_ACTION_BAN:
+		if (!uid.empty())
+			og_insert_ban(uid, "OdinGuard", type);
+		[[fallthrough]];
+	case OG_ACTION_KICK:
+		if (sd != nullptr)
+			clif_authfail_fd(fd, 15); // "You have been forced to disconnect by the GM Team"
+		else
+			set_eof(fd);
+		break;
+	default:
+		break;
+	}
+}
+
+static void og_map_text(int32 fd, const char* text) {
+	if (og_sd(fd) != nullptr)
+		clif_displaymessage(fd, text);
+}
+
+static void og_map_pong(int32 fd, int64 rtt) {
+	if (og_sd(fd) == nullptr)
+		return;
+	char msg[64];
+	safesnprintf(msg, sizeof(msg), "Ping: %d ms", (int32)rtt);
+	clif_displaymessage(fd, msg);
+}
+
+void og_map_init() {
+	if (!og_enabled())
+		return;
+	for (const char* q : og_sql_ddl())
+		if (SQL_ERROR == Sql_QueryStr(mmysql_handle, q))
+			Sql_ShowDebug(mmysql_handle);
+	og_set_handlers(og_map_event, og_map_text, og_map_pong);
+	og_map_guard_init();
+}

+bool og_map_chat_command(map_session_data* sd, const char* message) {
+	// newer clients put a colour code in front of the text ("|00")
+	if (message[0] == '|' && ISXDIGIT(message[1]) && ISXDIGIT(message[2]))
+		message += 3;
+	if (message[0] != '!')
+		return false;
+	char cmd[32];
+	safestrncpy(cmd, message + 1, sizeof(cmd));
+	char* arg = strchr(cmd, ' ');
+	if (arg != nullptr)
+		*arg++ = '\0';
+	// client commands can be renamed in the profile (og_cmdname_<id>)
+	const char* id = !strcmpi(cmd, og_map_command_name("ping")) ? "ping" : !strcmpi(cmd, og_map_command_name("vsync")) ? "vsync"
+		: !strcmpi(cmd, og_map_command_name("crash")) ? "crash" : nullptr;
+	if (id == nullptr || !og_module_on("og_client_commands", true))
+		return false;
+	if (!og_map_command_allowed(sd, id, !strcmp(id, "crash") ? 60000 : !strcmp(id, "ping") ? 2000 : 1000))
+		return true;
+	safestrncpy(cmd, id, sizeof(cmd));
+	if (!og_session_active(sd->fd)) {
+		clif_displaymessage(sd->fd, "OdinGuard is not active on this client.");
+		return true;
+	}
+	if (!strcmpi(cmd, "ping"))
+		og_send_ping(sd->fd);
+	else if (!strcmpi(cmd, "crash"))
+		og_send_command(sd->fd, "crash");
+	else if (arg != nullptr && (!strcmpi(arg, "on") || !strcmpi(arg, "off")))
+		og_send_command(sd->fd, !strcmpi(arg, "on") ? "vsync on" : "vsync off");
+	else
+		og_send_command(sd->fd, "vsync");
+	return true;
+}
+
+bool og_map_machine_limit(map_session_data* sd) {
+	int32 limit = og_max_per_machine();
+	const s_og_info* info = og_info(sd->fd);
+	if (limit <= 0 || info == nullptr || pc_get_group_level(sd) > 0)
+		return true;
+	struct s_count { const std::string* uid; uint32 account_id; int32 count; } c = { &info->unique_id, sd->status.account_id, 0 };
+	map_foreachpc([](map_session_data* other, va_list ap) -> int32 {
+		auto* c = va_arg(ap, s_count*);
+		if (other->fd <= 0 || other->state.autotrade || !other->state.active || other->status.account_id == c->account_id)
+			return 0;
+		const s_og_info* oi = og_info(other->fd);
+		if (oi != nullptr && oi->unique_id == *c->uid)
+			c->count++;
+		return 0;
+	}, &c);
+	if (c.count < limit)
+		return true;
+	ShowWarning("OdinGuard: %s (account %u) rejected, %d characters already online from the same machine (og_max_per_machine %d).\n",
+		sd->status.name, sd->status.account_id, c.count, limit);
+	return false;
+}
+
+bool og_map_ban(map_session_data* target, const char* by, const char* reason) {
+	const s_og_info* info = og_info(target->fd);
+	if (info == nullptr)
+		return false;
+	og_insert_ban(info->unique_id, by, reason);
+	og_map_event(target->fd, "gm-ban", reason, OG_ACTION_LOG, 0);
+	clif_authfail_fd(target->fd, 15);
+	return true;
+}
+
+int32 og_map_unban_account(uint32 account_id) {
+	std::string q = "DELETE FROM `og_ban` WHERE `unique_id` IN (SELECT `unique_id` FROM `og_client` WHERE `account_id` = " + std::to_string(account_id) + ")";
+	if (SQL_ERROR == Sql_QueryStr(mmysql_handle, q.c_str())) {
+		Sql_ShowDebug(mmysql_handle);
+		return 0;
+	}
+	return (int32)Sql_NumRowsAffected(mmysql_handle);
+}
+
+void og_map_info(map_session_data* target, char* out, size_t size) {
+	const s_og_info* info = og_info(target->fd);
+	if (info == nullptr) {
+		safesnprintf(out, size, "%s: no OdinGuard session.", target->status.name);
+		return;
+	}
+	safesnprintf(out, size, "%s: protocol v%d, build '%s', machine %.16s, exe %.16s, guard %.16s, flags %d, signatures v%u", target->status.name,
+		info->version, info->build.c_str(), info->unique_id.c_str(), info->exe_code.c_str(), info->guard_code.c_str(), info->flags, og_sigpack_version());
+}

+// ---------------------------------------------------------------- display features

+static int32 og_flags(const map_session_data* sd) {
+	return (int32)pc_readglobalreg(const_cast<map_session_data*>(sd), add_str(OG_REG_FLAGS));
+}
+
+static bool og_lgp_in_aoes(uint16 skill_id) {
+	// @aoes: only the three big area skills (og_lgp_aoes: comma separated skill ids)
+	char list[128];
+	safestrncpy(list, og_setting("og_lgp_aoes", "89,83,85"), sizeof(list));
+	for (char* t = strtok(list, ", "); t != nullptr; t = strtok(nullptr, ", "))
+		if (atoi(t) == skill_id) return true;
+	return false;
+}
+
+uint16 og_map_lgp_unit(const map_session_data* viewer, uint16 skill_id) {
+	if (viewer == nullptr || !og_module_on("og_lgp_enable", true))
+		return 0;
+	int32 flags = og_flags(viewer);
+	if (!(flags & OG_FLAG_LGP) || ((flags & OG_FLAG_LGP_AOES) && !og_lgp_in_aoes(skill_id)))
+		return 0;
+	int32 style = (int32)pc_readglobalreg(const_cast<map_session_data*>(viewer), add_str(OG_REG_LGP_STYLE));
+	char name[16];
+	if (style == 1) safestrncpy(name, "circle", sizeof(name));
+	else safesnprintf(name, sizeof(name), "set%d", style);
+	uint16 unit = style > 0 ? og_lgp_unit_style(name, skill_id) : 0;
+	return unit ? unit : og_lgp_unit(skill_id);
+}
+
+struct s_og_area { const block_list* src; const void* buf; int32 len; bool (*keep)(map_session_data*, const block_list&, void*); void* ctx; };
+
+void og_map_send_area(const block_list& src, const void* buf, int32 len, bool (*keep)(map_session_data* viewer, const block_list& src, void* ctx), void* ctx) {
+	s_og_area a = { &src, buf, len, keep, ctx };
+	map_foreachinallrange([](block_list* bl, va_list ap) -> int32 {
+		s_og_area* a = va_arg(ap, s_og_area*);
+		map_session_data* sd = reinterpret_cast<map_session_data*>(bl);
+		if (sd->fd <= 0 || !session_isActive(sd->fd) || (a->keep != nullptr && !a->keep(sd, *a->src, a->ctx)))
+			return 0;
+		clif_send(a->buf, a->len, bl, SELF);
+		return 1;
+	}, const_cast<block_list*>(&src), AREA_SIZE, BL_PC, &a);
+}
+
+/// @lgp / @square / @circle / @aoes. kind: 0 lgp, 1 square, 2 circle, 3 aoes; arg: "", "on", "off" or a set number
+void og_map_lgp_command(map_session_data* sd, int32 kind, const char* arg) {
+	int32 flags = og_flags(sd), style = (int32)pc_readglobalreg(sd, add_str(OG_REG_LGP_STYLE));
+	bool on = !(flags & OG_FLAG_LGP);
+	if (!strcmpi(arg, "on")) on = true;
+	else if (!strcmpi(arg, "off")) on = false;
+	else if (kind == 1 && atoi(arg) > 0) {
+		int32 set = atoi(arg);
+		if (set > 14) { clif_displaymessage(sd->fd, "Colour sets: 1-14."); return; }
+		style = set == 1 ? 0 : set;
+		on = true;
+	} else if (kind != 0 && *arg == '\0')
+		on = true;
+	if (kind == 1 && atoi(arg) <= 0) style = 0;
+	if (kind == 2) style = 1;
+	if (kind == 3) flags = on ? (flags | OG_FLAG_LGP_AOES) : (flags & ~OG_FLAG_LGP_AOES);
+	else if (kind != 0) flags &= ~OG_FLAG_LGP_AOES;
+	flags = on ? (flags | OG_FLAG_LGP) : (flags & ~(OG_FLAG_LGP | OG_FLAG_LGP_AOES));
+	pc_setglobalreg(sd, add_str(OG_REG_FLAGS), flags);
+	pc_setglobalreg(sd, add_str(OG_REG_LGP_STYLE), style);
+	char msg[CHAT_SIZE_MAX];
+	if (!on)
+		safesnprintf(msg, sizeof(msg), "Lite ground skills off: normal skill effects.");
+	else
+		safesnprintf(msg, sizeof(msg), "Lite ground skills on (%s%s): %s are shown as flat cell tiles.",
+			style == 1 ? "circle" : style > 1 ? "colour set" : "square", style > 1 ? std::to_string(style).c_str() : "",
+			(flags & OG_FLAG_LGP_AOES) ? "Storm Gust, Lord of Vermilion and Meteor Storm" : "area skills");
+	clif_displaymessage(sd->fd, msg);
+}
+
+typedef std::vector<std::pair<uint32, std::string>> og_color_list;
+
+// colour message: kind, op, entries (colour, text)
+static std::vector<uint8> og_colors_msg(uint8 kind, uint8 op, const std::vector<std::pair<uint32, std::string>>& entries) {
+	std::vector<uint8> m = { OG_S_COLORS, kind, op, 0, 0 };
+	uint16 n = 0;
+	for (const auto& e : entries) {
+		size_t len = std::min(e.second.size(), (size_t)63);
+		if (m.size() + 4 + len > 60000)
+			break;
+		m.push_back((uint8)(e.first >> 16));
+		m.push_back((uint8)(e.first >> 8));
+		m.push_back((uint8)e.first);
+		m.push_back((uint8)len);
+		m.insert(m.end(), e.second.begin(), e.second.begin() + len);
+		n++;
+	}
+	m[3] = (uint8)n;
+	m[4] = (uint8)(n >> 8);
+	return m;
+}
+
+/// name colour of a character: own setting first, then the group colour; -1 = none
+static int32 og_namecolor(map_session_data* sd) {
+	int32 reg = (int32)pc_readglobalreg(sd, add_str(OG_REG_NAMECOLOR));
+	if (reg & 0x1000000)
+		return reg & 0xFFFFFF;
+	for (const auto& g : og_group_namecolors())
+		if (g.first == sd->group_id)
+			return (int32)g.second;
+	return -1;
+}
+
+static void og_broadcast(const std::vector<uint8>& msg) {
+	map_foreachpc([](map_session_data* other, va_list ap) -> int32 {
+		const std::vector<uint8>* m = va_arg(ap, const std::vector<uint8>*);
+		if (other->fd > 0 && og_session_active(other->fd))
+			og_send_control(other->fd, *m);
+		return 0;
+	}, &msg);
+}
+
+static void og_announce_name(map_session_data* sd, bool remove) {
+	int32 rgb = og_namecolor(sd);
+	if (rgb < 0 && !remove)
+		return;
+	og_broadcast(og_colors_msg(OG_COLOR_NAME, remove ? OG_COLOR_OP_REMOVE : OG_COLOR_OP_SET, { { (uint32)std::max(rgb, 0), sd->status.name } }));
+}
+
+void og_map_set_namecolor(map_session_data* sd, int32 rgb) {
+	og_announce_name(sd, true);
+	pc_setglobalreg(sd, add_str(OG_REG_NAMECOLOR), rgb < 0 ? 0 : (0x1000000 | (rgb & 0xFFFFFF)));
+	og_announce_name(sd, false);
+}
+
+void og_map_on_load(map_session_data* sd, bool first) {
+	if (!og_enabled())
+		return;
+	if (first) {
+		if (og_session_active(sd->fd)) {
+			// item colours (names from the item database) and the coloured names of everyone online
+			std::vector<std::pair<uint32, std::string>> items, names;
+			for (const auto& c : og_item_colors())
+				if (std::shared_ptr<item_data> id = item_db.find(c.first); id != nullptr)
+					items.emplace_back(c.second, id->name);
+			og_send_control(sd->fd, og_colors_msg(OG_COLOR_ITEM, OG_COLOR_OP_REPLACE, items));
+			map_foreachpc([](map_session_data* other, va_list ap) -> int32 {
+				auto* v = va_arg(ap, og_color_list*);
+				int32 rgb = og_namecolor(other);
+				if (rgb >= 0)
+					v->emplace_back((uint32)rgb, other->status.name);
+				return 0;
+			}, &names);
+			og_send_control(sd->fd, og_colors_msg(OG_COLOR_NAME, OG_COLOR_OP_REPLACE, names));
+		}
+		og_announce_name(sd, false);
+	}
+}
+
+void og_map_on_quit(map_session_data* sd) {
+	og_map_guard_quit(sd);
+	if (og_enabled() && og_namecolor(sd) >= 0)
+		og_announce_name(sd, true);
+}

+// OdinGuard Anti Cheat on the map-server: server-side protection modules that work for every client (also
+// without the guard): flags and delayed ban waves (ban-system), packet rate limit (rate-limit), behaviour
+// signatures (behaviour: no-delay attempts, autopot reaction time, macro timing), the honeypot unit
+// (ch-honeypot), the bot captcha (ch-captcha) and the command registry (enable, rate limit, rename).
+// These checks are the real security of OdinGuard: they do not trust anything the client says.
+
+#include "og_map.hpp"
+
+#include <algorithm>
+#include <cmath>
+#include <ctime>
+#include <string>
+#include <unordered_map>
+#include <vector>
+
+#include <common/odinguard.hpp>
+#include <common/showmsg.hpp>
+#include <common/socket.hpp>
+#include <common/sql.hpp>
+#include <common/strlib.hpp>
+#include <common/timer.hpp>
+
+#include "clif.hpp"
+#include "itemdb.hpp"
+#include "map.hpp"
+#include "pc.hpp"
+#include "pc_groups.hpp"

+#define OG_HONEYPOT_BASE 0x7A000000
+
+struct s_og_bh {
+	t_tick win_start = 0;
+	int32 packets = 0, over_seconds = 0;
+	bool rate_reported = false;
+	t_tick nd_start = 0;
+	int32 nd_count = 0;
+	bool nd_flagged = false;
+	bool hp_low = false;
+	t_tick hp_low_at = 0;
+	std::vector<int32> reactions;
+	bool ap_flagged = false;
+	t_tick last_action = 0;
+	std::vector<int32> intervals;
+	bool macro_flagged = false;
+	bool honeypot_flagged = false;
+	bool captcha_sent = false;
+	std::unordered_map<std::string, t_tick> cmd_last;
+};
+
+static std::unordered_map<int32, s_og_bh> og_bh; // by account id
+
+static s_og_bh& og_state_of(const map_session_data* sd) { return og_bh[sd->status.account_id]; }
+
+void og_map_guard_quit(map_session_data* sd) { og_bh.erase(sd->status.account_id); }
+
+static std::string og_esc(const std::string& s) {
+	std::string out(s.size() * 2 + 1, '\0');
+	out.resize(Sql_EscapeStringLen(mmysql_handle, &out[0], s.c_str(), s.size()));
+	return out;
+}
+
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------- flags and ban waves
+
+void og_map_flag(map_session_data* sd, const char* uid, const char* rule, int32 score, bool ban, const char* detail) {
+	std::string q = "INSERT INTO `og_flag` (`unique_id`,`account_id`,`char_name`,`rule`,`score`,`ban`,`detail`) VALUES ('" +
+		og_esc(uid ? uid : "") + "'," + std::to_string(sd ? sd->status.account_id : 0) + ",'" + og_esc(sd ? sd->status.name : "") + "','" +
+		og_esc(std::string(rule).substr(0, 64)) + "'," + std::to_string(score) + "," + (ban ? "1" : "0") + ",'" +
+		og_esc(std::string(detail).substr(0, 255)) + "')";
+	if (SQL_ERROR == Sql_QueryStr(mmysql_handle, q.c_str()))
+		Sql_ShowDebug(mmysql_handle);
+}
+
+/// bans every account whose open ban flags reach og_ban_score; @return number of accounts (dry: only listed)
+int32 og_map_banwave(bool dry, std::vector<std::string>* report) {
+	int32 limit = og_setting_int("og_ban_score", 100), n = 0;
+	if (og_log_only() && !dry) {
+		dry = true; // warn mode never bans
+		if (report != nullptr) report->push_back("warn mode (og_log_only): only listed, nobody banned");
+	}
+	std::string q = "SELECT `account_id`, MAX(`unique_id`), SUM(`score`), GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT `rule` SEPARATOR ',') FROM `og_flag`"
+		" WHERE `state` = 'open' AND `ban` = 1 GROUP BY `account_id` HAVING SUM(`score`) >= " + std::to_string(limit);
+	if (SQL_ERROR == Sql_QueryStr(mmysql_handle, q.c_str())) { Sql_ShowDebug(mmysql_handle); return 0; }
+	std::vector<std::tuple<uint32, std::string, int32, std::string>> hits;
+	while (SQL_SUCCESS == Sql_NextRow(mmysql_handle)) {
+		char *acc, *uid, *score, *rules;
+		Sql_GetData(mmysql_handle, 0, &acc, nullptr);
+		Sql_GetData(mmysql_handle, 1, &uid, nullptr);
+		Sql_GetData(mmysql_handle, 2, &score, nullptr);
+		Sql_GetData(mmysql_handle, 3, &rules, nullptr);
+		hits.emplace_back((uint32)strtoul(acc, nullptr, 10), uid ? uid : "", atoi(score), rules ? rules : "");
+	}
+	Sql_FreeResult(mmysql_handle);
+	for (const auto& h : hits) {
+		uint32 acc = std::get<0>(h);
+		const std::string& uid = std::get<1>(h);
+		if (report != nullptr)
+			report->push_back("account " + std::to_string(acc) + ": score " + std::to_string(std::get<2>(h)) + " (" + std::get<3>(h).substr(0, 80) + ")");
+		n++;
+		if (dry)
+			continue;
+		if (!uid.empty()) {
+			std::string b = "INSERT INTO `og_ban` (`unique_id`,`reason`,`banned_by`) VALUES ('" + og_esc(uid) + "','ban wave: " + og_esc(std::get<3>(h).substr(0, 200)) + "','OdinGuard')";
+			if (SQL_ERROR == Sql_QueryStr(mmysql_handle, b.c_str())) Sql_ShowDebug(mmysql_handle);
+		}
+		std::string u = "UPDATE `og_flag` SET `state` = 'banned' WHERE `state` = 'open' AND `account_id` = " + std::to_string(acc);
+		if (SQL_ERROR == Sql_QueryStr(mmysql_handle, u.c_str())) Sql_ShowDebug(mmysql_handle);
+		if (map_session_data* sd = map_id2sd(acc); sd != nullptr)
+			clif_authfail_fd(sd->fd, 15);
+	}
+	if (!dry && n > 0)
+		ShowStatus("OdinGuard: ban wave banned %d account(s).\n", n);
+	return n;
+}
+
+static TIMER_FUNC(og_banwave_timer) {
+	static int32 last_day = -1;
+	int32 hour = og_setting_int("og_banwave_hour", 4);
+	if (hour < 0 || !og_module_on("og_ban_system", true) || og_log_only())
+		return 0;
+	time_t t = time(nullptr);
+	struct tm* lt = localtime(&t);
+	if (lt->tm_hour == hour && lt->tm_yday != last_day) {
+		last_day = lt->tm_yday;
+		og_map_banwave(false, nullptr);
+	}
+	return 0;
+}
+
+void og_map_flags_text(uint32 account_id, std::vector<std::string>& out) {
+	std::string q = account_id
+		? "SELECT `time`,`rule`,`score`,`ban`,`state`,`detail` FROM `og_flag` WHERE `account_id` = " + std::to_string(account_id) + " ORDER BY `id` DESC LIMIT 15"
+		: "SELECT MAX(`time`), CONCAT('account ', `account_id`), SUM(`score`), MAX(`ban`), 'open', GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT `rule` SEPARATOR ',') FROM `og_flag` WHERE `state` = 'open' GROUP BY `account_id` ORDER BY SUM(`score`) DESC LIMIT 10";
+	if (SQL_ERROR == Sql_QueryStr(mmysql_handle, q.c_str())) { Sql_ShowDebug(mmysql_handle); return; }
+	while (SQL_SUCCESS == Sql_NextRow(mmysql_handle)) {
+		char* d[6];
+		for (int32 i = 0; i < 6; i++) Sql_GetData(mmysql_handle, i, &d[i], nullptr);
+		out.push_back(std::string(d[0] ? d[0] : "") + " " + (d[1] ? d[1] : "") + " score " + (d[2] ? d[2] : "0") +
+			(d[3] && atoi(d[3]) ? " ban" : "") + " [" + (d[4] ? d[4] : "") + "] " + std::string(d[5] ? d[5] : "").substr(0, 60));
+	}
+	Sql_FreeResult(mmysql_handle);
+}
+
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------- rate limit
+
+void og_map_packet(int32 fd, map_session_data* sd, uint16 cmd) {
+	(void)cmd;
+	if (sd == nullptr || !og_module_on("og_rate_limit", false))
+		return;
+	s_og_bh& b = og_state_of(sd);
+	t_tick now = gettick();
+	if (DIFF_TICK(now, b.win_start) >= 1000) {
+		if (b.packets > og_setting_int("og_rate_pps", 150)) b.over_seconds++;
+		else b.over_seconds = 0;
+		b.win_start = now;
+		b.packets = 0;
+	}
+	b.packets++;
+	if (b.over_seconds >= 3 && !b.rate_reported) {
+		b.rate_reported = true;
+		char detail[96];
+		safesnprintf(detail, sizeof(detail), "more than %d packets/s for 3 s", og_setting_int("og_rate_pps", 150));
+		og_report(fd, "rate-limit", detail, og_setting_action("og_rate_action", OG_ACTION_KICK), 30);
+	}
+}
+
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------- behaviour
+
+static void og_bh_flag(map_session_data* sd, const char* rule, const char* detail, int32 score) {
+	og_report(sd->fd, rule, detail, og_setting_action("og_bh_action", OG_ACTION_FLAGBAN), score);
+	// a captcha only outside of WoE/BG/PvP fights, once per session
+	s_og_bh& b = og_state_of(sd);
+	if (og_module_on("og_ch_captcha", false) && !b.captcha_sent && sd->state.active) {
+		struct map_data* m = map_getmapdata(sd->m);
+		if (m != nullptr && !map_flag_gvg2(sd->m) && !m->getMapFlag(MF_BATTLEGROUND) && !m->getMapFlag(MF_PVP)) {
+			b.captcha_sent = true;
+			pc_macro_reporter_process(*sd, 0);
+		}
+	}
+}
+
+void og_map_skill_refused(map_session_data* sd) {
+	if (!og_module_on("og_behaviour", false))
+		return;
+	s_og_bh& b = og_state_of(sd);
+	t_tick now = gettick();
+	if (DIFF_TICK(now, b.nd_start) > 60000) { b.nd_start = now; b.nd_count = 0; }
+	if (++b.nd_count > og_setting_int("og_bh_nodelay", 120) && !b.nd_flagged) {
+		b.nd_flagged = true;
+		char detail[96];
+		safesnprintf(detail, sizeof(detail), "%d skill requests inside the delay within 60 s (modified client or macro)", b.nd_count);
+		og_bh_flag(sd, "bh:nodelay", detail, 40);
+	}
+}
+
+static void og_bh_action(map_session_data* sd, s_og_bh& b) {
+	t_tick now = gettick();
+	if (b.last_action != 0) {
+		int32 iv = (int32)DIFF_TICK(now, b.last_action);
+		if (iv > 30000) b.intervals.clear();
+		else b.intervals.push_back(iv);
+	}
+	b.last_action = now;
+	if (b.intervals.size() > 40) b.intervals.erase(b.intervals.begin());
+	if (b.intervals.size() == 40 && !b.macro_flagged) {
+		double mean = 0, var = 0;
+		for (int32 v : b.intervals) mean += v;
+		mean /= 40;
+		for (int32 v : b.intervals) var += (v - mean) * (v - mean);
+		double sd_ms = std::sqrt(var / 40);
+		if (mean >= 40 && sd_ms < og_setting_int("og_bh_macro_jitter", 4)) {
+			b.macro_flagged = true;
+			char detail[96];
+			safesnprintf(detail, sizeof(detail), "40 actions every %.0f ms with %.1f ms jitter", mean, sd_ms);
+			og_bh_flag(sd, "bh:macro", detail, 30);
+		}
+	}
+}
+
+void og_map_item_used(map_session_data* sd, int32 index) {
+	if (!og_module_on("og_behaviour", false) || index < 0 || index >= MAX_INVENTORY || sd->inventory_data[index] == nullptr)
+		return;
+	s_og_bh& b = og_state_of(sd);
+	og_bh_action(sd, b);
+	if (sd->inventory_data[index]->type != IT_HEALING || !b.hp_low)
+		return;
+	int32 reaction = (int32)DIFF_TICK(gettick(), b.hp_low_at);
+	b.hp_low = false;
+	if (reaction > 5000)
+		return;
+	b.reactions.push_back(reaction);
+	if (b.reactions.size() > 20) b.reactions.erase(b.reactions.begin());
+	if (b.reactions.size() == 20 && !b.ap_flagged) {
+		std::vector<int32> s = b.reactions;
+		std::sort(s.begin(), s.end());
+		int32 median = s[10];
+		if (median < og_setting_int("og_bh_autopot_ms", 90) && s[17] < og_setting_int("og_bh_autopot_ms", 90) * 2) {
+			b.ap_flagged = true;
+			char detail[96];
+			safesnprintf(detail, sizeof(detail), "healing item %d ms after HP < 50%% (median of 20, human ~250 ms)", median);
+			og_bh_flag(sd, "bh:autopot", detail, 40);
+		}
+	}
+}
+
+void og_map_skill_used(map_session_data* sd) {
+	if (og_module_on("og_behaviour", false))
+		og_bh_action(sd, og_state_of(sd));
+}
+
+void og_map_hp_update(map_session_data* sd) {
+	if (!og_module_on("og_behaviour", false) || sd->battle_status.max_hp == 0)
+		return;
+	s_og_bh& b = og_state_of(sd);
+	bool low = sd->battle_status.hp * 2 < sd->battle_status.max_hp && sd->battle_status.hp > 0;
+	if (low && !b.hp_low) { b.hp_low = true; b.hp_low_at = gettick(); }
+	else if (!low) b.hp_low = false;
+}
+
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------- honeypot
+
+static uint32 og_honeypot_id(const map_session_data* sd) { return OG_HONEYPOT_BASE | (sd->status.account_id & 0xFFFFFF); }
+
+void og_map_honeypot_spawn(map_session_data* sd) {
+	// an invisible monster at the player's position: the game client never draws or targets it, bots that read
+	// the unit list do
+	if (og_module_on("og_ch_honeypot", false) && pc_get_group_level(sd) == 0)
+		clif_og_honeypot(*sd, og_honeypot_id(sd));
+}
+
+bool og_map_honeypot_hit(map_session_data* sd, int32 target_id) {
+	if (target_id != (int32)og_honeypot_id(sd) || !og_module_on("og_ch_honeypot", false))
+		return false;
+	s_og_bh& b = og_state_of(sd);
+	if (!b.honeypot_flagged) {
+		b.honeypot_flagged = true;
+		og_report(sd->fd, "challenge:honeypot", "attacked an invisible decoy unit (bot)", og_setting_action("og_ch_honeypot_action", OG_ACTION_FLAGBAN), 80);
+	}
+	return true;
+}
+
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------- command registry
+
+/// og_cmd_<id>: on/off, og_cmdrate_<id>: ms, og_cmdgroup_<id>: lowest group level (conf/odinguard_commands.conf)
+bool og_map_command_allowed(map_session_data* sd, const char* id, int32 def_rate_ms) {
+	char key[64];
+	safesnprintf(key, sizeof(key), "og_cmd_%s", id);
+	if (!config_switch(og_setting(key, "yes"))) {
+		clif_displaymessage(sd->fd, "This command is disabled on this server.");
+		return false;
+	}
+	safesnprintf(key, sizeof(key), "og_cmdgroup_%s", id);
+	if (pc_get_group_level(sd) < og_setting_int(key, 0)) {
+		clif_displaymessage(sd->fd, "You are not allowed to use this command.");
+		return false;
+	}
+	safesnprintf(key, sizeof(key), "og_cmdrate_%s", id);
+	int32 rate = og_setting_int(key, def_rate_ms);
+	if (rate > 0 && pc_get_group_level(sd) == 0) {
+		s_og_bh& b = og_state_of(sd);
+		t_tick now = gettick();
+		auto it = b.cmd_last.find(id);
+		if (it != b.cmd_last.end() && DIFF_TICK(now, it->second) < rate) {
+			clif_displaymessage(sd->fd, "Please wait a moment before using this command again.");
+			return false;
+		}
+		b.cmd_last[id] = now;
+	}
+	return true;
+}
+
+/// client command name after renaming (og_cmdname_<id>), e.g. "ping"
+const char* og_map_command_name(const char* id) {
+	char key[64];
+	safesnprintf(key, sizeof(key), "og_cmdname_%s", id);
+	return og_setting(key, id);
+}
+
+void og_map_guard_init() {
+	add_timer_func_list(og_banwave_timer, "og_banwave_timer");
+	add_timer_interval(gettick() + 60000, og_banwave_timer, 0, 0, 60000);
+}
