`server/src/map/og_map.cpp`:

```cpp
// OdinGuard on the map-server. See og_map.hpp.

#include "og_map.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <string>

#include <common/odinguard.hpp>
#include <common/showmsg.hpp>
#include <common/socket.hpp>
#include <common/sql.hpp>
#include <common/strlib.hpp>
#include <common/utilities.hpp>

#include <common/og_proto.h>

#include "battle.hpp"
#include "clif.hpp"
#include "itemdb.hpp"
#include "map.hpp"
#include "pc.hpp"
#include "pc_groups.hpp"
#include "script.hpp"
#include "unit.hpp"

// character registry keys
#define OG_REG_FLAGS "og_flags"         // bit 1: lite ground skills, bit 3: only SG/LoV/MS (bit 0 was "hide auras", now src/map/aura.cpp)
#define OG_REG_LGP_STYLE "og_lgp_style" // 0 = square, 1 = circle, 2..14 = colour set
#define OG_REG_NAMECOLOR "og_namecolor" // 0x1RRGGBB (bit 24 marks "set")
#define OG_FLAG_LGP 2
#define OG_FLAG_LGP_AOES 8

static std::string og_esc(const std::string& s) {
	std::string out(s.size() * 2 + 1, '\0');
	out.resize(Sql_EscapeStringLen(mmysql_handle, &out[0], s.c_str(), s.size()));
	return out;
}

static map_session_data* og_sd(int32 fd) {
	if (!session_isValid(fd) || session[fd]->session_data == nullptr)
		return nullptr;
	map_session_data* sd = static_cast<map_session_data*>(session[fd]->session_data);
	return sd->state.active ? sd : nullptr;
}

static void og_insert_ban(const std::string& uid, const char* by, const char* reason) {
	std::string q = "INSERT INTO `og_ban` (`unique_id`,`reason`,`banned_by`) VALUES ('" + uid + "','" + og_esc(reason) + "','" + og_esc(by) + "')";
	if (SQL_ERROR == Sql_QueryStr(mmysql_handle, q.c_str()))
		Sql_ShowDebug(mmysql_handle);
}

static void og_map_event(int32 fd, const char* type, const char* detail, e_og_action action, int32 score) {
	const s_og_info* info = og_info(fd);
	map_session_data* sd = og_sd(fd);
	std::string uid = info ? info->unique_id : std::string();

	std::string q = "INSERT INTO `og_event` (`unique_id`,`account_id`,`char_name`,`type`,`detail`,`action`) VALUES ('" +
		uid + "'," + std::to_string(sd ? sd->status.account_id : 0) + ",'" +
		og_esc(sd ? sd->status.name : "") + "','" + og_esc(std::string(type).substr(0, 64)) + "','" +
		og_esc(std::string(detail).substr(0, 255)) + "','" + og_action_name(action) + "')";
	if (SQL_ERROR == Sql_QueryStr(mmysql_handle, q.c_str()))
		Sql_ShowDebug(mmysql_handle);

	switch (action) {
	case OG_ACTION_FLAG:
	case OG_ACTION_FLAGBAN:
		// flag now, act later: the player cannot tell which check fired (ban-system module)
		og_map_flag(sd, uid.c_str(), type, score, action == OG_ACTION_FLAGBAN, detail);
		break;
	case OG_ACTION_BAN:
		if (!uid.empty())
			og_insert_ban(uid, "OdinGuard", type);
		[[fallthrough]];
	case OG_ACTION_KICK:
		if (sd != nullptr)
			clif_authfail_fd(fd, 15); // "You have been forced to disconnect by the GM Team"
		else
			set_eof(fd);
		break;
	default:
		break;
	}
}

static void og_map_text(int32 fd, const char* text) {
	if (og_sd(fd) != nullptr)
		clif_displaymessage(fd, text);
}

static void og_map_pong(int32 fd, int64 rtt) {
	if (og_sd(fd) == nullptr)
		return;
	char msg[64];
	safesnprintf(msg, sizeof(msg), "Ping: %d ms", (int32)rtt);
	clif_displaymessage(fd, msg);
}

void og_map_init() {
	if (!og_enabled())
		return;
	for (const char* q : og_sql_ddl())
		if (SQL_ERROR == Sql_QueryStr(mmysql_handle, q))
			Sql_ShowDebug(mmysql_handle);
	og_set_handlers(og_map_event, og_map_text, og_map_pong);
	og_map_guard_init();
}

bool og_map_chat_command(map_session_data* sd, const char* message) {
	// newer clients put a colour code in front of the text ("|00")
	if (message[0] == '|' && ISXDIGIT(message[1]) && ISXDIGIT(message[2]))
		message += 3;
	if (message[0] != '!')
		return false;
	char cmd[32];
	safestrncpy(cmd, message + 1, sizeof(cmd));
	char* arg = strchr(cmd, ' ');
	if (arg != nullptr)
		*arg++ = '\0';
	// client commands can be renamed in the profile (og_cmdname_<id>)
	const char* id = !strcmpi(cmd, og_map_command_name("ping")) ? "ping" : !strcmpi(cmd, og_map_command_name("vsync")) ? "vsync"
		: !strcmpi(cmd, og_map_command_name("crash")) ? "crash" : nullptr;
	if (id == nullptr || !og_module_on("og_client_commands", true))
		return false;
	if (!og_map_command_allowed(sd, id, !strcmp(id, "crash") ? 60000 : !strcmp(id, "ping") ? 2000 : 1000))
		return true;
	safestrncpy(cmd, id, sizeof(cmd));
	if (!og_session_active(sd->fd)) {
		clif_displaymessage(sd->fd, "OdinGuard is not active on this client.");
		return true;
	}
	if (!strcmpi(cmd, "ping"))
		og_send_ping(sd->fd);
	else if (!strcmpi(cmd, "crash"))
		og_send_command(sd->fd, "crash");
	else if (arg != nullptr && (!strcmpi(arg, "on") || !strcmpi(arg, "off")))
		og_send_command(sd->fd, !strcmpi(arg, "on") ? "vsync on" : "vsync off");
	else
		og_send_command(sd->fd, "vsync");
	return true;
}

bool og_map_machine_limit(map_session_data* sd) {
	int32 limit = og_max_per_machine();
	const s_og_info* info = og_info(sd->fd);
	if (limit <= 0 || info == nullptr || pc_get_group_level(sd) > 0)
		return true;
	struct s_count { const std::string* uid; uint32 account_id; int32 count; } c = { &info->unique_id, sd->status.account_id, 0 };
	map_foreachpc([](map_session_data* other, va_list ap) -> int32 {
		auto* c = va_arg(ap, s_count*);
		if (other->fd <= 0 || other->state.autotrade || !other->state.active || other->status.account_id == c->account_id)
			return 0;
		const s_og_info* oi = og_info(other->fd);
		if (oi != nullptr && oi->unique_id == *c->uid)
			c->count++;
		return 0;
	}, &c);
	if (c.count < limit)
		return true;
	ShowWarning("OdinGuard: %s (account %u) rejected, %d characters already online from the same machine (og_max_per_machine %d).\n",
		sd->status.name, sd->status.account_id, c.count, limit);
	return false;
}

bool og_map_ban(map_session_data* target, const char* by, const char* reason) {
	const s_og_info* info = og_info(target->fd);
	if (info == nullptr)
		return false;
	og_insert_ban(info->unique_id, by, reason);
	og_map_event(target->fd, "gm-ban", reason, OG_ACTION_LOG, 0);
	clif_authfail_fd(target->fd, 15);
	return true;
}

int32 og_map_unban_account(uint32 account_id) {
	std::string q = "DELETE FROM `og_ban` WHERE `unique_id` IN (SELECT `unique_id` FROM `og_client` WHERE `account_id` = " + std::to_string(account_id) + ")";
	if (SQL_ERROR == Sql_QueryStr(mmysql_handle, q.c_str())) {
		Sql_ShowDebug(mmysql_handle);
		return 0;
	}
	return (int32)Sql_NumRowsAffected(mmysql_handle);
}

void og_map_info(map_session_data* target, char* out, size_t size) {
	const s_og_info* info = og_info(target->fd);
	if (info == nullptr) {
		safesnprintf(out, size, "%s: no OdinGuard session.", target->status.name);
		return;
	}
	safesnprintf(out, size, "%s: protocol v%d, build '%s', machine %.16s, exe %.16s, guard %.16s, flags %d, signatures v%u", target->status.name,
		info->version, info->build.c_str(), info->unique_id.c_str(), info->exe_code.c_str(), info->guard_code.c_str(), info->flags, og_sigpack_version());
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- display features

static int32 og_flags(const map_session_data* sd) {
	return (int32)pc_readglobalreg(const_cast<map_session_data*>(sd), add_str(OG_REG_FLAGS));
}

static bool og_lgp_in_aoes(uint16 skill_id) {
	// @aoes: only the three big area skills (og_lgp_aoes: comma separated skill ids)
	char list[128];
	safestrncpy(list, og_setting("og_lgp_aoes", "89,83,85"), sizeof(list));
	for (char* t = strtok(list, ", "); t != nullptr; t = strtok(nullptr, ", "))
		if (atoi(t) == skill_id) return true;
	return false;
}

uint16 og_map_lgp_unit(const map_session_data* viewer, uint16 skill_id) {
	if (viewer == nullptr || !og_module_on("og_lgp_enable", true))
		return 0;
	int32 flags = og_flags(viewer);
	if (!(flags & OG_FLAG_LGP) || ((flags & OG_FLAG_LGP_AOES) && !og_lgp_in_aoes(skill_id)))
		return 0;
	int32 style = (int32)pc_readglobalreg(const_cast<map_session_data*>(viewer), add_str(OG_REG_LGP_STYLE));
	char name[16];
	if (style == 1) safestrncpy(name, "circle", sizeof(name));
	else safesnprintf(name, sizeof(name), "set%d", style);
	uint16 unit = style > 0 ? og_lgp_unit_style(name, skill_id) : 0;
	return unit ? unit : og_lgp_unit(skill_id);
}

struct s_og_area { const block_list* src; const void* buf; int32 len; bool (*keep)(map_session_data*, const block_list&, void*); void* ctx; };

void og_map_send_area(const block_list& src, const void* buf, int32 len, bool (*keep)(map_session_data* viewer, const block_list& src, void* ctx), void* ctx) {
	s_og_area a = { &src, buf, len, keep, ctx };
	map_foreachinallrange([](block_list* bl, va_list ap) -> int32 {
		s_og_area* a = va_arg(ap, s_og_area*);
		map_session_data* sd = reinterpret_cast<map_session_data*>(bl);
		if (sd->fd <= 0 || !session_isActive(sd->fd) || (a->keep != nullptr && !a->keep(sd, *a->src, a->ctx)))
			return 0;
		clif_send(a->buf, a->len, bl, SELF);
		return 1;
	}, const_cast<block_list*>(&src), AREA_SIZE, BL_PC, &a);
}

/// @lgp / @square / @circle / @aoes. kind: 0 lgp, 1 square, 2 circle, 3 aoes; arg: "", "on", "off" or a set number
void og_map_lgp_command(map_session_data* sd, int32 kind, const char* arg) {
	int32 flags = og_flags(sd), style = (int32)pc_readglobalreg(sd, add_str(OG_REG_LGP_STYLE));
	bool on = !(flags & OG_FLAG_LGP);
	if (!strcmpi(arg, "on")) on = true;
	else if (!strcmpi(arg, "off")) on = false;
	else if (kind == 1 && atoi(arg) > 0) {
		int32 set = atoi(arg);
		if (set > 14) { clif_displaymessage(sd->fd, "Colour sets: 1-14."); return; }
		style = set == 1 ? 0 : set;
		on = true;
	} else if (kind != 0 && *arg == '\0')
		on = true;
	if (kind == 1 && atoi(arg) <= 0) style = 0;
	if (kind == 2) style = 1;
	if (kind == 3) flags = on ? (flags | OG_FLAG_LGP_AOES) : (flags & ~OG_FLAG_LGP_AOES);
	else if (kind != 0) flags &= ~OG_FLAG_LGP_AOES;
	flags = on ? (flags | OG_FLAG_LGP) : (flags & ~(OG_FLAG_LGP | OG_FLAG_LGP_AOES));
	pc_setglobalreg(sd, add_str(OG_REG_FLAGS), flags);
	pc_setglobalreg(sd, add_str(OG_REG_LGP_STYLE), style);
	char msg[CHAT_SIZE_MAX];
	if (!on)
		safesnprintf(msg, sizeof(msg), "Lite ground skills off: normal skill effects.");
	else
		safesnprintf(msg, sizeof(msg), "Lite ground skills on (%s%s): %s are shown as flat cell tiles.",
			style == 1 ? "circle" : style > 1 ? "colour set" : "square", style > 1 ? std::to_string(style).c_str() : "",
			(flags & OG_FLAG_LGP_AOES) ? "Storm Gust, Lord of Vermilion and Meteor Storm" : "area skills");
	clif_displaymessage(sd->fd, msg);
}

typedef std::vector<std::pair<uint32, std::string>> og_color_list;

// colour message: kind, op, entries (colour, text)
static std::vector<uint8> og_colors_msg(uint8 kind, uint8 op, const std::vector<std::pair<uint32, std::string>>& entries) {
	std::vector<uint8> m = { OG_S_COLORS, kind, op, 0, 0 };
	uint16 n = 0;
	for (const auto& e : entries) {
		size_t len = std::min(e.second.size(), (size_t)63);
		if (m.size() + 4 + len > 60000)
			break;
		m.push_back((uint8)(e.first >> 16));
		m.push_back((uint8)(e.first >> 8));
		m.push_back((uint8)e.first);
		m.push_back((uint8)len);
		m.insert(m.end(), e.second.begin(), e.second.begin() + len);
		n++;
	}
	m[3] = (uint8)n;
	m[4] = (uint8)(n >> 8);
	return m;
}

/// name colour of a character: own setting first, then the group colour; -1 = none
static int32 og_namecolor(map_session_data* sd) {
	int32 reg = (int32)pc_readglobalreg(sd, add_str(OG_REG_NAMECOLOR));
	if (reg & 0x1000000)
		return reg & 0xFFFFFF;
	for (const auto& g : og_group_namecolors())
		if (g.first == sd->group_id)
			return (int32)g.second;
	return -1;
}

static void og_broadcast(const std::vector<uint8>& msg) {
	map_foreachpc([](map_session_data* other, va_list ap) -> int32 {
		const std::vector<uint8>* m = va_arg(ap, const std::vector<uint8>*);
		if (other->fd > 0 && og_session_active(other->fd))
			og_send_control(other->fd, *m);
		return 0;
	}, &msg);
}

static void og_announce_name(map_session_data* sd, bool remove) {
	int32 rgb = og_namecolor(sd);
	if (rgb < 0 && !remove)
		return;
	og_broadcast(og_colors_msg(OG_COLOR_NAME, remove ? OG_COLOR_OP_REMOVE : OG_COLOR_OP_SET, { { (uint32)std::max(rgb, 0), sd->status.name } }));
}

void og_map_set_namecolor(map_session_data* sd, int32 rgb) {
	og_announce_name(sd, true);
	pc_setglobalreg(sd, add_str(OG_REG_NAMECOLOR), rgb < 0 ? 0 : (0x1000000 | (rgb & 0xFFFFFF)));
	og_announce_name(sd, false);
}

void og_map_on_load(map_session_data* sd, bool first) {
	if (!og_enabled())
		return;
	if (first) {
		if (og_session_active(sd->fd)) {
			// item colours (names from the item database) and the coloured names of everyone online
			std::vector<std::pair<uint32, std::string>> items, names;
			for (const auto& c : og_item_colors())
				if (std::shared_ptr<item_data> id = item_db.find(c.first); id != nullptr)
					items.emplace_back(c.second, id->name);
			og_send_control(sd->fd, og_colors_msg(OG_COLOR_ITEM, OG_COLOR_OP_REPLACE, items));
			map_foreachpc([](map_session_data* other, va_list ap) -> int32 {
				auto* v = va_arg(ap, og_color_list*);
				int32 rgb = og_namecolor(other);
				if (rgb >= 0)
					v->emplace_back((uint32)rgb, other->status.name);
				return 0;
			}, &names);
			og_send_control(sd->fd, og_colors_msg(OG_COLOR_NAME, OG_COLOR_OP_REPLACE, names));
		}
		og_announce_name(sd, false);
	}
}

void og_map_on_quit(map_session_data* sd) {
	og_map_guard_quit(sd);
	if (og_enabled() && og_namecolor(sd) >= 0)
		og_announce_name(sd, true);
}
```

`server/src/map/og_map_guard.cpp`:

```cpp
// OdinGuard Anti Cheat on the map-server: server-side protection modules that work for every client (also
// without the guard): flags and delayed ban waves (ban-system), packet rate limit (rate-limit), behaviour
// signatures (behaviour: no-delay attempts, autopot reaction time, macro timing), the honeypot unit
// (ch-honeypot), the bot captcha (ch-captcha) and the command registry (enable, rate limit, rename).
// These checks are the real security of OdinGuard: they do not trust anything the client says.

#include "og_map.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <string>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <vector>

#include <common/odinguard.hpp>
#include <common/showmsg.hpp>
#include <common/socket.hpp>
#include <common/sql.hpp>
#include <common/strlib.hpp>
#include <common/timer.hpp>

#include "clif.hpp"
#include "itemdb.hpp"
#include "map.hpp"
#include "pc.hpp"
#include "pc_groups.hpp"

#define OG_HONEYPOT_BASE 0x7A000000

struct s_og_bh {
	t_tick win_start = 0;
	int32 packets = 0, over_seconds = 0;
	bool rate_reported = false;
	t_tick nd_start = 0;
	int32 nd_count = 0;
	bool nd_flagged = false;
	bool hp_low = false;
	t_tick hp_low_at = 0;
	std::vector<int32> reactions;
	bool ap_flagged = false;
	t_tick last_action = 0;
	std::vector<int32> intervals;
	bool macro_flagged = false;
	bool honeypot_flagged = false;
	bool captcha_sent = false;
	std::unordered_map<std::string, t_tick> cmd_last;
};

static std::unordered_map<int32, s_og_bh> og_bh; // by account id

static s_og_bh& og_state_of(const map_session_data* sd) { return og_bh[sd->status.account_id]; }

void og_map_guard_quit(map_session_data* sd) { og_bh.erase(sd->status.account_id); }

static std::string og_esc(const std::string& s) {
	std::string out(s.size() * 2 + 1, '\0');
	out.resize(Sql_EscapeStringLen(mmysql_handle, &out[0], s.c_str(), s.size()));
	return out;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- flags and ban waves

void og_map_flag(map_session_data* sd, const char* uid, const char* rule, int32 score, bool ban, const char* detail) {
	std::string q = "INSERT INTO `og_flag` (`unique_id`,`account_id`,`char_name`,`rule`,`score`,`ban`,`detail`) VALUES ('" +
		og_esc(uid ? uid : "") + "'," + std::to_string(sd ? sd->status.account_id : 0) + ",'" + og_esc(sd ? sd->status.name : "") + "','" +
		og_esc(std::string(rule).substr(0, 64)) + "'," + std::to_string(score) + "," + (ban ? "1" : "0") + ",'" +
		og_esc(std::string(detail).substr(0, 255)) + "')";
	if (SQL_ERROR == Sql_QueryStr(mmysql_handle, q.c_str()))
		Sql_ShowDebug(mmysql_handle);
}

/// bans every account whose open ban flags reach og_ban_score; @return number of accounts (dry: only listed)
int32 og_map_banwave(bool dry, std::vector<std::string>* report) {
	int32 limit = og_setting_int("og_ban_score", 100), n = 0;
	if (og_log_only() && !dry) {
		dry = true; // warn mode never bans
		if (report != nullptr) report->push_back("warn mode (og_log_only): only listed, nobody banned");
	}
	std::string q = "SELECT `account_id`, MAX(`unique_id`), SUM(`score`), GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT `rule` SEPARATOR ',') FROM `og_flag`"
		" WHERE `state` = 'open' AND `ban` = 1 GROUP BY `account_id` HAVING SUM(`score`) >= " + std::to_string(limit);
	if (SQL_ERROR == Sql_QueryStr(mmysql_handle, q.c_str())) { Sql_ShowDebug(mmysql_handle); return 0; }
	std::vector<std::tuple<uint32, std::string, int32, std::string>> hits;
	while (SQL_SUCCESS == Sql_NextRow(mmysql_handle)) {
		char *acc, *uid, *score, *rules;
		Sql_GetData(mmysql_handle, 0, &acc, nullptr);
		Sql_GetData(mmysql_handle, 1, &uid, nullptr);
		Sql_GetData(mmysql_handle, 2, &score, nullptr);
		Sql_GetData(mmysql_handle, 3, &rules, nullptr);
		hits.emplace_back((uint32)strtoul(acc, nullptr, 10), uid ? uid : "", atoi(score), rules ? rules : "");
	}
	Sql_FreeResult(mmysql_handle);
	for (const auto& h : hits) {
		uint32 acc = std::get<0>(h);
		const std::string& uid = std::get<1>(h);
		if (report != nullptr)
			report->push_back("account " + std::to_string(acc) + ": score " + std::to_string(std::get<2>(h)) + " (" + std::get<3>(h).substr(0, 80) + ")");
		n++;
		if (dry)
			continue;
		if (!uid.empty()) {
			std::string b = "INSERT INTO `og_ban` (`unique_id`,`reason`,`banned_by`) VALUES ('" + og_esc(uid) + "','ban wave: " + og_esc(std::get<3>(h).substr(0, 200)) + "','OdinGuard')";
			if (SQL_ERROR == Sql_QueryStr(mmysql_handle, b.c_str())) Sql_ShowDebug(mmysql_handle);
		}
		std::string u = "UPDATE `og_flag` SET `state` = 'banned' WHERE `state` = 'open' AND `account_id` = " + std::to_string(acc);
		if (SQL_ERROR == Sql_QueryStr(mmysql_handle, u.c_str())) Sql_ShowDebug(mmysql_handle);
		if (map_session_data* sd = map_id2sd(acc); sd != nullptr)
			clif_authfail_fd(sd->fd, 15);
	}
	if (!dry && n > 0)
		ShowStatus("OdinGuard: ban wave banned %d account(s).\n", n);
	return n;
}

static TIMER_FUNC(og_banwave_timer) {
	static int32 last_day = -1;
	int32 hour = og_setting_int("og_banwave_hour", 4);
	if (hour < 0 || !og_module_on("og_ban_system", true) || og_log_only())
		return 0;
	time_t t = time(nullptr);
	struct tm* lt = localtime(&t);
	if (lt->tm_hour == hour && lt->tm_yday != last_day) {
		last_day = lt->tm_yday;
		og_map_banwave(false, nullptr);
	}
	return 0;
}

void og_map_flags_text(uint32 account_id, std::vector<std::string>& out) {
	std::string q = account_id
		? "SELECT `time`,`rule`,`score`,`ban`,`state`,`detail` FROM `og_flag` WHERE `account_id` = " + std::to_string(account_id) + " ORDER BY `id` DESC LIMIT 15"
		: "SELECT MAX(`time`), CONCAT('account ', `account_id`), SUM(`score`), MAX(`ban`), 'open', GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT `rule` SEPARATOR ',') FROM `og_flag` WHERE `state` = 'open' GROUP BY `account_id` ORDER BY SUM(`score`) DESC LIMIT 10";
	if (SQL_ERROR == Sql_QueryStr(mmysql_handle, q.c_str())) { Sql_ShowDebug(mmysql_handle); return; }
	while (SQL_SUCCESS == Sql_NextRow(mmysql_handle)) {
		char* d[6];
		for (int32 i = 0; i < 6; i++) Sql_GetData(mmysql_handle, i, &d[i], nullptr);
		out.push_back(std::string(d[0] ? d[0] : "") + " " + (d[1] ? d[1] : "") + " score " + (d[2] ? d[2] : "0") +
			(d[3] && atoi(d[3]) ? " ban" : "") + " [" + (d[4] ? d[4] : "") + "] " + std::string(d[5] ? d[5] : "").substr(0, 60));
	}
	Sql_FreeResult(mmysql_handle);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- rate limit

void og_map_packet(int32 fd, map_session_data* sd, uint16 cmd) {
	(void)cmd;
	if (sd == nullptr || !og_module_on("og_rate_limit", false))
		return;
	s_og_bh& b = og_state_of(sd);
	t_tick now = gettick();
	if (DIFF_TICK(now, b.win_start) >= 1000) {
		if (b.packets > og_setting_int("og_rate_pps", 150)) b.over_seconds++;
		else b.over_seconds = 0;
		b.win_start = now;
		b.packets = 0;
	}
	b.packets++;
	if (b.over_seconds >= 3 && !b.rate_reported) {
		b.rate_reported = true;
		char detail[96];
		safesnprintf(detail, sizeof(detail), "more than %d packets/s for 3 s", og_setting_int("og_rate_pps", 150));
		og_report(fd, "rate-limit", detail, og_setting_action("og_rate_action", OG_ACTION_KICK), 30);
	}
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- behaviour

static void og_bh_flag(map_session_data* sd, const char* rule, const char* detail, int32 score) {
	og_report(sd->fd, rule, detail, og_setting_action("og_bh_action", OG_ACTION_FLAGBAN), score);
	// a captcha only outside of WoE/BG/PvP fights, once per session
	s_og_bh& b = og_state_of(sd);
	if (og_module_on("og_ch_captcha", false) && !b.captcha_sent && sd->state.active) {
		struct map_data* m = map_getmapdata(sd->m);
		if (m != nullptr && !map_flag_gvg2(sd->m) && !m->getMapFlag(MF_BATTLEGROUND) && !m->getMapFlag(MF_PVP)) {
			b.captcha_sent = true;
			pc_macro_reporter_process(*sd, 0);
		}
	}
}

void og_map_skill_refused(map_session_data* sd) {
	if (!og_module_on("og_behaviour", false))
		return;
	s_og_bh& b = og_state_of(sd);
	t_tick now = gettick();
	if (DIFF_TICK(now, b.nd_start) > 60000) { b.nd_start = now; b.nd_count = 0; }
	if (++b.nd_count > og_setting_int("og_bh_nodelay", 120) && !b.nd_flagged) {
		b.nd_flagged = true;
		char detail[96];
		safesnprintf(detail, sizeof(detail), "%d skill requests inside the delay within 60 s (modified client or macro)", b.nd_count);
		og_bh_flag(sd, "bh:nodelay", detail, 40);
	}
}

static void og_bh_action(map_session_data* sd, s_og_bh& b) {
	t_tick now = gettick();
	if (b.last_action != 0) {
		int32 iv = (int32)DIFF_TICK(now, b.last_action);
		if (iv > 30000) b.intervals.clear();
		else b.intervals.push_back(iv);
	}
	b.last_action = now;
	if (b.intervals.size() > 40) b.intervals.erase(b.intervals.begin());
	if (b.intervals.size() == 40 && !b.macro_flagged) {
		double mean = 0, var = 0;
		for (int32 v : b.intervals) mean += v;
		mean /= 40;
		for (int32 v : b.intervals) var += (v - mean) * (v - mean);
		double sd_ms = std::sqrt(var / 40);
		if (mean >= 40 && sd_ms < og_setting_int("og_bh_macro_jitter", 4)) {
			b.macro_flagged = true;
			char detail[96];
			safesnprintf(detail, sizeof(detail), "40 actions every %.0f ms with %.1f ms jitter", mean, sd_ms);
			og_bh_flag(sd, "bh:macro", detail, 30);
		}
	}
}

void og_map_item_used(map_session_data* sd, int32 index) {
	if (!og_module_on("og_behaviour", false) || index < 0 || index >= MAX_INVENTORY || sd->inventory_data[index] == nullptr)
		return;
	s_og_bh& b = og_state_of(sd);
	og_bh_action(sd, b);
	if (sd->inventory_data[index]->type != IT_HEALING || !b.hp_low)
		return;
	int32 reaction = (int32)DIFF_TICK(gettick(), b.hp_low_at);
	b.hp_low = false;
	if (reaction > 5000)
		return;
	b.reactions.push_back(reaction);
	if (b.reactions.size() > 20) b.reactions.erase(b.reactions.begin());
	if (b.reactions.size() == 20 && !b.ap_flagged) {
		std::vector<int32> s = b.reactions;
		std::sort(s.begin(), s.end());
		int32 median = s[10];
		if (median < og_setting_int("og_bh_autopot_ms", 90) && s[17] < og_setting_int("og_bh_autopot_ms", 90) * 2) {
			b.ap_flagged = true;
			char detail[96];
			safesnprintf(detail, sizeof(detail), "healing item %d ms after HP < 50%% (median of 20, human ~250 ms)", median);
			og_bh_flag(sd, "bh:autopot", detail, 40);
		}
	}
}

void og_map_skill_used(map_session_data* sd) {
	if (og_module_on("og_behaviour", false))
		og_bh_action(sd, og_state_of(sd));
}

void og_map_hp_update(map_session_data* sd) {
	if (!og_module_on("og_behaviour", false) || sd->battle_status.max_hp == 0)
		return;
	s_og_bh& b = og_state_of(sd);
	bool low = sd->battle_status.hp * 2 < sd->battle_status.max_hp && sd->battle_status.hp > 0;
	if (low && !b.hp_low) { b.hp_low = true; b.hp_low_at = gettick(); }
	else if (!low) b.hp_low = false;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- honeypot

static uint32 og_honeypot_id(const map_session_data* sd) { return OG_HONEYPOT_BASE | (sd->status.account_id & 0xFFFFFF); }

void og_map_honeypot_spawn(map_session_data* sd) {
	// an invisible monster at the player's position: the game client never draws or targets it, bots that read
	// the unit list do
	if (og_module_on("og_ch_honeypot", false) && pc_get_group_level(sd) == 0)
		clif_og_honeypot(*sd, og_honeypot_id(sd));
}

bool og_map_honeypot_hit(map_session_data* sd, int32 target_id) {
	if (target_id != (int32)og_honeypot_id(sd) || !og_module_on("og_ch_honeypot", false))
		return false;
	s_og_bh& b = og_state_of(sd);
	if (!b.honeypot_flagged) {
		b.honeypot_flagged = true;
		og_report(sd->fd, "challenge:honeypot", "attacked an invisible decoy unit (bot)", og_setting_action("og_ch_honeypot_action", OG_ACTION_FLAGBAN), 80);
	}
	return true;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- command registry

/// og_cmd_<id>: on/off, og_cmdrate_<id>: ms, og_cmdgroup_<id>: lowest group level (conf/odinguard_commands.conf)
bool og_map_command_allowed(map_session_data* sd, const char* id, int32 def_rate_ms) {
	char key[64];
	safesnprintf(key, sizeof(key), "og_cmd_%s", id);
	if (!config_switch(og_setting(key, "yes"))) {
		clif_displaymessage(sd->fd, "This command is disabled on this server.");
		return false;
	}
	safesnprintf(key, sizeof(key), "og_cmdgroup_%s", id);
	if (pc_get_group_level(sd) < og_setting_int(key, 0)) {
		clif_displaymessage(sd->fd, "You are not allowed to use this command.");
		return false;
	}
	safesnprintf(key, sizeof(key), "og_cmdrate_%s", id);
	int32 rate = og_setting_int(key, def_rate_ms);
	if (rate > 0 && pc_get_group_level(sd) == 0) {
		s_og_bh& b = og_state_of(sd);
		t_tick now = gettick();
		auto it = b.cmd_last.find(id);
		if (it != b.cmd_last.end() && DIFF_TICK(now, it->second) < rate) {
			clif_displaymessage(sd->fd, "Please wait a moment before using this command again.");
			return false;
		}
		b.cmd_last[id] = now;
	}
	return true;
}

/// client command name after renaming (og_cmdname_<id>), e.g. "ping"
const char* og_map_command_name(const char* id) {
	char key[64];
	safesnprintf(key, sizeof(key), "og_cmdname_%s", id);
	return og_setting(key, id);
}

void og_map_guard_init() {
	add_timer_func_list(og_banwave_timer, "og_banwave_timer");
	add_timer_interval(gettick() + 60000, og_banwave_timer, 0, 0, 60000);
}
```

```toml
#         substrings are flag at most (browser tabs match), kick/ban needs an injected module, hash or a second signal.
#
# Pattern conventions (all comparisons case-insensitive unless a hash):
#   process        exact lower-case image file name
#   window_class   exact window class name; window_title: substring of the title
#   module         exact lower-case module file name. Never use a generic name (dinput.dll, ddraw.dll)
#                  alone - those are only listed as file_sha256.
#   file_name      exact lower-case file name (client folder unless the note says otherwise)
#   file_sha256 / grf_sha256   lower-case hex SHA-256 of the whole file
#   grf_entry      '<lower-case path as stored in the GRF, CP949 decoded to UTF-8, backslashes>|<md5 of
#                  decoded content>'. '*|<md5>' = the same content under any path (content-class rule).
#   import_pattern 'exports:a,b,c' = module exports all names; ';verinfo:Key=Value' = plus version string
#   string_pattern 'ascii:<text>' / 'utf16:<text>' = bytes in the module/process image or file,
#                  'section:<name>' = PE section name
#   driver         service / driver name; registry: key path
#   mutex          exact name of a named mutex/event/section, without Global\ or Local\ (client tries both)
#   registry       "HKCU\path" or "HKLM\path" key (32- and 64-bit views)
# Mapping to og_proto.h kinds: process=1, window_title=2, module=3, window_class=7, file_name=8,
# file_sha256=9, driver=10, grf_sha256=11, mutex=16, registry=17. grf_entry, import_pattern and string_pattern
# have no wire kind (analysis-only / server tooling; OG_KIND_GRF=5 is report-only).
# confidence: high = exact hash or tool-unique string; medium = specific but renamable or generic tool;
# low = context only. action is the default suggestion.
```

`studio/apps/studio/src-tauri/src/lib.rs`:

```rs
//! OdinGuard Studio backend: Tauri commands over og-core. The GUI never does anything og-core (and the `og` CLI)
//! cannot do; builds, signatures and updates use exactly the same code.

use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

use og_core::{pipeline, profile::Profile, registry::Registry, rollout};
use serde::Serialize;

type Res<T> = Result<T, String>;

fn err<E: std::fmt::Display>(e: E) -> String {
    e.to_string()
}

fn registry() -> Res<Registry> {
    Registry::load(&og_core::repo_root().join("modules")).map_err(err)
}

#[derive(Serialize)]
struct Loaded {
    path: String,
    profile: Profile,
    warnings: Vec<String>,
    error: Option<String>,
}

#[tauri::command]
fn get_registry() -> Res<Registry> {
    registry()
}

#[tauri::command]
fn load_profile(path: String) -> Res<Loaded> {
    let p = Profile::load(Path::new(&path)).map_err(err)?;
    let reg = registry()?;
    let (warnings, error) = match p.validate(&reg) {
        Ok(w) => (w, None),
        Err(e) => (vec![], Some(e.to_string())),
    };
    Ok(Loaded { path, profile: p, warnings, error })
}

/// Validates without saving: returns warnings or the first error.
#[tauri::command]
fn validate_profile(profile: Profile) -> Res<Vec<String>> {
    profile.validate(&registry()?).map_err(err)
}

#[tauri::command]
fn save_profile(path: String, profile: Profile) -> Res<Vec<String>> {
    let warnings = profile.validate(&registry()?).map_err(err)?;
    profile.save(Path::new(&path)).map_err(err)?;
    Ok(warnings)
}

/// New profile with fresh salts; the key files are created next to it (never overwritten).
#[tauri::command]
fn new_profile(path: String, id: String, operator: String) -> Res<Loaded> {
    let target = PathBuf::from(&path);
    if target.exists() {
        return Err(format!("{path} exists"));
    }
    let p = Profile::new(&id, &operator).map_err(err)?;
    let base = target.parent().unwrap_or(Path::new(".")).to_path_buf();
    for k in [&p.keys.server_seed, &p.keys.signing_seed, &p.keys.build_secret] {
        og_core::keys::ensure(&p.resolve(&base, k)).map_err(err)?;
    }
    p.save(&target).map_err(err)?;
    load_profile(path)
}

#[tauri::command]
fn preview(profile: Profile) -> Res<pipeline::Preview> {
    pipeline::preview(&profile, &registry()?).map_err(err)
}

#[tauri::command]
async fn build(path: String) -> Res<pipeline::BuildReport> {
    tauri::async_runtime::spawn_blocking(move || pipeline::build(Path::new(&path), &og_core::repo_root()).map_err(err))
        .await
        .map_err(err)?
}

#[tauri::command]
fn verify_release(dir: String) -> Res<String> {
    og_core::manifest::verify_release(Path::new(&dir), None).map(|m| format!("release ok: profile {}, {} files, signature valid", m.profile, m.files.len())).map_err(err)
}

#[tauri::command]
fn commands_md(profile: Profile, lang: String) -> Res<String> {
    Ok(og_core::generate::commands_md(&profile, &registry()?, &lang))
}

#[tauri::command]
fn rollout_status(path: String, events: String, clients: String, active: Option<usize>, fp_percent: f64) -> Res<rollout::Status> {
    let p = Profile::load(Path::new(&path)).map_err(err)?;
    rollout::status(&p, Path::new(&events), Path::new(&clients), active, fp_percent).map_err(err)
}

#[tauri::command]
fn rollout_advance(path: String, events: String, clients: String, active: Option<usize>, fp_percent: f64) -> Res<u8> {
    let mut p = Profile::load(Path::new(&path)).map_err(err)?;
    let s = rollout::status(&p, Path::new(&events), Path::new(&clients), active, fp_percent).map_err(err)?;
    let stage = rollout::advance(&mut p, &s, false).map_err(err)?;
    p.save(Path::new(&path)).map_err(err)?;
    Ok(stage)
}

/// Update endpoint base; `<base>/<channel>.json` plus `<channel>.json.sig`. Default: GitHub Releases of the
/// OdinGuard repository (stable = the latest release, beta = the release tagged "beta"). Overridable for
/// staging/tests and self-hosting.
fn update_base(channel: &str) -> String {
    std::env::var("OG_STUDIO_UPDATE_ENDPOINT").unwrap_or_else(|_| {
        if channel == "beta" { "https://github.com/kxdrsrt/OdinGuard/releases/download/beta".into() } else { "https://github.com/kxdrsrt/OdinGuard/releases/latest/download".into() }
    })
}

/// The minisign key line from the updater plugin config (Tauri stores the .pub file base64 encoded).
fn updater_pubkey(app: &tauri::AppHandle) -> Res<String> {
    let b64 = app.config().plugins.0.get("updater").and_then(|u| u.get("pubkey")).and_then(|k| k.as_str()).ok_or("updater pubkey missing")?;
    og_core::update::minisign_key_line(b64).ok_or_else(|| "updater pubkey has no minisign key line".into())
}

#[derive(Serialize)]
struct UpdateInfo {
    version: String,
    notes: String,
    channel: String,
}

/// Step 1 (og-core): signed channel manifest, downgrade refusal and manifest pinning.
/// Step 2 (Tauri updater plugin, same manifest URL): artifact signature check and installation.
#[tauri::command]
async fn studio_update(app: tauri::AppHandle, channel: String, install: bool) -> Res<Option<UpdateInfo>> {
    use tauri::Manager;
    use tauri_plugin_updater::UpdaterExt;
    if !matches!(channel.as_str(), "stable" | "beta") {
        return Err(format!("unknown channel {channel}"));
    }
    let base = update_base(&channel);
    let dir = app.path().app_data_dir().map_err(err)?.join("updates");
    let u = og_core::update::Updater { endpoint: base.clone(), channel: channel.clone(), public_key: updater_pubkey(&app)?, dir, allow_loopback_http: false };
    let current = app.package_info().version.to_string();
    let checked = tauri::async_runtime::spawn_blocking(move || u.check("studio", &current).map(|m| (m, u)).map_err(err)).await.map_err(err)??;
    let (Some(m), u) = checked else { return Ok(None) };
    let info = UpdateInfo { version: m.version.clone(), notes: m.notes.clone(), channel: channel.clone() };
    if !install {
        return Ok(Some(info));
    }
    let url = tauri::Url::parse(&format!("{}/{channel}.json", base.trim_end_matches('/'))).map_err(err)?;
    let update = app.updater_builder().endpoints(vec![url]).map_err(err)?.build().map_err(err)?.check().await.map_err(err)?;
    let Some(update) = update else { return Err("updater plugin found no newer version".into()) };
    if update.version != m.version {
        return Err(format!("manifest changed during the update ({} vs {})", update.version, m.version));
    }
    update.download_and_install(|_, _| {}, || {}).await.map_err(err)?;
    u.record_installed("studio", &m).map_err(err)?;
    Ok(Some(info))
}

/// Tool groups of the profile's signature sources (paths relative to the profile file).
#[tauri::command]
fn signature_groups(path: String, profile: Profile) -> Res<Vec<og_core::sigpack::Group>> {
    let base = Path::new(&path).parent().unwrap_or(Path::new(".")).to_path_buf();
    let src: Vec<PathBuf> = profile.signatures.sources.iter().map(|s| profile.resolve(&base, s)).collect();
    let al: Vec<PathBuf> = profile.signatures.allowlist.iter().map(|s| profile.resolve(&base, s)).collect();
    og_core::sigpack::catalog(&src.iter().map(PathBuf::as_path).collect::<Vec<_>>(), &al.iter().map(PathBuf::as_path).collect::<Vec<_>>()).map_err(err)
}

#[tauri::command]
async fn grf_scan(client: String, full: bool) -> Res<Vec<og_core::profile::GrfFile>> {
    tauri::async_runtime::spawn_blocking(move || og_core::grf::scan_client(Path::new(&client), full).map_err(err)).await.map_err(err)?
}

#[tauri::command]
fn grf_tail(path: String) -> Res<String> {
    og_core::grf::tail_hash(Path::new(&path)).map(|(_, t)| t).map_err(err)
}

/// Selectable staging folders of assets/competitive/recipe.toml in copy order.
#[tauri::command]
fn competitive_recipe() -> Res<Vec<og_core::pack::PackOption>> {
    og_core::pack::options(&og_core::repo_root().join("assets/competitive/recipe.toml")).map_err(err)
}

#[tauri::command]
fn studio_version() -> String {
    env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION").to_string()
}

pub fn run() {
    tauri::Builder::default()
        .plugin(tauri_plugin_dialog::init())
        .plugin(tauri_plugin_updater::Builder::new().build())
        .invoke_handler(tauri::generate_handler![
            get_registry,
            load_profile,
            validate_profile,
            save_profile,
            new_profile,
            preview,
            build,
            verify_release,
            commands_md,
            rollout_status,
            rollout_advance,
            studio_version,
            studio_update,
            signature_groups,
            grf_scan,
            grf_tail,
            competitive_recipe,
        ])
        .run(tauri::generate_context!())
        .expect("error while running OdinGuard Studio");
}

```

`studio/apps/studio/ui/app.js`:

```js
// OdinGuard Studio UI. Everything goes through the Tauri commands (og-core); the UI only edits the profile JSON.
"use strict";
const T = window.__TAURI__;
const invoke = (cmd, args) => T.core.invoke(cmd, args);
const $ = (s) => document.querySelector(s);
const esc = (s) => String(s ?? "").replace(/[&<>"]/g, (c) => ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;" })[c]);

let reg = null, profile = null, path = null;

function status(msg, ok = true) {
  const s = $("#status");
  s.textContent = msg;
  s.className = ok ? "ok" : "bad";
}

async function revalidate() {
  if (!profile) return;
  try {
    const w = await invoke("validate_profile", { profile });
    status(w.length ? "Gültig mit Hinweisen: " + w.join(" · ") : "Profil gültig.", true);
    return true;
  } catch (e) {
    status("Ungültig: " + e, false);
    return false;
  }
}

function field(label, value, onchange, type = "text") {
  const l = document.createElement("label");
  l.textContent = label;
  const i = document.createElement("input");
  i.type = type;
  if (type === "checkbox") i.checked = !!value; else i.value = value ?? "";
  i.addEventListener("change", () => { onchange(type === "checkbox" ? i.checked : type === "number" ? Number(i.value) : i.value); revalidate(); });
  l.appendChild(i);
  return l;
}

function renderGeneral() {
  const g = $("#general");
  g.innerHTML = "";
  const gen = profile.general;
  g.append(
    field("Profil-ID", gen.id, (v) => (gen.id = v)),
    field("Betreiber (Splash, Meldungen)", gen.operator, (v) => (gen.operator = v)),
    field("Client-Build", gen.client_build, (v) => (gen.client_build = v)),
    field("Ports (Komma)", gen.ports.join(","), (v) => (gen.ports = v.split(",").map((x) => Number(x.trim())).filter((x) => x > 0))),
    field("Splash ms", gen.splash_ms, (v) => (gen.splash_ms = v), "number"),
    field("HWID-Salt (nie ändern nach Livegang)", gen.hwid_salt, (v) => (gen.hwid_salt = v)),
    field("Server-Schlüssel (Datei)", profile.keys.server_seed, (v) => (profile.keys.server_seed = v)),
    field("Signier-Schlüssel (Datei)", profile.keys.signing_seed, (v) => (profile.keys.signing_seed = v)),
    field("Build-Secret (Datei)", profile.keys.build_secret, (v) => (profile.keys.build_secret = v)),
    field("Signatur-Quellen (Komma)", profile.signatures.sources.join(","), (v) => (profile.signatures.sources = v.split(",").map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean))),
    field("Allowlists (Komma)", profile.signatures.allowlist.join(","), (v) => (profile.signatures.allowlist = v.split(",").map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean))),
    field("Höchste Signatur-Aktion", profile.signatures.max_action, (v) => (profile.signatures.max_action = v)),
    field("Signaturpaket-Version", profile.signatures.version, (v) => (profile.signatures.version = v), "number"),
    field("Ausgabe-Ordner", profile.output, (v) => (profile.output = v)),
  );
}

function paramValue(m, p) {
  const k = `${m.id}.${p.name}`;
  return k in profile.params ? profile.params[k] : p.default;
}

function renderModules() {
  const root = $("#modules");
  root.innerHTML = "";
  for (const m of reg.modules) {
    const on = profile.modules.includes(m.id);
    const box = document.createElement("div");
    box.className = "module";
    const h = document.createElement("h3");
    const cb = document.createElement("input");
    cb.type = "checkbox";
    cb.checked = on;
    cb.disabled = m.id === "core";
    cb.addEventListener("change", () => {
      if (cb.checked) {
        // add the module and everything it needs
        const add = (id) => { if (!profile.modules.includes(id)) { profile.modules.push(id); (reg.modules.find((x) => x.id === id).requires || []).forEach(add); } };
        add(m.id);
      } else profile.modules = profile.modules.filter((x) => x !== m.id);
      renderModules();
      revalidate();
    });
    h.append(cb, Object.assign(document.createElement("span"), { textContent: m.id }), Object.assign(document.createElement("span"), { className: "kind", textContent: `${m.kind} · ${m.side}` }));
    box.append(h, Object.assign(document.createElement("div"), { className: "muted", textContent: m.summary + (m.requires.length ? `  (braucht: ${m.requires.join(", ")})` : "") }));
    if (on && m.param && m.param.length) {
      const ps = document.createElement("div");
      ps.className = "params";
      for (const p of m.param) {
        const k = `${m.id}.${p.name}`;
        const v = paramValue(m, p);
        const set = (x) => { profile.params[k] = x; };
        let el;
        if (p.type === "action") {
          el = document.createElement("label");
          el.textContent = p.name;
          const s = document.createElement("select");
          for (const a of ["log", "flag", "flagban", "kick", "ban"]) s.add(new Option(a, a, false, a === v));
          s.addEventListener("change", () => { set(s.value); revalidate(); });
          el.appendChild(s);
        } else el = field(`${p.name}${p.min != null ? ` (${p.min}–${p.max})` : ""}`, v, set, p.type === "bool" ? "checkbox" : p.type === "int" ? "number" : "text");
        el.title = p.help || "";
        ps.appendChild(el);
      }
      box.appendChild(ps);
    }
    root.appendChild(box);
  }
}

function renderCommands() {
  const t = $("#commands");
  t.innerHTML = "<tr><th>An</th><th>Command</th><th>Name</th><th>Gruppe ab</th><th>Ratenlimit ms</th><th>Modul</th><th>Hilfe</th></tr>";
  for (const c of reg.commands) {
    const s = profile.commands[c.id] || { enabled: true };
    const ensure = () => (profile.commands[c.id] = profile.commands[c.id] || { enabled: true });
    const tr = document.createElement("tr");
    const active = profile.modules.includes(c.module);
    tr.innerHTML = `<td><input type="checkbox" ${s.enabled !== false ? "checked" : ""} ${active ? "" : "disabled"}></td><td>${c.kind === "client" ? "!" : "@"}${esc(c.name)} ${esc(c.params)}</td>
      <td><input value="${esc(s.name || "")}" placeholder="${esc(c.name)}" size="10"></td><td><input type="number" value="${s.group ?? c.group}" style="width:70px"></td>
      <td><input type="number" value="${s.rate_ms ?? c.rate_ms}" style="width:90px"></td><td class="muted">${esc(c.module)}${active ? "" : " (aus)"}</td><td class="muted">${esc(c.help_de)}</td>`;
    const [en, name, group, rate] = tr.querySelectorAll("input");
    en.addEventListener("change", () => { ensure().enabled = en.checked; revalidate(); });
    name.addEventListener("change", () => { const x = ensure(); if (name.value) x.name = name.value; else delete x.name; revalidate(); });
    group.addEventListener("change", () => { ensure().group = Number(group.value); revalidate(); });
    rate.addEventListener("change", () => { ensure().rate_ms = Number(rate.value); revalidate(); });
    t.appendChild(tr);
  }
}

const ACTIONS = ["log", "flag", "flagban", "kick", "ban"];
function select(options, value, onchange) {
  const s = document.createElement("select");
  for (const [v, t] of options) s.add(new Option(t, v, false, v === value));
  s.addEventListener("change", () => { onchange(s.value); revalidate(); });
  return s;
}

async function renderSignatures() {
  const t = $("#siggroups");
  t.innerHTML = "<tr><th>Gruppe</th><th>Art</th><th>Einträge</th><th>Client</th><th>Prüfarten</th><th>Quelle</th><th>Profil</th></tr>";
  let groups = [];
  try { groups = await invoke("signature_groups", { path, profile }); } catch (e) { status("Signaturen: " + e, false); return; }
  profile.signatures.groups = profile.signatures.groups || {};
  for (const g of groups) {
    const tr = document.createElement("tr");
    tr.innerHTML = `<td><b>${esc(g.group)}</b></td><td>${g.allow ? "Allowlist" : "Signatur"}</td><td>${g.count}</td><td>${g.active}</td><td class="muted">${esc(g.kinds.join(", "))}</td><td class="muted">${esc(g.sources.slice(0, 2).join(" · "))}</td><td></td>`;
    const opts = [["", "Standard (" + g.actions.join("/") + ")"], ["off", "aus"]].concat(g.allow ? [] : ACTIONS.map((a) => [a, "alle: " + a]));
    tr.lastElementChild.appendChild(select(opts, profile.signatures.groups[g.group] || "", (v) => { if (v) profile.signatures.groups[g.group] = v; else delete profile.signatures.groups[g.group]; }));
    t.appendChild(tr);
  }
}

function renderGrf() {
  const g = profile.grf;
  const a = $("#grf-actions");
  a.innerHTML = "";
  for (const [k, label] of [["modified_action", "GRF verändert"], ["unknown_action", "unbekannte GRF"], ["missing_action", "Pflicht-GRF fehlt"]]) {
    const l = document.createElement("label");
    l.textContent = label;
    l.appendChild(select(ACTIONS.map((x) => [x, x]), g[k], (v) => (g[k] = v)));
    a.appendChild(l);
  }
  $("#grf-files").innerHTML = "<tr><th>Name</th><th>Größe</th><th>Tabellen-Hash</th><th>Datei-Hash</th><th>Pflicht</th><th></th></tr>" +
    g.file.map((f, i) => `<tr><td>${esc(f.name)}</td><td>${f.size}</td><td class="muted">${esc(f.tail.slice(0, 16))}…</td><td class="muted">${f.full ? esc(f.full.slice(0, 16)) + "…" : "–"}</td><td><input type="checkbox" data-req="${i}" ${f.required ? "checked" : ""}></td><td><button data-del="${i}">entfernen</button></td></tr>`).join("");
  $("#grf-mods").innerHTML = "<tr><th>Hinweis</th><th>Tabellen-Hash</th><th></th></tr>" +
    g.mod.map((m, i) => `<tr><td>${esc(m.note)}</td><td class="muted">${esc(m.tail.slice(0, 16))}…</td><td><button data-delmod="${i}">entfernen</button></td></tr>`).join("");
  $("#grf-files").querySelectorAll("[data-req]").forEach((c) => c.addEventListener("change", () => { g.file[c.dataset.req].required = c.checked; revalidate(); }));
  $("#grf-files").querySelectorAll("[data-del]").forEach((b) => b.addEventListener("click", () => { g.file.splice(b.dataset.del, 1); renderGrf(); revalidate(); }));
  $("#grf-mods").querySelectorAll("[data-delmod]").forEach((b) => b.addEventListener("click", () => { g.mod.splice(b.dataset.delmod, 1); renderGrf(); revalidate(); }));
  $("#grf-overlays").value = g.overlays.join(",");
}

async function renderPack() {
  const src = $("#pack-src");
  src.innerHTML = "";
  src.append(
    field("Fertige GRF statt Kategorien (optional)", profile.assets.competitive_pack, (v) => (profile.assets.competitive_pack = v)),
    field("Ordner mit Kategorie-Staging", profile.assets.competitive_source || "", (v) => (profile.assets.competitive_source = v)),
  );
  let cats = [];
  try { cats = await invoke("competitive_recipe"); } catch (e) { $("#pack-cats").innerHTML = `<tr><td class="muted">Kein Rezept: ${esc(e)}</td></tr>`; return; }
  profile.assets.competitive = profile.assets.competitive || [];
  const t = $("#pack-cats");
  t.innerHTML = "<tr><th>An</th><th>Kategorie</th><th>Beschreibung</th><th>Dateien</th><th>Größe</th><th>Hinweis</th></tr>";
  for (const c of cats) {
    const tr = document.createElement("tr");
    const on = profile.assets.competitive.includes(c.staging);
    const mb = c.grf_bytes ? (c.grf_bytes / 1e6).toFixed(1) + " MB" : "";
    tr.innerHTML = `<td><input type="checkbox" ${on ? "checked" : ""}></td><td><b>${esc(c.title)}</b><br><span class="muted">${esc(c.staging)}${c.default ? " · Standard" : ""}${c.requires ? " · braucht " + esc(c.requires) : ""}</span></td><td class="muted">${esc(c.description)}</td><td>${c.files || ""}</td><td>${mb}</td><td class="muted">${esc(c.fairness)}</td>`;
    tr.querySelector("input").addEventListener("change", (e) => {
      const l = profile.assets.competitive.filter((x) => x !== c.staging);
      if (e.target.checked) { l.push(c.staging); if (c.requires && !l.includes(c.requires)) l.push(c.requires); }
      profile.assets.competitive = cats.map((x) => x.staging).filter((x) => l.includes(x));
      renderPack(); revalidate();
    });
    t.appendChild(tr);
  }
}

function renderStages() {
  const names = ["Warnmodus", "Kick", "Patcher", "Pflicht"];
  $("#stages").innerHTML = names.map((n, i) => `<div class="${i + 1 < profile.rollout.stage ? "done" : i + 1 === profile.rollout.stage ? "now" : ""}">${i + 1}. ${n}</div>`).join("");
}

function render() {
  $("#path").textContent = path || "kein Profil";
  $("#btn-save").disabled = !profile;
  if (!profile) return;
  renderGeneral();
  renderModules();
  renderCommands();
  renderGrf();
  renderStages();
  renderSignatures();
  renderPack();
}

async function openProfile(p) {
  const r = await invoke("load_profile", { path: p });
  path = r.path;
  profile = r.profile;
  render();
  if (r.error) status("Ungültig: " + r.error, false); else status(r.warnings.length ? "Geladen, Hinweise: " + r.warnings.join(" · ") : "Profil geladen.");
}

document.querySelectorAll("nav button").forEach((b) => b.addEventListener("click", () => {
  document.querySelectorAll("nav button, .tab").forEach((x) => x.classList.remove("active"));
  b.classList.add("active");
  $("#tab-" + b.dataset.tab).classList.add("active");
}));

$("#btn-open").addEventListener("click", async () => {
  const p = await T.dialog.open({ filters: [{ name: "OdinGuard-Profil", extensions: ["toml"] }] });
  if (p) openProfile(p).catch((e) => status(String(e), false));
});
$("#btn-new").addEventListener("click", async () => {
  const p = await T.dialog.save({ defaultPath: "odinguard.profile.toml", filters: [{ name: "OdinGuard-Profil", extensions: ["toml"] }] });
  if (!p) return;
  const id = (prompt("Profil-ID (Buchstaben, Ziffern, - _)", "myserver") || "").trim();
  const op = (prompt("Betreibername (Splash)", "My Ragnarok Server") || "").trim();
  if (!id || !op) return;
  try { const r = await invoke("new_profile", { path: p, id, operator: op }); path = r.path; profile = r.profile; render(); status("Profil und Schlüsseldateien angelegt."); }
  catch (e) { status(String(e), false); }
});
$("#btn-save").addEventListener("click", async () => {
  try { const w = await invoke("save_profile", { path, profile }); status("Gespeichert." + (w.length ? " Hinweise: " + w.join(" · ") : "")); }
  catch (e) { status("Nicht gespeichert: " + e, false); }
});
$("#btn-preview").addEventListener("click", async () => {
  try { $("#build-out").textContent = JSON.stringify(await invoke("preview", { profile }), null, 2); } catch (e) { status(String(e), false); }
});
$("#btn-build").addEventListener("click", async () => {
  if (!(await revalidate())) return;
  await invoke("save_profile", { path, profile });
  $("#build-out").textContent = "Baue …";
  try {
    const r = await invoke("build", { path });
    $("#build-out").textContent = JSON.stringify(r, null, 2);
    status(`Release gebaut: ${r.out}`);
  } catch (e) { $("#build-out").textContent = String(e); status("Build fehlgeschlagen", false); }
});
$("#btn-verify").addEventListener("click", async () => {
  const d = await T.dialog.open({ directory: true });
  if (d) invoke("verify_release", { dir: d }).then((m) => status(m)).catch((e) => status(String(e), false));
});
$("#btn-grf-scan").addEventListener("click", async () => {
  try {
    const scan = await invoke("grf_scan", { client: $("#grf-client").value, full: $("#grf-full").checked });
    const keep = $("#grf-keep").checked;
    const same = (a, b) => a.name.toLowerCase() === b.name.toLowerCase() && a.size === b.size && a.tail === b.tail;
    for (const s of scan) {
      if (!keep) profile.grf.file = profile.grf.file.filter((f) => f.name.toLowerCase() !== s.name.toLowerCase() || same(f, s));
      if (!profile.grf.file.some((f) => same(f, s))) profile.grf.file.push(s);
    }
    renderGrf(); revalidate(); status(`${scan.length} GRF(s) eingelesen.`);
  } catch (e) { status("Einlesen fehlgeschlagen: " + e, false); }
});
$("#btn-grf-mod").addEventListener("click", async () => {
  try {
    const f = $("#grf-mod").value;
    const tail = await invoke("grf_tail", { path: f });
    if (!profile.grf.mod.some((m) => m.tail === tail)) profile.grf.mod.push({ tail, note: f.split(/[\\/]/).pop().replace(/[,|]/g, " ") });
    renderGrf(); revalidate();
  } catch (e) { status(String(e), false); }
});
$("#grf-overlays").addEventListener("change", () => { profile.grf.overlays = $("#grf-overlays").value.split(",").map((x) => x.trim()).filter(Boolean); revalidate(); });
const roArgs = () => ({ path, events: $("#ro-events").value, clients: $("#ro-clients").value, active: $("#ro-active").value ? Number($("#ro-active").value) : null, fpPercent: Number($("#ro-fp").value) });
$("#btn-ro-status").addEventListener("click", async () => {
  try { const s = await invoke("rollout_status", roArgs()); $("#ro-out").textContent = JSON.stringify(s, null, 2); status(s.next_stage_ok ? "Nächste Stufe möglich." : "Gate: " + s.reasons.join("; "), s.next_stage_ok); }
  catch (e) { status(String(e), false); }
});
$("#btn-ro-advance").addEventListener("click", async () => {
  try { const st = await invoke("rollout_advance", roArgs()); await openProfile(path); status(`Stufe ${st} gesetzt – Release neu bauen und Server-Konfig ausrollen.`); }
  catch (e) { status(String(e), false); }
});
$("#btn-upd").addEventListener("click", async () => {
  const channel = $("#upd-channel").value;
  try {
    const u = await invoke("studio_update", { channel, install: false });
    if (!u) { $("#upd-out").textContent = `Aktuell (Kanal ${channel}).`; return; }
    $("#upd-out").textContent = `Version ${u.version} (${u.channel}) verfügbar, Manifest-Signatur gültig:\n${u.notes || ""}`;
    if (!confirm(`Studio ${u.version} installieren?`)) return;
    await invoke("studio_update", { channel, install: true });
    $("#upd-out").textContent += "\nInstalliert. Studio neu starten.";
  } catch (e) { $("#upd-out").textContent = "Update abgelehnt oder fehlgeschlagen: " + e; }
});

(async () => {
  try {
    reg = await invoke("get_registry");
    $("#ver").textContent = "v" + (await invoke("studio_version"));
    status(`${reg.modules.length} Module, ${reg.commands.length} Commands geladen. Profil öffnen oder neu anlegen.`);
  } catch (e) { status("Registry nicht gefunden: " + e, false); }
})();
```

`studio/crates/og-cli/src/main.rs`:

```rs
//! `og` – OdinGuard Anti Cheat Studio on the command line (the GUI calls the same og-core functions).

use clap::{Parser, Subcommand};
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::process::ExitCode;

use og_core::{Result, keys, pipeline, profile::Profile, registry::Registry, rollout, sigpack, update};

#[derive(Parser)]
#[command(name = "og", version, about = "OdinGuard Anti Cheat Studio (headless)")]
struct Cli {
    #[command(subcommand)]
    cmd: Cmd,
}

#[derive(Subcommand)]
enum Cmd {
    /// Create a profile with fresh salts and its key files (never overwrites keys)
    New { profile: PathBuf, #[arg(long)] id: String, #[arg(long)] operator: String },
    /// Create the profile's missing key files (never overwrites existing keys)
    Keys { profile: PathBuf },
    /// Check a profile against the module registry
    Validate { profile: PathBuf },
    /// Print the module and command registry as JSON
    Registry,
    /// Print a profile (migrated) as JSON
    Show { profile: PathBuf },
    /// Read the GRFs of a client folder (DATA.INI) into the profile's GRF manifest
    GrfScan { profile: PathBuf, #[arg(long)] client: PathBuf, #[arg(long)] full: bool, #[arg(long, default_value_t = 512)] full_max_mb: u64, #[arg(long)] keep_previous: bool, #[arg(long)] optional: Vec<String> },
    /// Size, tail hash and full hash of a GRF (the values of an og_grf_file / og_grf_mod line)
    GrfHash { grf: PathBuf },
    /// Allow an extra GRF (skin, darkworld variant, ...) by its tail hash, under any name
    GrfAllow { profile: PathBuf, grf: PathBuf, #[arg(long, default_value = "")] note: String },
    /// Tool groups of the profile's signature sources (switch off or change the action with signatures.groups)
    SigGroups { profile: PathBuf, #[arg(long)] json: bool },
    /// Selectable competitive-pack folders of assets/competitive/recipe.toml (JSON)
    PackOptions,
    /// Migrate an older profile to the current schema (keeps a .bak copy)
    Migrate { profile: PathBuf },
    /// What a build would contain
    Preview { profile: PathBuf },
    /// Build the complete release of a profile
    Build { profile: PathBuf },
    /// Verify a release folder (manifest signature and every file hash)
    VerifyRelease { dir: PathBuf, #[arg(long)] key: Option<String> },
    /// Build and sign a signature package
    Sigpack { #[arg(long)] seed: PathBuf, #[arg(long = "source")] sources: Vec<PathBuf>, #[arg(long = "allow")] allow: Vec<PathBuf>, #[arg(long, default_value_t = 1)] version: u32, #[arg(long, default_value = "")] max_action: String, #[arg(long)] out: PathBuf },
    /// Verify a signature package
    SigpackVerify { pack: PathBuf, #[arg(long)] key: String },
    /// Command reference of a profile (Markdown)
    Docs { profile: PathBuf, #[arg(long, default_value = "de")] lang: String },
    /// Rollout status and gate from database exports
    Rollout { profile: PathBuf, #[arg(long)] events: PathBuf, #[arg(long)] clients: PathBuf, #[arg(long)] active: Option<usize>, #[arg(long, default_value_t = 2.0)] fp_percent: f64, #[arg(long)] advance: bool, #[arg(long)] force: bool },
    /// Write `<channel>.json` for a release folder (artifacts need their .sig next to them); sign it afterwards
    UpdateManifest { #[arg(long)] version: String, #[arg(long, default_value = "")] notes: String, #[arg(long)] base_url: String, #[arg(long = "artifact", value_parser = parse_artifact)] artifacts: Vec<(String, PathBuf)>, #[arg(long)] out: PathBuf },
    /// Offline check of a release folder: manifest signature and artifact signatures
    UpdateVerify { manifest: PathBuf, #[arg(long)] pubkey: String },
    /// Check an update channel (Studio, core or signatures) and optionally install
    Update { #[arg(long)] endpoint: String, #[arg(long, default_value = "stable")] channel: String, #[arg(long)] pubkey: String, #[arg(long, default_value = "studio")] key: String, #[arg(long)] current: String, #[arg(long)] target: String, #[arg(long)] dir: PathBuf, #[arg(long)] install: bool, #[arg(long)] rollback: bool },
}

fn parse_artifact(s: &str) -> std::result::Result<(String, PathBuf), String> {
    s.split_once('=').map(|(t, f)| (t.to_string(), PathBuf::from(f))).ok_or_else(|| "expected <target>=<file>".into())
}

fn read_pubkey(arg: &str) -> String {
    std::fs::read_to_string(arg).unwrap_or_else(|_| arg.to_string())
}

fn reg() -> Result<Registry> {
    Registry::load(&og_core::repo_root().join("modules"))
}

fn print<T: serde::Serialize>(v: &T) {
    println!("{}", serde_json::to_string_pretty(v).unwrap_or_default());
}

fn base(p: &Path) -> PathBuf {
    p.parent().unwrap_or(Path::new(".")).to_path_buf()
}

fn run(cli: Cli) -> Result<()> {
    match cli.cmd {
        Cmd::New { profile, id, operator } => {
            let p = Profile::new(&id, &operator)?;
            if profile.exists() {
                return Err(og_core::Error::Invalid(format!("{} exists", profile.display())));
            }
            for k in [&p.keys.server_seed, &p.keys.signing_seed, &p.keys.build_secret] {
                let path = p.resolve(&base(&profile), k);
                println!("{} {}", if keys::ensure(&path)? { "created" } else { "kept" }, path.display());
            }
            p.save(&profile)?;
            println!("profile {} written", profile.display());
        }
        Cmd::Keys { profile } => {
            let p = Profile::load(&profile)?;
            for k in [&p.keys.server_seed, &p.keys.signing_seed, &p.keys.build_secret] {
                let path = p.resolve(&base(&profile), k);
                println!("{} {}", if keys::ensure(&path)? { "created" } else { "kept" }, path.display());
            }
        }
        Cmd::Validate { profile } => {
            let w = Profile::load(&profile)?.validate(&reg()?)?;
            w.iter().for_each(|w| println!("warning: {w}"));
            println!("ok");
        }
        Cmd::Registry => print(&reg()?),
        Cmd::GrfScan { profile, client, full, full_max_mb, keep_previous, optional } => {
            let mut p = Profile::load(&profile)?;
            let mut scan = og_core::grf::scan_client_limited(&client, full, full_max_mb * 1024 * 1024)?;
            for f in &mut scan {
                f.required = !optional.iter().any(|o| o.eq_ignore_ascii_case(&f.name));
                println!("{} {} bytes tail {}{}{}", f.name, f.size, &f.tail[..16], if f.full.is_empty() { "" } else { " + full hash" }, if f.required { "" } else { " (optional)" });
            }
            og_core::grf::merge(&mut p.grf.files, scan, keep_previous);
            p.save(&profile)?;
            println!("{} accepted GRF version(s) in the profile; rebuild and deploy the server config before the patch", p.grf.files.len());
        }
        Cmd::GrfHash { grf } => {
            let (size, tail) = og_core::grf::tail_hash(&grf)?;
            println!("{size} {tail} {}", og_core::manifest::sha256_file(&grf)?.0);
        }
        Cmd::GrfAllow { profile, grf, note } => {
            let mut p = Profile::load(&profile)?;
            let (_, tail) = og_core::grf::tail_hash(&grf)?;
            let note = if note.is_empty() { grf.file_name().map(|n| n.to_string_lossy().into_owned()).unwrap_or_default() } else { note };
            if !p.grf.mods.iter().any(|m| m.tail == tail) {
                p.grf.mods.push(og_core::profile::GrfMod { tail, note: note.replace([',', '|'], " ") });
            }
            p.save(&profile)?;
            println!("allowed: {note}");
        }
        Cmd::PackOptions => print(&og_core::pack::options(&og_core::repo_root().join("assets/competitive/recipe.toml"))?),
        Cmd::SigGroups { profile, json } => {
            let p = Profile::load(&profile)?;
            let b = base(&profile);
            let src: Vec<PathBuf> = p.signatures.sources.iter().map(|s| p.resolve(&b, s)).collect();
            let al: Vec<PathBuf> = p.signatures.allowlist.iter().map(|s| p.resolve(&b, s)).collect();
            let groups = sigpack::catalog(&src.iter().map(PathBuf::as_path).collect::<Vec<_>>(), &al.iter().map(PathBuf::as_path).collect::<Vec<_>>())?;
            if json {
                print(&groups);
                return Ok(());
            }
            for g in groups {
                let set = p.signatures.groups.get(&g.group).cloned().unwrap_or_else(|| "default".into());
                println!("{:<10} {:<5} {:>4} entries ({:>3} client) kinds {:<40} actions {:<20} profile: {set}", g.group, if g.allow { "allow" } else { "sig" }, g.count, g.active, g.kinds.join(","), g.actions.join(","));
            }
        }
        Cmd::Show { profile } => print(&Profile::load(&profile)?),
        Cmd::Migrate { profile } => {
            let text = std::fs::read_to_string(&profile).map_err(|e| og_core::Error::Io(profile.display().to_string(), e))?;
            let p = Profile::load(&profile)?;
            std::fs::write(profile.with_extension("toml.bak"), text).map_err(|e| og_core::Error::Io("backup".into(), e))?;
            p.save(&profile)?;
            println!("migrated to schema {}", og_core::profile::SCHEMA_VERSION);
        }
        Cmd::Preview { profile } => print(&pipeline::preview(&Profile::load(&profile)?, &reg()?)?),
        Cmd::Build { profile } => print(&pipeline::build(&profile, &og_core::repo_root())?),
        Cmd::VerifyRelease { dir, key } => {
            let k = key.and_then(|k| hex::decode(k).ok().and_then(|v| v.try_into().ok()));
            let m = og_core::manifest::verify_release(&dir, k.as_ref())?;
            println!("release ok: profile {}, {} files", m.profile, m.files.len());
        }
        Cmd::Sigpack { seed, sources, allow, version, max_action, out } => {
            let s = keys::read_hex32(&seed)?;
            let (pack, rep) = sigpack::build(&sources.iter().map(PathBuf::as_path).collect::<Vec<_>>(), &allow.iter().map(PathBuf::as_path).collect::<Vec<_>>(), version, &max_action, &s)?;
            std::fs::write(&out, pack).map_err(|e| og_core::Error::Io(out.display().to_string(), e))?;
            print(&rep);
            println!("public key {}", hex::encode(og_core::crypto::public_key(&s)));
        }
        Cmd::SigpackVerify { pack, key } => {
            let data = std::fs::read(&pack).map_err(|e| og_core::Error::Io(pack.display().to_string(), e))?;
            let k: [u8; 32] = hex::decode(key).ok().and_then(|v| v.try_into().ok()).ok_or_else(|| og_core::Error::Invalid("key: 64 hex".into()))?;
            let (v, e) = sigpack::verify(&data, &k)?;
            println!("signature ok, version {v}, {} entries", e.len());
        }
        Cmd::Docs { profile, lang } => print!("{}", og_core::generate::commands_md(&Profile::load(&profile)?, &reg()?, &lang)),
        Cmd::Rollout { profile, events, clients, active, fp_percent, advance, force } => {
            let mut p = Profile::load(&profile)?;
            let s = rollout::status(&p, &events, &clients, active, fp_percent)?;
            print(&s);
            if advance {
                let stage = rollout::advance(&mut p, &s, force)?;
                p.save(&profile)?;
                println!("profile is now at stage {stage}; rebuild and deploy the server config");
            }
        }
        Cmd::UpdateManifest { version, notes, base_url, artifacts, out } => {
            let m = update::write_manifest(&version, &notes, &base_url, &artifacts, &out)?;
            println!("{} written: {} {} platform(s)", out.display(), m.version, m.platforms.len());
        }
        Cmd::UpdateVerify { manifest, pubkey } => {
            let m = update::verify_local(&manifest, &read_pubkey(&pubkey))?;
            println!("ok: {} {}, {} platform(s), manifest and artifact signatures valid", manifest.display(), m.version, m.platforms.len());
        }
        Cmd::Update { endpoint, channel, pubkey, key, current, target, dir, install, rollback } => {
            let pk = update::minisign_key_line(&read_pubkey(&pubkey)).unwrap_or(pubkey);
            let u = update::Updater { endpoint, channel, public_key: pk, dir, allow_loopback_http: false };
            if rollback {
                println!("rolled back to {}", u.rollback(&key)?);
            } else {
                match u.check(&key, &current)? {
                    Some(m) if install => println!("installed {} -> {}", m.version, u.apply(&key, &m, &target)?.display()),
                    Some(m) => println!("update available: {}\n{}", m.version, m.notes),
                    None => println!("up to date"),
                }
            }
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn main() -> ExitCode {
    match run(Cli::parse()) {
        Ok(()) => ExitCode::SUCCESS,
        Err(e) => {
            eprintln!("error: {e}");
            ExitCode::FAILURE
        }
    }
}
```

```rs
// Monocypher (third_party, CC0/BSD-2) is the same crypto library the client DLL and the server module use: the Studio

fn main() {
```

`studio/crates/og-core/src/crypto.rs`:

```rs
//! EdDSA (BLAKE2b, Monocypher) and BLAKE2b, shared with the client DLL and the server module. Thin FFI wrapper.
#![allow(unsafe_code)]

unsafe extern "C" {
    fn crypto_eddsa_key_pair(secret_key: *mut u8, public_key: *mut u8, seed: *mut u8);
    fn crypto_eddsa_sign(signature: *mut u8, secret_key: *const u8, message: *const u8, message_size: usize);
    fn crypto_eddsa_check(signature: *const u8, public_key: *const u8, message: *const u8, message_size: usize) -> i32;
    fn crypto_blake2b(hash: *mut u8, hash_size: usize, message: *const u8, message_size: usize);
    fn crypto_blake2b_keyed(hash: *mut u8, hash_size: usize, key: *const u8, key_size: usize, message: *const u8, message_size: usize);
}

/// Public key of a 32-byte seed (the format of keys/server.seed and the Studio signing key).
pub fn public_key(seed: &[u8; 32]) -> [u8; 32] {
    let mut s = *seed;
    let mut sk = [0u8; 64];
    let mut pk = [0u8; 32];
    // SAFETY: buffers have the sizes Monocypher expects (64, 32, 32); the seed copy is wiped by Monocypher.
    unsafe { crypto_eddsa_key_pair(sk.as_mut_ptr(), pk.as_mut_ptr(), s.as_mut_ptr()) };
    sk.fill(0);
    pk
}

pub fn sign(seed: &[u8; 32], message: &[u8]) -> [u8; 64] {
    let mut s = *seed;
    let mut sk = [0u8; 64];
    let mut pk = [0u8; 32];
    let mut sig = [0u8; 64];
    // SAFETY: fixed-size buffers as required, message pointer/length from a slice.
    unsafe {
        crypto_eddsa_key_pair(sk.as_mut_ptr(), pk.as_mut_ptr(), s.as_mut_ptr());
        crypto_eddsa_sign(sig.as_mut_ptr(), sk.as_ptr(), message.as_ptr(), message.len());
    }
    sk.fill(0);
    sig
}

pub fn verify(public_key: &[u8; 32], message: &[u8], signature: &[u8; 64]) -> bool {
    // SAFETY: fixed-size buffers as required, message pointer/length from a slice.
    unsafe { crypto_eddsa_check(signature.as_ptr(), public_key.as_ptr(), message.as_ptr(), message.len()) == 0 }
}

pub fn blake2b<const N: usize>(message: &[u8]) -> [u8; N] {
    let mut out = [0u8; N];
    // SAFETY: N is the output size (1..=64), message from a slice.
    unsafe { crypto_blake2b(out.as_mut_ptr(), N, message.as_ptr(), message.len()) };
    out
}

pub fn blake2b_keyed<const N: usize>(key: &[u8], message: &[u8]) -> [u8; N] {
    let mut out = [0u8; N];
    // SAFETY: N is the output size (1..=64), key and message from slices (key at most 64 bytes, checked by callers).
    unsafe { crypto_blake2b_keyed(out.as_mut_ptr(), N, key.as_ptr(), key.len(), message.as_ptr(), message.len()) };
    out
}

/// Random bytes from the OS (macOS/Linux /dev/urandom, Windows via std's hashing seed is not enough, so read the
/// file where it exists and fail otherwise).
pub fn random<const N: usize>() -> std::io::Result<[u8; N]> {
    use std::io::Read;
    let mut out = [0u8; N];
    std::fs::File::open("/dev/urandom")?.read_exact(&mut out)?;
    Ok(out)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn sign_verify_and_tamper() {
        let seed = [7u8; 32];
        let pk = public_key(&seed);
        let sig = sign(&seed, b"odinguard");
        assert!(verify(&pk, b"odinguard", &sig));
        assert!(!verify(&pk, b"odinguarD", &sig));
    }
}
```
