`studio/crates/og-core/src/generate.rs`:

```rs
//! Generated files of a profile: client build headers (og_modules.h, og_profile.h, og_modules.mk, resource script),
//! the server config (conf/import/odinguard_conf.txt, secrets env file) and the command reference.

use std::fmt::Write as _;
use std::path::Path;

use crate::profile::Profile;
use crate::registry::Registry;
use crate::{Error, Result};

/// Values derived from the profile and its secrets.
pub struct Derived {
    pub server_seed: [u8; 32],
    pub server_pub: [u8; 32],
    pub build_secret: [u8; 32],
    pub proto_salt: [u8; 16],
    pub tag: [u8; 16],
    pub mask: [u8; 32],
}

impl Derived {
    pub fn new(p: &Profile, server_seed: [u8; 32], build_secret: [u8; 32]) -> Result<Self> {
        let seed = hex::decode(&p.general.variation_seed).map_err(|_| Error::Invalid("variation_seed".into()))?;
        let server_pub = crate::crypto::public_key(&server_seed);
        let mut m = b"OdinGuard/proto-salt".to_vec();
        m.extend_from_slice(&seed);
        m.extend_from_slice(&server_pub);
        let proto_salt: [u8; 16] = crate::crypto::blake2b(&m);
        let mut t = b"OdinGuard/tag".to_vec();
        t.extend_from_slice(&proto_salt);
        let tag: [u8; 16] = crate::crypto::blake2b(&t);
        let mut k = b"OdinGuard/mask".to_vec();
        k.extend_from_slice(&seed);
        k.extend_from_slice(p.general.id.as_bytes());
        let mask: [u8; 32] = crate::crypto::blake2b(&k);
        Ok(Derived { server_seed, server_pub, build_secret, proto_salt, tag, mask })
    }
}

fn c_bytes(b: &[u8]) -> String {
    let parts: Vec<String> = b.iter().map(|x| format!("0x{x:02x}")).collect();
    format!("{{{}}}", parts.join(","))
}

fn masked(v: &[u8], mask: &[u8; 32]) -> Vec<u8> {
    v.iter().enumerate().map(|(i, b)| b ^ mask[i & 31]).collect()
}

fn c_string(s: &str) -> String {
    s.chars().filter(|c| !c.is_control()).map(|c| if c == '"' || c == '\\' { format!("\\{c}") } else { c.to_string() }).collect()
}

/// Protected files of the file-range challenge (index = position, same list in client and server).
pub fn protected_files(p: &Profile) -> Vec<(&'static str, bool)> {
    let mut v = vec![("odin.grf", true)];
    if p.modules.iter().any(|m| m == "competitive-pack") {
        v.push(("odin-dark.grf", false));
    }
    v
}

/// Client sources of the selected modules in a profile-specific order (build variation: different code layout).
pub fn client_sources(p: &Profile, reg: &Registry) -> Vec<String> {
    let seed = hex::decode(&p.general.variation_seed).unwrap_or_default();
    let mut src: Vec<String> = reg
        .modules
        .iter()
        .filter(|m| p.modules.contains(&m.id))
        .flat_map(|m| m.client_src.iter().cloned())
        .collect();
    src.sort_by_key(|f| {
        let mut m = seed.clone();
        m.extend_from_slice(f.as_bytes());
        crate::crypto::blake2b::<8>(&m)
    });
    src
}

pub fn modules_h(p: &Profile, reg: &Registry) -> String {
    let mut s = String::from("/* Generated by the OdinGuard Studio. Do not edit. */\n#ifndef OG_MODULES_H\n#define OG_MODULES_H\n");
    for m in &reg.modules {
        if let Some(d) = &m.define {
            let _ = writeln!(s, "#define {d} {}", u8::from(p.modules.contains(&m.id)));
        }
    }
    s.push_str("#endif\n");
    s
}

pub fn modules_mk(p: &Profile, reg: &Registry) -> String {
    let files: Vec<String> = client_sources(p, reg).iter().map(|f| if f.starts_with("..") { f.trim_start_matches("../").to_string() } else { format!("src/{f}") }).collect();
    let files: Vec<String> = files.into_iter().map(|f| if f.starts_with("proto/") { format!("../{f}") } else { f }).collect();
    format!("# Generated by the OdinGuard Studio (module selection and link order of the profile).\nOG_SRC := {}\n", files.join(" "))
}

pub fn profile_h(p: &Profile, d: &Derived) -> String {
    let salt = p.general.hwid_salt.as_bytes();
    let files = protected_files(p);
    let names: Vec<String> = files.iter().map(|(f, _)| format!("\"{f}\"")).collect();
    let ports: Vec<String> = p.general.ports.iter().map(u16::to_string).collect();
    let variation = u32::from_le_bytes([d.mask[0], d.mask[1], d.mask[2], d.mask[3]]);
    format!(
        "/* Generated by the OdinGuard Studio for profile '{id}'. Secrets are masked. Do not edit. */\n\
#ifndef OG_PROFILE_H\n#define OG_PROFILE_H\n\
#define OG_PROFILE_ID \"{id}\"\n\
#define OG_PROFILE_OPERATOR \"{op}\"\n\
#define OG_PROFILE_BUILD \"{build}\"\n\
#define OG_PROFILE_PORTS \"{ports}\"\n\
#define OG_PROFILE_SPLASH_MS {splash}\n\
#define OG_PROFILE_VARIATION 0x{variation:08x}u\n\
#define OG_PROFILE_MASK {mask}\n\
#define OG_PROFILE_HWID_SALT_LEN {salt_len}\n\
#define OG_PROFILE_HWID_SALT {salt}\n\
#define OG_PROFILE_PROTO_SALT {proto}\n\
#define OG_PROFILE_BUILD_SECRET {secret}\n\
#define OG_PROFILE_FILES {{{files}}}\n\
#define OG_PROFILE_NFILES {nfiles}\n\
#define OG_PROFILE_SERVER_PUBKEY {pubkey}\n\
#endif\n",
        id = c_string(&p.general.id),
        op = c_string(&p.general.operator),
        build = c_string(&p.general.client_build),
        ports = ports.join(","),
        splash = if p.modules.iter().any(|m| m == "branding") { p.general.splash_ms } else { 0 },
        mask = c_bytes(&d.mask),
        salt_len = salt.len(),
        salt = c_bytes(&masked(salt, &d.mask)),
        proto = c_bytes(&masked(&d.proto_salt, &d.mask)),
        secret = c_bytes(&masked(&d.build_secret, &d.mask)),
        files = names.join(", "),
        nfiles = files.len(),
        pubkey = c_bytes(&d.server_pub),
    )
}

pub fn resource_rc(p: &Profile) -> String {
    let splash = if p.modules.iter().any(|m| m == "branding") { "100 BITMAP \"splash.bmp\"\n" } else { "" };
    format!(
        "#include <winver.h>\n#include \"og_version.h\"\n#include \"og_profile.h\"\n\n1 ICON \"odinguard.ico\"\n{splash}\n\
VS_VERSION_INFO VERSIONINFO\nFILEVERSION OG_VER_MAJOR, OG_VER_MINOR, OG_VER_PATCH, 0\nPRODUCTVERSION OG_VER_MAJOR, OG_VER_MINOR, OG_VER_PATCH, 0\n\
FILEOS VOS_NT_WINDOWS32\nFILETYPE VFT_DLL\nBEGIN\n    BLOCK \"StringFileInfo\"\n    BEGIN\n        BLOCK \"040904B0\"\n        BEGIN\n\
            VALUE \"CompanyName\", OG_PROFILE_OPERATOR\n            VALUE \"FileDescription\", \"OdinGuard Anti Cheat\"\n\
            VALUE \"FileVersion\", OG_VERSION_STR\n            VALUE \"InternalName\", \"odinguard\"\n\
            VALUE \"LegalCopyright\", \"OdinGuard Anti Cheat\"\n            VALUE \"OriginalFilename\", \"odinguard.dll\"\n\
            VALUE \"ProductName\", \"OdinGuard Anti Cheat\"\n            VALUE \"ProductVersion\", OG_VERSION_STR\n        END\n    END\n\
    BLOCK \"VarFileInfo\"\n    BEGIN\n        VALUE \"Translation\", 0x0409, 1200\n    END\nEND\n"
    )
}

fn conf_value(v: &toml::Value) -> String {
    match v {
        toml::Value::Boolean(b) => if *b { "yes".into() } else { "no".into() },
        toml::Value::String(s) => s.clone(),
        other => other.to_string(),
    }
}

/// Server config of the profile (goes to conf/import/odinguard_conf.txt). Secrets are not in it, they go to the env
/// file (ODINGUARD_KEY, ODINGUARD_PROTO_SALT, ODINGUARD_BUILD_SECRET).
/// `built`: GRFs of the release (odin.grf, odin-dark.grf) that are added to the GRF manifest automatically.
pub fn server_conf(p: &Profile, reg: &Registry, sigpack_key: &[u8; 32], built: &[crate::profile::GrfFile], ref_dir: &str) -> String {
    let mut s = format!(
        "// Generated by the OdinGuard Studio for profile '{}' (rollout stage {}). Edit the profile, not this file.\n\
// Secrets come from the environment (secrets/odinguard.env): ODINGUARD_KEY, ODINGUARD_PROTO_SALT, ODINGUARD_BUILD_SECRET.\n",
        p.general.id, p.rollout.stage
    );
    let _ = writeln!(s, "og_enable: yes");
    let _ = writeln!(s, "og_log_only: {}", if p.rollout.stage == 1 { "yes" } else { "no" });
    let required = p.rollout.stage >= 4 || p.param(reg, "core", "required").and_then(|v| v.as_bool()) == Some(true);
    let _ = writeln!(s, "og_required: {}", if required { "yes" } else { "no" });
    s.push_str("\n// modules\n");
    for m in &reg.modules {
        let on = p.modules.contains(&m.id);
        if let Some(k) = &m.server_key
            && k != "og_enable"
        {
            let _ = writeln!(s, "{k}: {}", if on { "yes" } else { "no" });
        }
        if !on {
            continue;
        }
        for prm in &m.params {
            let Some(conf) = &prm.conf else { continue };
            if (m.id == "core" && (prm.name == "required" || prm.name == "log_only")) || (m.kind == "challenge" && prm.name == "enabled") {
                continue;
            }
            if let Some(v) = p.param(reg, &m.id, &prm.name) {
                let _ = writeln!(s, "{conf}: {}", conf_value(&v));
            }
        }
    }
    s.push_str("\n// references (copied by the server package)\n");
    if p.modules.iter().any(|m| m == "integrity") {
        let _ = writeln!(s, "og_guard_file: {ref_dir}/odinguard.dll");
    }
    for (i, (f, req)) in protected_files(p).iter().enumerate() {
        let _ = writeln!(s, "og_protected_file: {i},{ref_dir}/{f},{}", if *req { "yes" } else { "no" });
    }
    if p.modules.iter().any(|m| m == "cheat-signatures") {
        let _ = writeln!(s, "og_sigpack: {ref_dir}/odinguard.sigpack\nog_sigpack_key: {}\nog_sigpack_min_version: {}", hex::encode(sigpack_key), p.signatures.version);
    }
    s.push_str("\n// commands\n");
    for c in &reg.commands {
        let set = p.commands.get(&c.id).cloned().unwrap_or_default();
        let enabled = p.commands.get(&c.id).is_none_or(|x| x.enabled) && p.modules.contains(&c.module);
        let _ = writeln!(s, "og_cmd_{}: {}", c.id, if enabled { "yes" } else { "no" });
        let _ = writeln!(s, "og_cmdgroup_{}: {}", c.id, set.group.unwrap_or(c.group));
        let _ = writeln!(s, "og_cmdrate_{}: {}", c.id, set.rate_ms.unwrap_or(c.rate_ms));
        if let Some(n) = &set.name
            && c.kind == "client"
        {
            let _ = writeln!(s, "og_cmdname_{}: {n}", c.id);
        }
    }
    if p.modules.iter().any(|m| m == "grf-rules") {
        s.push_str("\n// GRF manifest (og grf-scan); several lines per name = accepted versions during a patch rollout\n");
        let _ = writeln!(s, "og_grf_modified_action: {}", p.grf.modified_action);
        let _ = writeln!(s, "og_grf_unknown_action: {}", p.grf.unknown_action);
        let _ = writeln!(s, "og_grf_missing_action: {}", p.grf.missing_action);
        for f in built.iter().chain(&p.grf.files) {
            let full = if f.full.is_empty() { "-" } else { &f.full };
            let _ = writeln!(s, "og_grf_file: {},{},{},{full},{}", f.name, f.size, f.tail, if f.required { "yes" } else { "no" });
        }
        for m in &p.grf.mods {
            let _ = writeln!(s, "og_grf_mod: {},{}", m.tail, m.note);
        }
        for o in &p.grf.overlays {
            let _ = writeln!(s, "og_grf_overlay: {o}");
        }
    }
    s
}

pub fn secrets_env(d: &Derived) -> String {
    format!(
        "# OdinGuard Anti Cheat server secrets. Keep out of git and out of the client package.\n\
ODINGUARD_KEY={}\nODINGUARD_PROTO_SALT={}\nODINGUARD_BUILD_SECRET={}\n",
        hex::encode(d.server_seed),
        hex::encode(d.proto_salt),
        hex::encode(d.build_secret)
    )
}

/// Command reference in Markdown (players and GMs), language "de" or "en".
pub fn commands_md(p: &Profile, reg: &Registry, lang: &str) -> String {
    let de = lang == "de";
    let mut s = String::new();
    let _ = writeln!(s, "<!-- generated by the OdinGuard Studio from modules/commands.toml and profile '{}' -->", p.general.id);
    for (title, players) in [(if de { "Spieler" } else { "Players" }, true), (if de { "Nur GM" } else { "GM only" }, false)] {
        let _ = writeln!(s, "\n### {title}\n\n| Command | {} |\n|---|---|", if de { "Was es macht" } else { "What it does" });
        for c in &reg.commands {
            let set = p.commands.get(&c.id).cloned().unwrap_or_default();
            if !(p.commands.get(&c.id).is_none_or(|x| x.enabled) && p.modules.contains(&c.module)) {
                continue;
            }
            if (set.group.unwrap_or(c.group) == 0) != players {
                continue;
            }
            let name = set.name.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| c.name.clone());
            let sym = if c.kind == "client" { "!" } else { "@" };
            let params = if c.params.is_empty() { String::new() } else { format!(" {}", c.params) };
            let _ = writeln!(s, "| `{sym}{name}{params}` | {} |", if de { &c.help_de } else { &c.help_en }.replace('|', "\\|"));
        }
    }
    s
}

pub fn write(path: &Path, text: &str) -> Result<()> {
    if let Some(d) = path.parent() {
        std::fs::create_dir_all(d).map_err(|e| Error::Io(d.display().to_string(), e))?;
    }
    std::fs::write(path, text).map_err(|e| Error::Io(path.display().to_string(), e))
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn reg() -> Registry {
        Registry::load(&crate::repo_root().join("modules")).unwrap()
    }

    #[test]
    fn minimal_profile_selects_only_core_sources() {
        let r = reg();
        let mut p = Profile::new("min", "Min").unwrap();
        p.modules = vec!["core".into(), "rate-limit".into()];
        let src = client_sources(&p, &r);
        assert!(src.iter().all(|f| r.module("core").unwrap().client_src.contains(f)), "{src:?}");
        let h = modules_h(&p, &r);
        assert!(h.contains("#define OG_MOD_CORE 1") && h.contains("#define OG_MOD_DETECT 0"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn secrets_are_masked_in_the_header() {
        let p = Profile::new("x", "X \"quoted\"").unwrap();
        let d = Derived::new(&p, [1u8; 32], [0xAB; 32]).unwrap();
        let h = profile_h(&p, &d);
        assert!(!h.contains(&c_bytes(&[0xAB; 32])), "build secret in clear");
        assert!(h.contains("X \\\"quoted\\\""));
    }

    #[test]
    fn server_conf_follows_rollout_stage_and_commands() {
        let r = reg();
        let mut p = Profile::new("x", "X").unwrap();
        p.rollout.stage = 4;
        p.commands.insert("lgp".into(), crate::profile::CommandSetting { enabled: false, ..Default::default() });
        p.commands.insert("ping".into(), crate::profile::CommandSetting { enabled: true, name: Some("latency".into()), ..Default::default() });
        p.grf.files.push(crate::profile::GrfFile { name: "data.grf".into(), size: 9, tail: "a".repeat(64), full: String::new(), required: true });
        p.grf.mods.push(crate::profile::GrfMod { tail: "b".repeat(64), note: "darkworld".into() });
        let c = server_conf(&p, &r, &[0; 32], &[], "conf/odinguard");
        assert!(c.contains(&format!("og_grf_file: data.grf,9,{},-,yes", "a".repeat(64))));
        assert!(c.contains(&format!("og_grf_mod: {},darkworld", "b".repeat(64))));
        assert!(c.contains("og_log_only: no") && c.contains("og_required: yes"));
        assert!(c.contains("og_cmd_lgp: no") && c.contains("og_cmdname_ping: latency"));
        assert!(c.contains("og_rate_limit: no"), "rate-limit is not in the default set");
        let md = commands_md(&p, &r, "de");
        assert!(md.contains("`!latency`") && !md.contains("`@lgp"));
    }
}
```

`studio/crates/og-core/src/grf.rs`:

```rs
//! GRF manifest helpers for the grf-rules module: the "tail hash" the guard checks at every scan (SHA-256 of the
//! 46-byte header plus everything from the file table to the end of the file; client/src/og_assets.c computes the
//! same) and the client scan (`og grf-scan`) that lists every GRF of a client's DATA.INI.

use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
use std::io::{Read, Seek, SeekFrom};
use std::path::Path;

use crate::profile::GrfFile;
use crate::{Error, Result};

/// (file size, tail hash hex)
pub fn tail_hash(path: &Path) -> Result<(u64, String)> {
    let io = |e| Error::Io(path.display().to_string(), e);
    let mut f = std::fs::File::open(path).map_err(io)?;
    let size = f.metadata().map_err(io)?.len();
    if size < 46 {
        return Err(Error::Invalid(format!("{}: not a GRF (too small)", path.display())));
    }
    let mut h = [0u8; 46];
    f.read_exact(&mut h).map_err(io)?;
    let version = u32::from_le_bytes([h[42], h[43], h[44], h[45]]);
    let off = if version == 0x300 && h[35..38] == [0, 0, 0] {
        u64::from_le_bytes(h[30..38].try_into().unwrap_or_default())
    } else {
        u64::from(u32::from_le_bytes([h[30], h[31], h[32], h[33]]))
    };
    let mut d = Sha256::new();
    d.update(h);
    let pos = 46u64.saturating_add(off);
    if pos < size {
        f.seek(SeekFrom::Start(pos)).map_err(io)?;
        let mut buf = vec![0u8; 1 << 16];
        loop {
            let n = f.read(&mut buf).map_err(io)?;
            if n == 0 {
                break;
            }
            d.update(&buf[..n]);
        }
    }
    Ok((size, hex::encode(d.finalize())))
}

/// GRF names of a client's DATA.INI ([Data] 0=..., 1=..., in priority order).
pub fn data_ini(client: &Path) -> Result<Vec<String>> {
    let path = ["DATA.INI", "data.ini", "Data.ini"].iter().map(|n| client.join(n)).find(|p| p.is_file()).ok_or_else(|| Error::Invalid(format!("{}: no DATA.INI", client.display())))?;
    let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&std::fs::read(&path).map_err(|e| Error::Io(path.display().to_string(), e))?).into_owned();
    let mut section = String::new();
    let mut v: Vec<(u32, String)> = Vec::new();
    for line in text.lines().map(str::trim) {
        if line.starts_with('[') {
            section = line.trim_matches(['[', ']']).to_ascii_lowercase();
        } else if section == "data"
            && let Some((k, val)) = line.split_once('=')
            && let Ok(n) = k.trim().parse::<u32>()
            && !val.trim().is_empty()
        {
            v.push((n, val.trim().to_string()));
        }
    }
    v.sort();
    Ok(v.into_iter().map(|(_, n)| n).collect())
}

/// Scans the GRFs of a client folder. `full` = also the whole-file SHA-256 for archives up to `full_max` bytes (the
/// guard re-reads those at every start in the background; larger ones rely on the tail hash, which every GRF tool
/// and patcher changes when it writes the archive).
/// The GRFs the release itself ships (odin.grf, odin-dark.grf) are skipped: the build adds their hashes to the
/// manifest, so a client that already has a release installed scans the same as one without.
pub fn scan_client_limited(client: &Path, full: bool, full_max: u64) -> Result<Vec<GrfFile>> {
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    for name in data_ini(client)? {
        let p = client.join(&name);
        if RELEASE_GRFS.iter().any(|r| r.eq_ignore_ascii_case(&name)) || !p.is_file() {
            continue;
        }
        let (size, tail) = tail_hash(&p)?;
        let full = if full && size <= full_max { crate::manifest::sha256_file(&p)?.0 } else { String::new() };
        out.push(GrfFile { name, size, tail, full, required: true });
    }
    Ok(out)
}

pub const RELEASE_GRFS: [&str; 2] = ["odin.grf", "odin-dark.grf"];

pub const FULL_HASH_MAX: u64 = 512 * 1024 * 1024;

pub fn scan_client(client: &Path, full: bool) -> Result<Vec<GrfFile>> {
    scan_client_limited(client, full, FULL_HASH_MAX)
}

/// Merges a new scan into the accepted list: new versions are added, old versions of the same name are kept when
/// `keep_previous` (patch rollout: old and new clients both pass), otherwise replaced.
pub fn merge(list: &mut Vec<GrfFile>, scan: Vec<GrfFile>, keep_previous: bool) {
    for s in scan {
        if !keep_previous {
            list.retain(|f| !f.name.eq_ignore_ascii_case(&s.name) || (f.size == s.size && f.tail == s.tail));
        }
        if !list.iter().any(|f| f.name.eq_ignore_ascii_case(&s.name) && f.size == s.size && f.tail == s.tail) {
            list.push(s);
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn fake_grf(table_offset: u32, body: &[u8], table: &[u8]) -> Vec<u8> {
        let mut h = vec![0u8; 46];
        h[..15].copy_from_slice(b"Master of Magic");
        h[30..34].copy_from_slice(&table_offset.to_le_bytes());
        h[42..46].copy_from_slice(&0x200u32.to_le_bytes());
        [h, body.to_vec(), table.to_vec()].concat()
    }

    #[test]
    fn tail_hash_covers_header_and_table_only() {
        let d = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let a = d.path().join("a.grf");
        std::fs::write(&a, fake_grf(4, b"AAAA", b"table")).unwrap();
        let (size, t1) = tail_hash(&a).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(size, 46 + 4 + 5);
        std::fs::write(&a, fake_grf(4, b"BBBB", b"table")).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(tail_hash(&a).unwrap().1, t1, "content outside the table is the full hash's job");
        std::fs::write(&a, fake_grf(4, b"AAAA", b"tablf")).unwrap();
        assert_ne!(tail_hash(&a).unwrap().1, t1);
    }

    #[test]
    fn scan_and_merge_keep_rollout_versions() {
        let d = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        std::fs::write(d.path().join("DATA.INI"), "[Data]\r\n1=data.grf\r\n0=odin.grf\r\n2=missing.grf\r\n").unwrap();
        std::fs::write(d.path().join("odin.grf"), fake_grf(0, b"", b"t1")).unwrap();
        std::fs::write(d.path().join("data.grf"), fake_grf(0, b"", b"t2")).unwrap();
        let s = scan_client(d.path(), true).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(s.iter().map(|f| f.name.as_str()).collect::<Vec<_>>(), ["data.grf"], "release GRFs are added by the build");
        let mut list = s.clone();
        std::fs::write(d.path().join("data.grf"), fake_grf(0, b"", b"t3")).unwrap();
        merge(&mut list, scan_client(d.path(), false).unwrap(), true);
        assert_eq!(list.iter().filter(|f| f.name == "data.grf").count(), 2);
        merge(&mut list, scan_client(d.path(), false).unwrap(), false);
        assert_eq!(list.iter().filter(|f| f.name == "data.grf").count(), 1);
    }
}
```

`studio/crates/og-core/src/keys.rs`:

```rs
//! Key files of a profile: server seed (handshake), signing seed (signature packages and manifests), build secret
//! (nonce/time challenges). 64 hex characters each; created once, never overwritten, never committed.

use std::path::Path;

use crate::{Error, Result};

pub fn read_hex32(path: &Path) -> Result<[u8; 32]> {
    let text = std::fs::read_to_string(path).map_err(|e| Error::Io(path.display().to_string(), e))?;
    let v = hex::decode(text.trim()).map_err(|_| Error::Invalid(format!("{}: 64 hex characters expected", path.display())))?;
    v.try_into().map_err(|_| Error::Invalid(format!("{}: 64 hex characters expected", path.display())))
}

/// Creates the key file with a random value if it does not exist. Returns true when it was created.
pub fn ensure(path: &Path) -> Result<bool> {
    if path.exists() {
        read_hex32(path)?;
        return Ok(false);
    }
    if let Some(dir) = path.parent() {
        std::fs::create_dir_all(dir).map_err(|e| Error::Io(dir.display().to_string(), e))?;
    }
    let v: [u8; 32] = crate::crypto::random().map_err(|e| Error::Io("random".into(), e))?;
    std::fs::write(path, format!("{}\n", hex::encode(v))).map_err(|e| Error::Io(path.display().to_string(), e))?;
    #[cfg(unix)]
    {
        use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt;
        let _ = std::fs::set_permissions(path, std::fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o600));
    }
    Ok(true)
}
```

```rs
//! OdinGuard Anti Cheat Studio core. The GUI (apps/studio) and the CLI (og-cli) are thin frontends of this crate.

pub mod crypto;
pub mod generate;
pub mod grf;
pub mod pack;
pub mod keys;
pub mod manifest;
pub mod pipeline;

pub mod registry;
pub mod rollout;
pub mod sigpack;
pub mod update;

#[derive(Debug, thiserror::Error)]
pub enum Error {
    #[error("{0}: {1}")]
    Io(String, std::io::Error),
    #[error("{0}: {1}")]
    Parse(String, String),
    #[error("{0}")]
    Invalid(String),
    #[error("build step failed: {0}")]
    Build(String),
    #[error("signature check failed: {0}")]
    Signature(String),
}

pub type Result<T> = std::result::Result<T, Error>;

/// Root of the OdinGuard repository (client sources, registry, assets) used by builds.
pub fn repo_root() -> std::path::PathBuf {
    std::env::var_os("ODINGUARD_ROOT")
        .map(std::path::PathBuf::from)
        .unwrap_or_else(|| std::path::Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).join("../../.."))
}
```

`studio/crates/og-core/src/manifest.rs`:

```rs
//! Release manifest: SHA-256 and size of every shipped file, signed with the Studio signing key (EdDSA/BLAKE2b).
//! `manifest.json` + `manifest.sig` (hex) + `signing.pub` (hex). Secrets are never listed.

use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
use std::path::Path;

use crate::{Error, Result};

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
pub struct FileEntry {
    pub path: String,
    pub sha256: String,
    pub size: u64,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
pub struct Manifest {
    pub product: String,
    pub version: String,
    pub protocol: u32,
    pub profile: String,
    pub rollout_stage: u8,
    pub sigpack_version: u32,
    pub files: Vec<FileEntry>,
}

pub fn sha256_file(path: &Path) -> Result<(String, u64)> {
    let data = std::fs::read(path).map_err(|e| Error::Io(path.display().to_string(), e))?;
    Ok((hex::encode(Sha256::digest(&data)), data.len() as u64))
}

/// Lists every file below `root` (sorted, '/' separators) except the excluded top-level folders.
pub fn collect(root: &Path, exclude: &[&str]) -> Result<Vec<FileEntry>> {
    fn walk(dir: &Path, root: &Path, exclude: &[&str], out: &mut Vec<FileEntry>) -> Result<()> {
        let mut items: Vec<_> = std::fs::read_dir(dir).map_err(|e| Error::Io(dir.display().to_string(), e))?.flatten().collect();
        items.sort_by_key(|e| e.file_name());
        for e in items {
            let p = e.path();
            let rel = p.strip_prefix(root).unwrap_or(&p).to_string_lossy().replace('\\', "/");
            if exclude.iter().any(|x| rel == *x || rel.starts_with(&format!("{x}/"))) {
                continue;
            }
            if p.is_dir() {
                walk(&p, root, exclude, out)?;
            } else {
                let (sha256, size) = sha256_file(&p)?;
                out.push(FileEntry { path: rel, sha256, size });
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    }
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    walk(root, root, exclude, &mut out)?;
    Ok(out)
}

pub fn write_signed(dir: &Path, m: &Manifest, signing_seed: &[u8; 32]) -> Result<()> {
    let json = serde_json::to_vec_pretty(m).map_err(|e| Error::Invalid(e.to_string()))?;
    let sig = crate::crypto::sign(signing_seed, &json);
    let w = |name: &str, data: &[u8]| std::fs::write(dir.join(name), data).map_err(|e| Error::Io(name.into(), e));
    w("manifest.json", &json)?;
    w("manifest.sig", hex::encode(sig).as_bytes())?;
    w("signing.pub", hex::encode(crate::crypto::public_key(signing_seed)).as_bytes())
}

/// Checks the signature and every file hash of a release folder. Returns the manifest.
pub fn verify_release(dir: &Path, pinned_key: Option<&[u8; 32]>) -> Result<Manifest> {
    let read = |name: &str| std::fs::read(dir.join(name)).map_err(|e| Error::Io(name.into(), e));
    let json = read("manifest.json")?;
    let sig: [u8; 64] = hex::decode(String::from_utf8_lossy(&read("manifest.sig")?).trim())
        .ok()
        .and_then(|v| v.try_into().ok())
        .ok_or_else(|| Error::Signature("manifest.sig".into()))?;
    let key: [u8; 32] = match pinned_key {
        Some(k) => *k,
        None => hex::decode(String::from_utf8_lossy(&read("signing.pub")?).trim())
            .ok()
            .and_then(|v| v.try_into().ok())
            .ok_or_else(|| Error::Signature("signing.pub".into()))?,
    };
    if !crate::crypto::verify(&key, &json, &sig) {
        return Err(Error::Signature("manifest signature invalid".into()));
    }
    let m: Manifest = serde_json::from_slice(&json).map_err(|e| Error::Parse("manifest.json".into(), e.to_string()))?;
    for f in &m.files {
        let (h, size) = sha256_file(&dir.join(&f.path))?;
        if h != f.sha256 || size != f.size {
            return Err(Error::Signature(format!("{} differs from the manifest", f.path)));
        }
    }
    Ok(m)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn signed_release_detects_changes() {
        let d = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        std::fs::create_dir_all(d.path().join("client")).unwrap();
        std::fs::write(d.path().join("client/a.dll"), b"abc").unwrap();
        std::fs::write(d.path().join("secret.env"), b"x").unwrap();
        let files = collect(d.path(), &["secret.env"]).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(files.len(), 1);
        let m = Manifest { product: "OdinGuard Anti Cheat".into(), version: "1.0.0".into(), protocol: 2, profile: "t".into(), rollout_stage: 1, sigpack_version: 1, files };
        let seed = [9u8; 32];
        write_signed(d.path(), &m, &seed).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(verify_release(d.path(), None).unwrap(), m);
        assert!(verify_release(d.path(), Some(&crate::crypto::public_key(&[8u8; 32]))).is_err(), "foreign key");
        std::fs::write(d.path().join("client/a.dll"), b"abd").unwrap();
        assert!(verify_release(d.path(), None).is_err(), "changed file");
    }
}
```

`studio/crates/og-core/src/pack.rs`:

```rs
//! Competitive-pack recipe (assets/competitive/recipe.toml): the selectable staging folders in copy order.

use serde::Serialize;
use std::path::Path;

use crate::{Error, Result};

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, PartialEq)]
pub struct PackOption {
    /// staging folder name, the value stored in the profile (assets.competitive)
    pub staging: String,
    pub category: String,
    pub title: String,
    pub description: String,
    pub fairness: String,
    pub default: bool,
    /// another staging folder this one needs (floor-flat-* needs flat-maps-*)
    pub requires: String,
    pub files: i64,
    pub grf_bytes: i64,
}

fn s(v: &toml::Value, k: &str) -> String {
    v.get(k).and_then(|x| x.as_str()).unwrap_or_default().to_string()
}

fn i(v: &toml::Value, k: &str) -> i64 {
    v.get(k).and_then(|x| x.as_integer()).unwrap_or_default()
}

/// Options of the recipe, sorted by its `copy_order` (later folders overwrite earlier ones).
pub fn options(recipe: &Path) -> Result<Vec<PackOption>> {
    let text = std::fs::read_to_string(recipe).map_err(|e| Error::Io(recipe.display().to_string(), e))?;
    let v: toml::Value = toml::from_str(&text).map_err(|e| Error::Parse(recipe.display().to_string(), e.to_string()))?;
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    for c in v.get("category").and_then(|c| c.as_array()).cloned().unwrap_or_default() {
        let (id, title) = (s(&c, "id"), s(&c, "title"));
        let default_variant = s(&c, "default_variant");
        let base = PackOption {
            staging: s(&c, "staging"),
            category: id.clone(),
            title: title.clone(),
            description: s(&c, "description"),
            fairness: s(&c, "fairness"),
            default: c.get("default").and_then(|x| x.as_bool()).unwrap_or(false),
            requires: String::new(),
            files: i(&c, "files"),
            grf_bytes: i(&c, "grf_bytes"),
        };
        if !base.staging.is_empty() {
            out.push(base.clone());
        }
        for var in c.get("variant").and_then(|x| x.as_array()).cloned().unwrap_or_default() {
            let vid = s(&var, "id");
            out.push(PackOption {
                staging: s(&var, "staging"),
                title: format!("{title} ({vid})"),
                description: [base.description.clone(), s(&var, "maps")].into_iter().filter(|x| !x.is_empty()).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(" – "),
                default: base.default && !default_variant.is_empty() && vid == default_variant,
                requires: s(&var, "requires"),
                files: i(&var, "files"),
                grf_bytes: i(&var, "grf_bytes"),
                ..base.clone()
            });
        }
    }
    let order: Vec<String> = v.get("copy_order").and_then(|x| x.as_array()).map(|a| a.iter().filter_map(|x| x.as_str().map(str::to_string)).collect()).unwrap_or_default();
    out.retain(|o| !o.staging.is_empty());
    out.sort_by_key(|o| order.iter().position(|x| *x == o.staging).unwrap_or(usize::MAX));
    Ok(out)
}

/// The selected staging folders in recipe order; unknown names keep their place after the known ones. Checks that
/// required folders are selected too.
pub fn ordered_selection(recipe: &Path, selected: &[String]) -> Result<Vec<String>> {
    if !recipe.is_file() {
        return Ok(selected.to_vec());
    }
    let opts = options(recipe)?;
    for o in opts.iter().filter(|o| selected.contains(&o.staging) && !o.requires.is_empty()) {
        if !selected.contains(&o.requires) {
            return Err(Error::Invalid(format!("competitive category {} needs {}", o.staging, o.requires)));
        }
    }
    let mut v = selected.to_vec();
    v.sort_by_key(|x| opts.iter().position(|o| &o.staging == x).unwrap_or(usize::MAX));
    Ok(v)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn repository_recipe_orders_flat_floor_after_flat_maps() {
        let r = Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).join("../../../assets/competitive/recipe.toml");
        let o = options(&r).unwrap();
        assert!(o.iter().any(|x| x.staging == "trees"));
        let sel = vec!["floor-flat-woe-bg-pvp".to_string(), "trees".into(), "flat-maps-woe-bg-pvp".into()];
        assert_eq!(ordered_selection(&r, &sel).unwrap(), ["flat-maps-woe-bg-pvp", "floor-flat-woe-bg-pvp", "trees"]);
        assert!(ordered_selection(&r, &["floor-flat-all".to_string()]).is_err(), "needs flat-maps-all");
    }
}
```

`studio/crates/og-core/src/pipeline.rs`:

```rs
//! Release build of a profile. Layout of the output folder:
//!   client/     odinguard.dll, ijl15.dll (loader), odin.grf, [odin-dark.grf], odinguard.ini, README.txt, licences
//!   patcher/    filelist.txt (path, sha256, size) for the operator's patcher
//!   server/     src/ (module), conf/ (odinguard_athena.conf, import/odinguard_conf.txt, odinguard/ references), sql/
//!   secrets/    odinguard.env (server key, protocol salt, build secret) – never shipped, excluded from the manifest
//!   docs/       handbook.md, commands-de.md, commands-en.md, build-report.json
//!   manifest.json, manifest.sig, signing.pub

use serde::Serialize;
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::process::Command;

use crate::generate::{self, Derived};
use crate::profile::Profile;
use crate::registry::Registry;
use crate::{Error, Result, keys};

#[derive(Debug, Default, Serialize)]
pub struct BuildReport {
    pub profile: String,
    pub out: String,
    pub modules: Vec<String>,
    pub client_sources: Vec<String>,
    pub linked_objects: Vec<String>,
    pub guard_sha256: String,
    pub loader_sha256: String,
    pub odin_grf_sha256: String,
    pub odin_grf_files: usize,
    pub competitive_pack_sha256: String,
    pub competitive_files: usize,
    pub grf_manifest: Vec<crate::profile::GrfFile>,
    pub sigpack: Option<crate::sigpack::Report>,
    pub warnings: Vec<String>,
}

/// What a build would do (Studio preview), without writing anything.
#[derive(Debug, Serialize)]
pub struct Preview {
    pub modules: Vec<String>,
    pub client_sources: Vec<String>,
    pub server_switches: Vec<(String, bool)>,
    pub odin_grf_groups: Vec<String>,
    pub protected_files: Vec<String>,
    pub commands: Vec<String>,
    pub warnings: Vec<String>,
}

pub fn preview(p: &Profile, reg: &Registry) -> Result<Preview> {
    let warnings = p.validate(reg)?;
    Ok(Preview {
        modules: p.modules.clone(),
        client_sources: generate::client_sources(p, reg),
        server_switches: reg.modules.iter().filter_map(|m| m.server_key.clone().map(|k| (k, p.modules.contains(&m.id)))).collect(),
        odin_grf_groups: asset_groups(p, reg),
        protected_files: generate::protected_files(p).iter().map(|(f, _)| f.to_string()).collect(),
        commands: reg
            .commands
            .iter()
            .filter(|c| p.modules.contains(&c.module) && p.commands.get(&c.id).is_none_or(|x| x.enabled))
            .map(|c| format!("{}{}", if c.kind == "client" { "!" } else { "@" }, p.commands.get(&c.id).and_then(|x| x.name.clone()).unwrap_or_else(|| c.name.clone())))
            .collect(),
        warnings,
    })
}

fn asset_groups(p: &Profile, reg: &Registry) -> Vec<String> {
    let mut g: Vec<String> = reg.modules.iter().filter(|m| p.modules.contains(&m.id)).flat_map(|m| m.assets.iter().cloned()).filter(|a| a != "competitive").collect();
    g.sort();
    g.dedup();
    g
}

fn io<T>(r: std::io::Result<T>, what: &Path) -> Result<T> {
    r.map_err(|e| Error::Io(what.display().to_string(), e))
}

fn copy(from: &Path, to: &Path) -> Result<()> {
    if let Some(d) = to.parent() {
        io(std::fs::create_dir_all(d), d)?;
    }
    io(std::fs::copy(from, to), from).map(|_| ())
}

fn copy_tree(from: &Path, to: &Path) -> Result<usize> {
    let mut n = 0;
    for e in io(std::fs::read_dir(from), from)?.flatten() {
        let p = e.path();
        let t = to.join(e.file_name());
        if p.is_dir() {
            n += copy_tree(&p, &t)?;
        } else {
            copy(&p, &t)?;
            n += 1;
        }
    }
    Ok(n)
}

fn sha(path: &Path) -> Result<String> {
    Ok(crate::manifest::sha256_file(path)?.0)
}

/// Builds the release of a profile. `profile_path` locates relative paths; `root` is the OdinGuard repository.
pub fn build(profile_path: &Path, root: &Path) -> Result<BuildReport> {
    let base = profile_path.parent().unwrap_or(Path::new(".")).to_path_buf();
    let p = Profile::load(profile_path)?;
    let reg = Registry::load(&root.join("modules"))?;
    let mut rep = BuildReport { profile: p.general.id.clone(), warnings: p.validate(&reg)?, modules: p.modules.clone(), ..Default::default() };
    let out = p.resolve(&base, &p.output);
    rep.out = out.display().to_string();
    if out.exists() {
        io(std::fs::remove_dir_all(&out), &out)?;
    }
    let server_seed = keys::read_hex32(&p.resolve(&base, &p.keys.server_seed))?;
    let signing_seed = keys::read_hex32(&p.resolve(&base, &p.keys.signing_seed))?;
    let build_secret = keys::read_hex32(&p.resolve(&base, &p.keys.build_secret))?;
    let d = Derived::new(&p, server_seed, build_secret)?;

    // ---- client DLL
    // GNU make cannot handle spaces in paths: build in a fixed space-free work folder in that case
    let work = if std::path::absolute(&out).unwrap_or_else(|_| out.clone()).to_string_lossy().contains(' ') { std::env::temp_dir().join("odinguard-build").join(&p.general.id) } else { out.join("build") };
    if work.exists() {
        io(std::fs::remove_dir_all(&work), &work)?;
    }
    let gendir = work.join("gen");
    let obj = work.join("client");
    generate::write(&gendir.join("og_modules.h"), &generate::modules_h(&p, &reg))?;
    generate::write(&gendir.join("og_modules.mk"), &generate::modules_mk(&p, &reg))?;
    generate::write(&gendir.join("og_profile.h"), &generate::profile_h(&p, &d))?;
    generate::write(&gendir.join("res/odinguard.rc"), &generate::resource_rc(&p))?;
    copy(&root.join("client/res/odinguard.ico"), &gendir.join("res/odinguard.ico"))?;
    copy(&root.join("client/res/splash.bmp"), &gendir.join("res/splash.bmp"))?;
    rep.client_sources = generate::client_sources(&p, &reg);
    let abs = |x: &Path| x.canonicalize().unwrap_or_else(|_| x.to_path_buf());
    io(std::fs::create_dir_all(&obj), &obj)?;
    // OG_TOOLCHAIN=llvm: llvm-mingw with Control Flow Guard (client/Makefile TOOLCHAIN)
    let toolchain = std::env::var("OG_TOOLCHAIN").unwrap_or_else(|_| "gcc".into());
    let status = Command::new("make")
        .arg("-C")
        .arg(root.join("client"))
        .arg(format!("TOOLCHAIN={toolchain}"))
        .arg(format!("PROFILE_DIR={}", abs(&gendir).display()))
        .arg(format!("OUT={}", abs(&obj).display()))
        .arg(format!("RC_DIR={}", abs(&gendir.join("res")).display()))
        .arg(abs(&obj).join("odinguard.dll"))
        .arg(abs(&obj).join("ijl15.dll"))
        .output()
        .map_err(|e| Error::Build(format!("make: {e} (needs mingw-w64)")))?;
    if !status.status.success() {
        return Err(Error::Build(format!("client build failed:\n{}", String::from_utf8_lossy(&status.stderr))));
    }
    rep.linked_objects = linked_objects(&obj.join("odinguard.map"))?;
    check_linked(&rep.client_sources, &rep.linked_objects)?;
    let client = out.join("client");
    copy(&obj.join("odinguard.dll"), &client.join("odinguard.dll"))?;
    copy(&obj.join("ijl15.dll"), &client.join("ijl15.dll"))?;
    copy(&root.join("client/package/odinguard.ini"), &client.join("odinguard.ini"))?;
    let readme = std::fs::read_to_string(root.join("client/package/README.txt")).map_err(|e| Error::Io("client/package/README.txt".into(), e))?;
    generate::write(&client.join("README.txt"), &readme.replace("{operator}", &p.general.operator).replace('\n', "\r\n"))?;
    copy(&root.join("third_party/LICENCE-monocypher.md"), &client.join("LICENSE-monocypher.md"))?;
    copy(&root.join("third_party/minhook/LICENSE.txt"), &client.join("LICENSE-minhook.txt"))?;
    rep.guard_sha256 = sha(&client.join("odinguard.dll"))?;
    rep.loader_sha256 = sha(&client.join("ijl15.dll"))?;

    // ---- odin.grf (assets only)
    let stage = out.join("build/odin-grf");
    generate::write(
        &stage.join("data/odinguard/profile.txt"),
        &format!("OdinGuard Anti Cheat {}\nprofile {}\nassets {}\n", env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION"), p.general.id, asset_groups(&p, &reg).join(",")),
    )?;
    for g in asset_groups(&p, &reg) {
        if let Some(dir) = p.assets.odin_grf.get(&g) {
            let dir = p.resolve(&base, dir);
            let data = dir.join("data");
            if !data.is_dir() {
                return Err(Error::Invalid(format!("asset group {g}: {} has no data/ folder", dir.display())));
            }
            copy_tree(&data, &stage.join("data"))?;
        } else {
            rep.warnings.push(format!("asset group {g} has no folder in assets.odin_grf"));
        }
    }
    let grf = client.join("odin.grf");
    let ctl = rgrf_core::progress::Control::default();
    let br = rgrf_core::build::build(&stage, &grf, &rgrf_core::build::BuildOptions::default(), &ctl).map_err(|e| Error::Build(format!("odin.grf: {e}")))?;
    let archive = rgrf_core::Archive::open(&grf).map_err(|e| Error::Build(format!("odin.grf: {e}")))?;
    let vr = rgrf_core::verify::verify(&archive, rgrf_core::verify::VerifyOptions::default(), &ctl).map_err(|e| Error::Build(format!("odin.grf verify: {e}")))?;
    if vr.issues.iter().any(|i| matches!(i.severity, rgrf_core::verify::Severity::Error)) {
        return Err(Error::Build("odin.grf failed verification".into()));
    }
    rep.odin_grf_files = br.files;
    rep.odin_grf_sha256 = sha(&grf)?;

    // ---- competitive pack: a ready GRF, or built from the selected categories (assets/competitive/recipe.toml)
    if p.modules.iter().any(|m| m == "competitive-pack") {
        let src = if p.assets.competitive_pack.is_empty() {
            let cat_root = p.resolve(&base, &p.assets.competitive_source);
            let stage = out.join("build/odin-dark");
            for c in &crate::pack::ordered_selection(&root.join("assets/competitive/recipe.toml"), &p.assets.competitive)? {
                let data = cat_root.join(c).join("data");
                if !data.is_dir() {
                    return Err(Error::Invalid(format!("competitive category {c}: {} missing", data.display())));
                }
                rep.competitive_files += copy_tree(&data, &stage.join("data"))?;
            }
            let built = out.join("build/odin-dark.grf");
            // client paths are Korean (cp949), as stored in the client's own GRFs
            let opts = rgrf_core::build::BuildOptions { names: rgrf_core::NameMode::Cp949, ..Default::default() };
            rgrf_core::build::build(&stage, &built, &opts, &ctl).map_err(|e| Error::Build(format!("odin-dark.grf: {e}")))?;
            built
        } else {
            p.resolve(&base, &p.assets.competitive_pack)
        };
        let a = rgrf_core::Archive::open(&src).map_err(|e| Error::Build(format!("competitive pack {}: {e}", src.display())))?;
        let v = rgrf_core::verify::verify(&a, rgrf_core::verify::VerifyOptions::default(), &ctl).map_err(|e| Error::Build(format!("competitive pack: {e}")))?;
        if v.issues.iter().any(|i| matches!(i.severity, rgrf_core::verify::Severity::Error)) {
            return Err(Error::Build("competitive pack failed verification".into()));
        }
        copy(&src, &client.join("odin-dark.grf"))?;
        rep.competitive_pack_sha256 = sha(&client.join("odin-dark.grf"))?;
    }

    // ---- server package
    let server = out.join("server");
    copy_tree(&root.join("server/src"), &server.join("src"))?;
    copy_tree(&root.join("server/sql"), &server.join("sql"))?;
    copy(&root.join("server/conf/odinguard_athena.conf"), &server.join("conf/odinguard_athena.conf"))?;
    let refdir = server.join("conf/odinguard");
    copy(&client.join("odinguard.dll"), &refdir.join("odinguard.dll"))?;
    copy(&grf, &refdir.join("odin.grf"))?;
    if client.join("odin-dark.grf").exists() {
        copy(&client.join("odin-dark.grf"), &refdir.join("odin-dark.grf"))?;
    }
    if p.modules.iter().any(|m| m == "cheat-signatures") {
        let srcs: Vec<PathBuf> = p.signatures.sources.iter().map(|s| p.resolve(&base, s)).collect();
        let allow: Vec<PathBuf> = p.signatures.allowlist.iter().map(|s| p.resolve(&base, s)).collect();
        let (pack, sr) = crate::sigpack::build_selected(
            &srcs.iter().map(PathBuf::as_path).collect::<Vec<_>>(),
            &allow.iter().map(PathBuf::as_path).collect::<Vec<_>>(),
            p.signatures.version,
            &p.signatures.max_action,
            &p.signatures.groups,
            &p.signatures.disabled,
            &signing_seed,
        )?;
        io(std::fs::write(refdir.join("odinguard.sigpack"), pack), &refdir)?;
        rep.sigpack = Some(sr);
    }
    // GRFs of this release enter the GRF manifest automatically
    for (name, required) in generate::protected_files(&p) {
        let f = client.join(name);
        if f.exists() {
            let (size, tail) = crate::grf::tail_hash(&f)?;
            rep.grf_manifest.push(crate::profile::GrfFile { name: name.into(), size, tail, full: sha(&f)?, required });
        }
    }
    let signing_pub = crate::crypto::public_key(&signing_seed);
    generate::write(&server.join("conf/import/odinguard_conf.txt"), &generate::server_conf(&p, &reg, &signing_pub, &rep.grf_manifest, "conf/odinguard"))?;
    generate::write(&out.join("secrets/odinguard.env"), &generate::secrets_env(&d))?;

    // ---- patcher list, docs, manifest
    let files = crate::manifest::collect(&client, &[])?;
    let list: String = files.iter().map(|f| format!("{}\t{}\t{}\n", f.path, f.sha256, f.size)).collect();
    generate::write(&out.join("patcher/filelist.txt"), &list)?;
    generate::write(&out.join("docs/commands-de.md"), &generate::commands_md(&p, &reg, "de"))?;
    generate::write(&out.join("docs/commands-en.md"), &generate::commands_md(&p, &reg, "en"))?;
    generate::write(&out.join("docs/handbook.md"), &handbook(&p, &reg, &rep, &d))?;
    generate::write(&out.join("docs/build-report.json"), &serde_json::to_string_pretty(&rep).unwrap_or_default())?;
    io(std::fs::remove_dir_all(out.join("build")), &out)?;
    let m = crate::manifest::Manifest {
        product: "OdinGuard Anti Cheat".into(),
        version: env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION").into(),
        protocol: 2,
        profile: p.general.id.clone(),
        rollout_stage: p.rollout.stage,
        sigpack_version: p.signatures.version,
        files: crate::manifest::collect(&out, &["secrets", "manifest.json", "manifest.sig", "signing.pub"])?,
    };
    crate::manifest::write_signed(&out, &m, &signing_seed)?;
    Ok(rep)
}

/// Module objects named in the linker map (client/Makefile writes obj/<source>.o per module source).
pub fn linked_objects(map: &Path) -> Result<Vec<String>> {
    let text = io(std::fs::read_to_string(map), map)?;
    let mut v: Vec<String> = text
        .split(|c: char| c.is_whitespace() || c == '(' || c == ')')
        // GNU ld writes "obj/og_main.o", lld (llvm-mingw) "obj/og_main.o:"
        .map(|w| w.trim_end_matches(':'))
        .filter(|w| w.ends_with(".o") && w.rsplit('/').nth(1) == Some("obj"))
        .filter_map(|w| w.rsplit('/').next().map(|f| f.trim_end_matches(".o").to_string()))
        .collect();
    v.sort();
    v.dedup();
    Ok(v)
}

/// The DLL must contain exactly the module sources of the profile (proof that unselected code is not linked).
pub fn check_linked(sources: &[String], linked: &[String]) -> Result<()> {
    let mut want: Vec<String> = sources.iter().map(|s| s.rsplit('/').next().unwrap_or(s).trim_end_matches(".c").to_string()).collect();
    want.sort();
    if want != linked {
        return Err(Error::Build(format!("linked objects {linked:?} differ from the selected module sources {want:?}")));
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn handbook(p: &Profile, reg: &Registry, rep: &BuildReport, d: &Derived) -> String {
    use std::fmt::Write as _;
    let mut s = format!(
        "# OdinGuard Anti Cheat – operator handbook ({})\n\nGenerated by the OdinGuard Studio {} for profile `{}` (rollout stage {}).\n\n",
        p.general.operator,
        env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION"),
        p.general.id,
        p.rollout.stage
    );
    s.push_str("## 1. What is in this release\n\n| Folder | Content |\n|---|---|\n| `client/` | files for the game client folder (patcher) |\n| `server/` | server module, config, references, SQL |\n| `secrets/odinguard.env` | server secrets – environment of the servers only, never in git, never to players |\n| `patcher/filelist.txt` | path, SHA-256, size for the patcher |\n| `manifest.json` + `manifest.sig` | signed list of every file (`og verify-release <folder>`) |\n\n");
    let _ = writeln!(s, "Guard `odinguard.dll` SHA-256 `{}`, loader `{}`, odin.grf `{}` ({} files).\n", rep.guard_sha256, rep.loader_sha256, rep.odin_grf_sha256, rep.odin_grf_files);
    let _ = writeln!(s, "Server public key `{}`, profile tag `{}`.\n", hex::encode(d.server_pub), hex::encode(d.tag));
    s.push_str("## 2. Client integration (no player uninstall; only through your patcher)\n\n1. Rename the client's existing `ijl15.dll` (e.g. ROExt) to `ijl15r.dll`; ship `client/ijl15.dll` (loader) and `client/odinguard.dll`.\n2. Ship `odin.grf` and add it to `DATA.INI` **before** `data.grf` (lower number = higher priority), e.g. `0=odin.grf`");
    if rep.competitive_pack_sha256.is_empty() {
        s.push_str(".\n");
    } else {
        s.push_str(", `1=odin-dark.grf` (optional for players; modified copies are refused).\n");
    }
    s.push_str("3. Optional `odinguard.ini` (splash time, ports). Protection switches cannot be changed there.\n4. Deliver everything with the patcher (`patcher/filelist.txt`). Do not change the files: the server checks the guard's own code and the protected files.\n\n");
    s.push_str("## 3. Server integration\n\n1. Copy `server/src/*` into the emulator (see `server/README.md` of the OdinGuard repository for the hook lines) and build.\n2. Copy `server/conf/odinguard_athena.conf`, `server/conf/import/odinguard_conf.txt` and `server/conf/odinguard/` into the server's `conf/`.\n3. Put the three values of `secrets/odinguard.env` into the server environment (Docker/Easypanel) or into `conf/import/odinguard_conf.txt` as `og_key`, `og_proto_salt`, `og_build_secret` (not in git).\n4. The tables are created at the first start.\n\n");
    s.push_str("## 4. Rollout\n\n| Stage | Config | Leave it when |\n|---|---|---|\n| 1 warn | `og_log_only: yes` | a week of logs, `og rollout status` shows no rule above the false-alarm threshold |\n| 2 kick | `og_log_only: no` | kicks are only real cheats (check `og_event`, `@ogflags`) |\n| 3 patcher | stage 2 + every player gets the guard by the patcher | `og rollout status` reports >= 98 % guarded sessions |\n| 4 required | `og_required: yes` | – |\n\nAdvance with `og rollout advance <profile> --events og_event.csv --clients og_client.csv`; the Studio refuses stage 4 when the gate fails.\n\n");
    s.push_str("## 5. Modules\n\n| Module | Side | What it does |\n|---|---|---|\n");
    for m in reg.modules.iter().filter(|m| p.modules.contains(&m.id)) {
        let _ = writeln!(s, "| {} | {} | {} |", m.id, m.side, m.summary);
    }
    s.push_str("\n## 6. Commands\n\nSee `docs/commands-en.md` / `docs/commands-de.md`.\n\n## 7. Honest limits\n\nThe server cannot prove what a client runs. Encryption, challenges and server-side checks (rate limit, behaviour, honeypot, delays) are the real security; client checks (signatures, anti-debug, integrity) raise the cost of cheating and are reported, never trusted. Keep warn mode until the logs are clean.\n");
    s
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    #[test]
    fn linker_maps_of_gnu_ld_and_lld() {
        let d = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let m = d.path().join("odinguard.map");
        std::fs::write(&m, " .text 0x6b001000 0x1a2 build/x/obj/og_main.o\n 6b002000 6b002000 10 16 /b/x/obj/og_net.o:(.text)\n lib/hook.o\n").unwrap();
        assert_eq!(super::linked_objects(&m).unwrap(), ["og_main", "og_net"]);
    }
}

```

`studio/crates/og-core/src/profile.rs`:

```rs
//! `odinguard.profile.toml`: the single source of truth of an operator (modules, challenges, commands, signature
//! package, branding, ports, keys, rollout stage, GRF policy, competitive pack). Paths inside a profile are
//! relative to the profile file. Secrets are never stored in the profile, only the paths of the key files.

use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::collections::BTreeMap;
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

use crate::registry::{ACTIONS, Registry};
use crate::{Error, Result};

pub const SCHEMA_VERSION: u32 = 3;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
pub struct General {
    pub id: String,
    /// shown on the splash screen and in message boxes
    pub operator: String,
    /// client build name sent in the hello (e.g. 2018-06-20)
    pub client_build: String,
    pub ports: Vec<u16>,
    pub splash_ms: u32,
    /// hex, 16 bytes: build variation (masks, link order, protocol salt derivation)
    pub variation_seed: String,
    /// hardware id salt; changing it makes every machine ban useless
    pub hwid_salt: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
pub struct Keys {
    /// server key seed (64 hex), the public key is compiled into the guard
    pub server_seed: String,
    /// Studio signing key seed (signature packages, release manifests)
    pub signing_seed: String,
    /// build secret (64 hex) for the nonce and time challenges
    pub build_secret: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Default)]
pub struct CommandSetting {
    #[serde(default = "yes")]
    pub enabled: bool,
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub name: Option<String>,
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub group: Option<i64>,
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub rate_ms: Option<i64>,
}

fn yes() -> bool {
    true
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
pub struct Signatures {
    pub sources: Vec<String>,
    pub allowlist: Vec<String>,
    /// raises every signature action to at most this one (e.g. "flagban" during the rollout); empty = as written
    #[serde(default)]
    pub max_action: String,
    /// version written into the package; the server refuses packages older than its og_sigpack_min_version
    pub version: u32,
    /// per tool group (signature id prefix, e.g. "RCX" for OG-RCX-001): "off" or an action that replaces the
    /// action of every signature of the group (log, flag, flagban, kick, ban)
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "BTreeMap::is_empty")]
    pub groups: BTreeMap<String, String>,
    /// single signature ids that are left out of the package
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Vec::is_empty")]
    pub disabled: Vec<String>,
}

/// One accepted version of a GRF the operator ships (from `og grf-scan`).
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
pub struct GrfFile {
    pub name: String,
    pub size: u64,
    /// SHA-256 of the header and the file table to the end of the file
    pub tail: String,
    /// SHA-256 of the whole file ("" = only the tail is checked)
    #[serde(default)]
    pub full: String,
    #[serde(default = "yes")]
    pub required: bool,
}

/// A GRF players may add under any name (skins, darkworld variants, translations), matched by its tail hash.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
pub struct GrfMod {
    pub tail: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub note: String,
}

/// GRF manifest and actions (module grf-rules), like Gepard's start-up GRF check but patcher friendly: keep the old
/// and the new version of a GRF listed while a patch rolls out.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
pub struct GrfPolicy {
    #[serde(default = "kick")]
    pub modified_action: String,
    #[serde(default = "log")]
    pub unknown_action: String,
    #[serde(default = "log")]
    pub missing_action: String,
    /// extra folders where loose files are allowed (e.g. "data\\texture\\skin\\")
    #[serde(default)]
    pub overlays: Vec<String>,
    #[serde(default, rename = "file")]
    pub files: Vec<GrfFile>,
    #[serde(default, rename = "mod")]
    pub mods: Vec<GrfMod>,
}

impl Default for GrfPolicy {
    fn default() -> Self {
        GrfPolicy { modified_action: kick(), unknown_action: log(), missing_action: log(), overlays: vec![], files: vec![], mods: vec![] }
    }
}

fn kick() -> String {
    "kick".into()
}

fn log() -> String {
    "log".into()
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
pub struct Assets {
    /// folders whose `data/` trees are merged into odin.grf (module asset groups, e.g. lgp)
    pub odin_grf: BTreeMap<String, String>,
    /// optional competitive pack as a ready GRF, shipped as odin-dark.grf (takes precedence over the categories)
    #[serde(default)]
    pub competitive_pack: String,
    /// folder with one staging folder (`<category>/data/...`) per competitive-pack category
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "String::is_empty")]
    pub competitive_source: String,
    /// selected categories (assets/competitive/recipe.toml); the Studio builds odin-dark.grf from them
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Vec::is_empty")]
    pub competitive: Vec<String>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
pub struct Rollout {
    /// 1 warn mode, 2 kick, 3 patcher delivery, 4 required
    pub stage: u8,
    /// rules an operator has checked by hand: not counted as false-alarm candidates
    #[serde(default)]
    pub reviewed_rules: Vec<String>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
pub struct Profile {
    pub schema_version: u32,
    pub general: General,
    pub keys: Keys,
    pub modules: Vec<String>,
    /// "module.param" -> value
    #[serde(default)]
    pub params: BTreeMap<String, toml::Value>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub commands: BTreeMap<String, CommandSetting>,
    pub signatures: Signatures,
    pub assets: Assets,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub grf: GrfPolicy,
    pub rollout: Rollout,
    /// output folder of builds
    pub output: String,
}

impl Profile {
    /// A new profile with fresh salts and every module of the default set. Key files are created by `keys::ensure`.
    pub fn new(id: &str, operator: &str) -> Result<Self> {
        let seed: [u8; 16] = crate::crypto::random().map_err(|e| Error::Io("random".into(), e))?;
        let salt: [u8; 12] = crate::crypto::random().map_err(|e| Error::Io("random".into(), e))?;
        Ok(Profile {
            schema_version: SCHEMA_VERSION,
            general: General {
                id: id.into(),
                operator: operator.into(),
                client_build: "2018-06-20".into(),
                ports: vec![6900, 6121, 5121],
                splash_ms: 1800,
                variation_seed: hex::encode(seed),
                hwid_salt: hex::encode(salt),
            },
            keys: Keys {
                server_seed: "keys/server.seed".into(),
                signing_seed: "keys/signing.seed".into(),
                build_secret: "keys/build.secret".into(),
            },
            modules: DEFAULT_MODULES.iter().map(|s| s.to_string()).collect(),
            params: BTreeMap::new(),
            commands: BTreeMap::new(),
            signatures: Signatures {
                sources: vec!["signatures/signatures.toml".into()],
                allowlist: vec!["signatures/allowlist.toml".into()],
                max_action: "flagban".into(),
                version: 1,
                groups: BTreeMap::new(),
                disabled: vec![],
            },
            assets: Assets {
                odin_grf: BTreeMap::from([("lgp".into(), "assets/odin-grf/lgp".into())]),
                competitive_pack: String::new(),
                competitive_source: String::new(),
                competitive: vec![],
            },
            grf: GrfPolicy::default(),
            rollout: Rollout { stage: 1, reviewed_rules: vec![] },
            output: format!("dist/{id}"),
        })
    }

    pub fn load(path: &Path) -> Result<Self> {
        let text = std::fs::read_to_string(path).map_err(|e| Error::Io(path.display().to_string(), e))?;
        let mut value: toml::Value = toml::from_str(&text).map_err(|e| Error::Parse(path.display().to_string(), e.to_string()))?;
        migrate(&mut value)?;
        value.try_into().map_err(|e: toml::de::Error| Error::Parse(path.display().to_string(), e.to_string()))
    }

    pub fn save(&self, path: &Path) -> Result<()> {
        let text = toml::to_string_pretty(self).map_err(|e| Error::Invalid(e.to_string()))?;
        std::fs::write(path, format!("# OdinGuard Anti Cheat profile (schema {SCHEMA_VERSION}). Secrets are only referenced by path.\n{text}"))
            .map_err(|e| Error::Io(path.display().to_string(), e))
    }

    /// Value of a module parameter (profile override or registry default).
    pub fn param(&self, reg: &Registry, module: &str, name: &str) -> Option<toml::Value> {
        if let Some(v) = self.params.get(&format!("{module}.{name}")) {
            return Some(v.clone());
        }
        reg.module(module)?.params.iter().find(|p| p.name == name).map(|p| p.default.clone())
    }

    /// Checks the profile against the registry. Returns warnings; errors stop a build.
    pub fn validate(&self, reg: &Registry) -> Result<Vec<String>> {
        let mut warn = Vec::new();
        let bad = |m: String| Err(Error::Invalid(m));
        if self.schema_version != SCHEMA_VERSION {
            return bad(format!("schema {} (expected {SCHEMA_VERSION}); run `og profile migrate`", self.schema_version));
        }
        if self.general.id.is_empty() || !self.general.id.chars().all(|c| c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || c == '-' || c == '_') {
            return bad("general.id: letters, digits, - and _ only".into());
        }
        if self.general.operator.trim().is_empty() || self.general.operator.len() > 60 || self.general.operator.contains('"') {
            return bad("general.operator: 1-60 characters, no quotes".into());
        }
        if self.general.ports.is_empty() {
            return bad("general.ports: at least one game server port".into());
        }
        if hex::decode(&self.general.variation_seed).map(|v| v.len()) != Ok(16) {
            return bad("general.variation_seed: 32 hex characters".into());
        }
        if self.general.hwid_salt.len() < 6 || self.general.hwid_salt.len() > 60 || self.general.hwid_salt.contains('"') {
            return bad("general.hwid_salt: 6-60 characters".into());
        }
        if !self.modules.iter().any(|m| m == "core") {
            return bad("the core module cannot be removed".into());
        }
        for m in &self.modules {
            let module = reg.module(m).ok_or_else(|| Error::Invalid(format!("unknown module {m}")))?;
            for r in &module.requires {
                if !self.modules.contains(r) {
                    return bad(format!("module {m} needs {r}"));
                }
            }
        }
        for (key, v) in &self.params {
            let (module, name) = key.split_once('.').ok_or_else(|| Error::Invalid(format!("parameter {key}: use module.name")))?;
            let p = reg
                .module(module)
                .and_then(|m| m.params.iter().find(|p| p.name == name))
                .ok_or_else(|| Error::Invalid(format!("unknown parameter {key}")))?;
            match p.kind.as_str() {
                "int" => {
                    let n = v.as_integer().ok_or_else(|| Error::Invalid(format!("{key}: integer expected")))?;
                    if p.min.is_some_and(|m| n < m) || p.max.is_some_and(|m| n > m) {
                        return bad(format!("{key} = {n} outside {:?}..{:?}", p.min, p.max));
                    }
                }
                "bool" if !v.is_bool() => return bad(format!("{key}: true/false expected")),
                "action" if !ACTIONS.contains(&v.as_str().unwrap_or("")) => return bad(format!("{key}: one of {ACTIONS:?}")),
                "string" if !v.is_str() => return bad(format!("{key}: text expected")),
                _ => {}
            }
            if !self.modules.iter().any(|m| m == module) {
                warn.push(format!("{key} is set but module {module} is not selected"));
            }
        }
        for (id, c) in &self.commands {
            let cmd = reg.commands.iter().find(|x| &x.id == id).ok_or_else(|| Error::Invalid(format!("unknown command {id}")))?;
            if let Some(n) = &c.name
                && (n.is_empty() || n.len() > 24 || !n.chars().all(|ch| ch.is_ascii_alphanumeric()))
            {
                return bad(format!("command {id}: name must be 1-24 letters/digits"));
            }
            if c.enabled && !self.modules.contains(&cmd.module) {
                warn.push(format!("command {id} is enabled but its module {} is not selected", cmd.module));
            }
        }
        if !self.signatures.max_action.is_empty() && !ACTIONS.contains(&self.signatures.max_action.as_str()) {
            return bad(format!("signatures.max_action: one of {ACTIONS:?}"));
        }
        if !(1..=4).contains(&self.rollout.stage) {
            return bad("rollout.stage: 1-4".into());
        }
        if self.modules.iter().any(|m| m == "competitive-pack")
            && self.assets.competitive_pack.is_empty()
            && (self.assets.competitive.is_empty() || self.assets.competitive_source.is_empty())
        {
            return bad("module competitive-pack needs assets.competitive_pack or assets.competitive + competitive_source".into());
        }
        for (g, a) in &self.signatures.groups {
            if g.is_empty() || !g.chars().all(|c| c.is_ascii_uppercase() || c.is_ascii_digit()) {
                return bad(format!("signatures.groups: '{g}' is not a group name (e.g. RCX)"));
            }
            if a != "off" && !ACTIONS.contains(&a.as_str()) {
                return bad(format!("signatures.groups.{g}: off or one of {ACTIONS:?}"));
            }
        }
        for (k, a) in [("modified", &self.grf.modified_action), ("unknown", &self.grf.unknown_action), ("missing", &self.grf.missing_action)] {
            if !ACTIONS.contains(&a.as_str()) {
                return bad(format!("grf.{k}_action: one of {ACTIONS:?}"));
            }
        }
        let hex64 = |h: &str| h.len() == 64 && h.chars().all(|c| c.is_ascii_hexdigit());
        for f in &self.grf.files {
            if f.name.is_empty() || f.name.len() > 60 || f.name.contains(['|', ',', '/', '\\']) || !hex64(&f.tail) || !(f.full.is_empty() || hex64(&f.full)) {
                return bad(format!("grf.file {}: name or hash invalid", f.name));
            }
        }
        for m in &self.grf.mods {
            if !hex64(&m.tail) || m.note.contains(['|', ',']) {
                return bad(format!("grf.mod {}: tail hash (64 hex) and a note without | or ,", m.note));
            }
        }
        if !self.grf.files.is_empty() && !self.modules.iter().any(|m| m == "grf-rules") {
            warn.push("grf.file entries are only checked with the grf-rules module".into());
        }
        if self.rollout.stage >= 4 && self.param(reg, "core", "required").and_then(|v| v.as_bool()) == Some(false) {
            warn.push("rollout stage 4 forces core.required = true in the generated config".into());
        }
        Ok(warn)
    }

    /// Absolute path of a profile-relative path.
    pub fn resolve(&self, base: &Path, p: &str) -> PathBuf {
        let p = Path::new(p);
        if p.is_absolute() { p.to_path_buf() } else { base.join(p) }
    }
}

/// Default module set: the features of OdinGuard 0.3 (regression profile). New protection modules are opt-in.
pub const DEFAULT_MODULES: &[&str] = &[
    "core", "hwid", "multi-client", "heartbeat", "integrity", "cheat-signatures", "grf-rules", "input-filter",
    "crash-report", "client-commands", "colors", "branding", "lgp", "ban-system",
];

/// Schema migrations, oldest first. Schema 1 (Studio preview): `[general].mode = "warn|kick|required"`,
/// `signatures.files` instead of `sources`, no allowlist, no rollout table.
pub fn migrate(v: &mut toml::Value) -> Result<u32> {
    let t = v.as_table_mut().ok_or_else(|| Error::Invalid("profile is not a table".into()))?;
    let from = t.get("schema_version").and_then(|x| x.as_integer()).unwrap_or(1) as u32;
    if from > SCHEMA_VERSION {
        return Err(Error::Invalid(format!("profile schema {from} is newer than this Studio ({SCHEMA_VERSION}); update the Studio")));
    }
    if from < 2 {
        let mode = t
            .get_mut("general")
            .and_then(|g| g.as_table_mut())
            .and_then(|g| g.remove("mode"))
            .and_then(|m| m.as_str().map(str::to_string))
            .unwrap_or_else(|| "warn".into());
        let stage = match mode.as_str() {
            "required" => 4,
            "kick" => 2,
            _ => 1,
        };
        let mut r = toml::map::Map::new();
        r.insert("stage".into(), toml::Value::Integer(stage));
        r.insert("reviewed_rules".into(), toml::Value::Array(vec![]));
        t.entry("rollout").or_insert(toml::Value::Table(r));
        if let Some(s) = t.get_mut("signatures").and_then(|s| s.as_table_mut()) {
            if let Some(files) = s.remove("files") {
                s.insert("sources".into(), files);
            }
            s.entry("allowlist").or_insert(toml::Value::Array(vec![]));
            s.entry("max_action").or_insert(toml::Value::String("flagban".into()));
            s.entry("version").or_insert(toml::Value::Integer(1));
        }
        t.insert("schema_version".into(), toml::Value::Integer(2));
    }
    if from < 3 {
        // schema 3: auras became a separate rAthena feature (not part of OdinGuard any more)
        t.remove("aura_catalog");
        if let Some(m) = t.get_mut("modules").and_then(|m| m.as_array_mut()) {
            m.retain(|x| x.as_str() != Some("auras"));
        }
        if let Some(c) = t.get_mut("commands").and_then(|c| c.as_table_mut()) {
            for k in ["aura", "auraunlock", "showauras"] {
                c.remove(k);
            }
        }
        if let Some(p) = t.get_mut("params").and_then(|p| p.as_table_mut()) {
            p.retain(|k, _| !k.starts_with("auras."));
        }
        t.insert("schema_version".into(), toml::Value::Integer(3));
    }
    Ok(from)
}
```

`studio/crates/og-core/src/registry.rs`:

```rs
//! Module, command and aura registries (`modules/*.toml` in the OdinGuard repository).

use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::path::Path;

use crate::{Error, Result};

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Deserialize, Serialize)]
pub struct Param {
    pub name: String,
    #[serde(rename = "type")]
    pub kind: String,
    pub default: toml::Value,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub min: Option<i64>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub max: Option<i64>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub conf: Option<String>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub help: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Deserialize, Serialize)]
pub struct Module {
    pub id: String,
    pub version: String,
    pub kind: String,
    pub side: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub requires: Vec<String>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub client_src: Vec<String>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub define: Option<String>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub server_key: Option<String>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub assets: Vec<String>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub summary: String,
    #[serde(default, rename = "param")]
    pub params: Vec<Param>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Deserialize, Serialize)]
pub struct Command {
    pub id: String,
    pub kind: String,
    pub name: String,
    pub module: String,
    pub group: i64,
    pub rate_ms: i64,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub params: String,
    pub help_en: String,
    pub help_de: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize)]
struct ModulesFile {
    schema: u32,
    #[serde(rename = "module")]
    modules: Vec<Module>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize)]
struct CommandsFile {
    #[serde(rename = "command")]
    commands: Vec<Command>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize)]
pub struct Registry {
    pub modules: Vec<Module>,
    pub commands: Vec<Command>,
}

pub const ACTIONS: &[&str] = &["log", "flag", "kick", "ban", "flagban"];

fn read<T: serde::de::DeserializeOwned>(path: &Path) -> Result<T> {
    let text = std::fs::read_to_string(path).map_err(|e| Error::Io(path.display().to_string(), e))?;
    toml::from_str(&text).map_err(|e| Error::Parse(path.display().to_string(), e.to_string()))
}

impl Registry {
    /// Loads `modules.toml` and `commands.toml` from the registry folder.
    pub fn load(dir: &Path) -> Result<Self> {
        let m: ModulesFile = read(&dir.join("modules.toml"))?;
        if m.schema != 1 {
            return Err(Error::Invalid(format!("modules.toml schema {} is not supported", m.schema)));
        }
        let c: CommandsFile = read(&dir.join("commands.toml"))?;
        let r = Registry { modules: m.modules, commands: c.commands };
        r.check()?;
        Ok(r)
    }

    pub fn module(&self, id: &str) -> Option<&Module> {
        self.modules.iter().find(|m| m.id == id)
    }

    /// Internal consistency: unique ids, known dependencies and command modules, valid defaults.
    fn check(&self) -> Result<()> {
        let mut ids = std::collections::HashSet::new();
        for m in &self.modules {
            if !ids.insert(m.id.as_str()) {
                return Err(Error::Invalid(format!("module {} defined twice", m.id)));
            }
        }
        for m in &self.modules {
            for r in &m.requires {
                if !ids.contains(r.as_str()) {
                    return Err(Error::Invalid(format!("module {} requires unknown module {r}", m.id)));
                }
            }
            for p in &m.params {
                if p.kind == "action" && !ACTIONS.contains(&p.default.as_str().unwrap_or("")) {
                    return Err(Error::Invalid(format!("{}.{}: unknown default action", m.id, p.name)));
                }
            }
        }
        for c in &self.commands {
            if !ids.contains(c.module.as_str()) {
                return Err(Error::Invalid(format!("command {} belongs to unknown module {}", c.id, c.module)));
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    /// Every module needed by `selected`, in registry order (dependencies resolved transitively).
    pub fn closure(&self, selected: &[String]) -> Result<Vec<String>> {
        let mut want: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
        let mut stack: Vec<String> = selected.to_vec();
        while let Some(id) = stack.pop() {
            let m = self.module(&id).ok_or_else(|| Error::Invalid(format!("unknown module {id}")))?;
            if !want.contains(&id) {
                want.push(id.clone());
                stack.extend(m.requires.iter().cloned());
            }
        }
        Ok(self.modules.iter().filter(|m| want.contains(&m.id)).map(|m| m.id.clone()).collect())
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {

    fn reg() -> Registry {
        Registry::load(&Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).join("../../../modules")).unwrap()
```
