`studio/crates/og-core/src/rollout.rs`:

```rs
//! Rollout stages of a profile: 1 warn mode (log only), 2 kick, 3 patcher delivery, 4 required. The gate before the
//! next stage is computed from database exports (tab or comma separated with a header, e.g. `mysql -B -e "SELECT *
//! FROM og_event WHERE time > NOW() - INTERVAL 7 DAY"`):
//! - false-alarm candidates: rules that hit more than `fp_percent` of the active accounts and were not reviewed;
//! - coverage: share of active accounts that logged in with the guard (og_client) – needed for stage 4.

use serde::Serialize;
use std::collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet};
use std::path::Path;

use crate::profile::Profile;
use crate::{Error, Result};

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Default)]
pub struct RuleStat {
    pub rule: String,
    pub events: usize,
    pub accounts: usize,
    pub percent: f64,
    pub actions: BTreeMap<String, usize>,
    pub reviewed: bool,
}

#[derive(Debug, Serialize)]
pub struct Status {
    pub stage: u8,
    pub active_accounts: usize,
    pub guarded_accounts: usize,
    pub coverage_percent: f64,
    pub rules: Vec<RuleStat>,
    pub fp_candidates: Vec<String>,
    pub next_stage_ok: bool,
    pub reasons: Vec<String>,
}

/// events, distinct accounts, actions
type RuleAcc = (usize, BTreeSet<String>, BTreeMap<String, usize>);

fn table(path: &Path) -> Result<Vec<BTreeMap<String, String>>> {
    let text = std::fs::read_to_string(path).map_err(|e| Error::Io(path.display().to_string(), e))?;
    let mut lines = text.lines().filter(|l| !l.trim().is_empty());
    let head = lines.next().ok_or_else(|| Error::Invalid(format!("{}: empty", path.display())))?;
    let sep = if head.contains('\t') { '\t' } else { ',' };
    let cols: Vec<String> = head.split(sep).map(|c| c.trim().trim_matches('"').to_string()).collect();
    Ok(lines
        .map(|l| cols.iter().cloned().zip(l.split(sep).map(|v| v.trim().trim_matches('"').to_string())).collect())
        .collect())
}

/// Rule name of an event type: "sig:OG-RCX-001" stays, "challenge:code" stays, details are not part of it.
fn rule_of(t: &str) -> String {
    t.to_string()
}

pub fn status(p: &Profile, events: &Path, clients: &Path, active_accounts: Option<usize>, fp_percent: f64) -> Result<Status> {
    let ev = table(events)?;
    let cl = table(clients)?;
    let guarded: BTreeSet<String> = cl.iter().filter_map(|r| r.get("account_id").cloned()).filter(|a| a != "0").collect();
    let active = active_accounts.unwrap_or(guarded.len()).max(1);
    let mut stats: BTreeMap<String, RuleAcc> = BTreeMap::new();
    for e in &ev {
        let rule = rule_of(e.get("type").map(String::as_str).unwrap_or(""));
        if rule.is_empty() || rule == "gm-ban" {
            continue;
        }
        let s = stats.entry(rule).or_default();
        s.0 += 1;
        if let Some(a) = e.get("account_id").filter(|a| *a != "0") {
            s.1.insert(a.clone());
        }
        *s.2.entry(e.get("action").cloned().unwrap_or_default()).or_default() += 1;
    }
    let mut rules: Vec<RuleStat> = stats
        .into_iter()
        .map(|(rule, (events, accs, actions))| RuleStat {
            reviewed: p.rollout.reviewed_rules.iter().any(|r| r == &rule),
            percent: accs.len() as f64 * 100.0 / active as f64,
            rule,
            events,
            accounts: accs.len(),
            actions,
        })
        .collect();
    rules.sort_by_key(|r| std::cmp::Reverse(r.accounts));
    let fp_candidates: Vec<String> = rules.iter().filter(|r| r.percent > fp_percent && !r.reviewed).map(|r| format!("{} ({:.1} % of the accounts)", r.rule, r.percent)).collect();
    let coverage = guarded.len() as f64 * 100.0 / active as f64;
    let mut reasons = Vec::new();
    if !fp_candidates.is_empty() {
        reasons.push(format!("{} rule(s) hit more than {fp_percent} % of the accounts: check them, then add them to rollout.reviewed_rules or fix the signature", fp_candidates.len()));
    }
    if p.rollout.stage == 3 && coverage < 98.0 {
        reasons.push(format!("only {coverage:.1} % of the active accounts play with the guard (needs 98 %)"));
    }
    if p.rollout.stage >= 4 {
        reasons.push("already at the last stage".into());
    }
    if ev.is_empty() && p.rollout.stage == 1 {
        reasons.push("no events yet: collect at least a few days of warn-mode logs".into());
    }
    Ok(Status {
        stage: p.rollout.stage,
        active_accounts: active,
        guarded_accounts: guarded.len(),
        coverage_percent: coverage,
        rules,
        fp_candidates,
        next_stage_ok: reasons.is_empty(),
        reasons,
    })
}

/// Moves the profile to the next stage when the gate allows it (`force` skips the gate, logged in the reasons).
pub fn advance(p: &mut Profile, s: &Status, force: bool) -> Result<u8> {
    if !s.next_stage_ok && !force {
        return Err(Error::Invalid(format!("rollout gate: {}", s.reasons.join("; "))));
    }
    if p.rollout.stage >= 4 {
        return Err(Error::Invalid("already at stage 4".into()));
    }
    p.rollout.stage += 1;
    Ok(p.rollout.stage)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn files(dir: &Path, events: &str, clients: &str) -> (std::path::PathBuf, std::path::PathBuf) {
        let e = dir.join("e.tsv");
        let c = dir.join("c.tsv");
        std::fs::write(&e, events).unwrap();
        std::fs::write(&c, clients).unwrap();
        (e, c)
    }

    #[test]
    fn gate_blocks_on_false_alarm_candidates_and_coverage() {
        let d = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let mut ev = String::from("time\tunique_id\taccount_id\tchar_name\ttype\tdetail\taction\n");
        for a in 0..30 {
            ev.push_str(&format!("t\tu\t{}\tc\tsig:OG-AHK-001\tAutoHotkey\tlog\n", 2000000 + a));
        }
        ev.push_str("t\tu\t2000001\tc\tsig:OG-RCX-001\trcxdraw.exe\tlog\n");
        let mut cl = String::from("unique_id\taccount_id\n");
        for a in 0..100 {
            cl.push_str(&format!("u{a}\t{}\n", 2000000 + a));
        }
        let (e, c) = files(d.path(), &ev, &cl);
        let mut p = Profile::new("t", "T").unwrap();
        let s = status(&p, &e, &c, Some(100), 2.0).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(s.fp_candidates.len(), 1, "{:?}", s.fp_candidates);
        assert!(!s.next_stage_ok);
        assert!(advance(&mut p, &s, false).is_err());
        p.rollout.reviewed_rules.push("sig:OG-AHK-001".into());
        let s = status(&p, &e, &c, Some(100), 2.0).unwrap();
        assert!(s.next_stage_ok, "{:?}", s.reasons);
        assert_eq!(advance(&mut p, &s, false).unwrap(), 2);
        p.rollout.stage = 3;
        let s = status(&p, &e, &c, Some(200), 2.0).unwrap();
        assert!(!s.next_stage_ok, "50 % coverage must block stage 4");
        let s = status(&p, &e, &c, Some(101), 2.0).unwrap();
        assert!(s.next_stage_ok, "{:?}", s.reasons);
        assert_eq!(advance(&mut p, &s, false).unwrap(), 4);
    }
}
```

`studio/crates/og-core/src/sigpack.rs`:

```rs
//! Signature package of the cheat-signatures module: compiled from the TOML sources (analysis/cheat-signatures
//! format) into the binary format the server checks (src/common/odinguard.cpp og_load_sigpack):
//! "OGSP" u8 format(1) u32 version u32 created(0) u16 n, n x { u16 id, u8 kind, u8 action, u8 score, u8 nlen, name,
//! u8 plen, pattern }, then u8 signature[64] = EdDSA(BLAKE2b) of everything before, Studio signing key.

use serde::Deserialize;
use std::path::Path;

use crate::{Error, Result};

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Deserialize, serde::Serialize)]
pub struct SigEntry {
    pub id: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub source: String,
    pub kind: String,
    pub pattern: String,
    #[serde(default = "medium")]
    pub confidence: String,
    #[serde(default = "medium")]
    pub severity: String,
    #[serde(default = "logs")]
    pub action: String,
}

fn medium() -> String {
    "medium".into()
}
fn logs() -> String {
    "log".into()
}

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize)]
struct SigFile {
    #[serde(default, rename = "signature")]
    signatures: Vec<SigEntry>,
    #[serde(default, rename = "allow")]
    allow: Vec<SigEntry>,
}

/// Wire kind (og_proto.h OG_KIND_*) of a signature kind; None = not checkable by the guard.
pub fn wire_kind(kind: &str, allow: bool) -> Option<u8> {
    if allow {
        return match kind {
            "file_sha256" | "grf_sha256" => Some(64),
            "path" | "allow_path" => Some(65),
            _ => None,
        };
    }
    Some(match kind {
        "process" => 1,
        "window_title" | "window" => 2,
        "module" => 3,
        "window_class" => 7,
        "file_name" => 8,
        "file_sha256" => 9,
        "driver" => 10,
        "grf_sha256" => 11,
        "mutex" => 16,
        "registry" => 17,
        _ => return None,
    })
}

/// Server action byte (odinguard.hpp e_og_action) and its strength for capping.
fn action(a: &str) -> Result<(u8, u8)> {
    Ok(match a {
        "log" => (0, 0),
        "flag" => (3, 1),
        "flagban" => (4, 2),
        "kick" => (1, 3),
        "ban" => (2, 4),
        _ => return Err(Error::Invalid(format!("unknown action {a}"))),
    })
}

fn score(severity: &str, confidence: &str) -> u8 {
    let s: f64 = match severity {
        "critical" => 100.0,
        "high" => 60.0,
        "medium" => 30.0,
        _ => 10.0,
    };
    let c = match confidence {
        "high" => 1.0,
        "medium" => 0.6,
        _ => 0.3,
    };
    (s * c).round() as u8
}

#[derive(Debug, Default, Clone, serde::Serialize)]
pub struct Report {
    pub signatures: usize,
    pub allow: usize,
    /// kinds the guard cannot check (grf_entry, import/string patterns, rules)
    pub skipped: Vec<(String, String)>,
    pub capped: usize,
    /// left out by the profile (signatures.groups = "off" or signatures.disabled)
    pub switched_off: usize,
}

/// Compiles and signs the package. `max_action` caps every action ("" = none).
/// Tool group of a signature id: "OG-RCX-001" -> "RCX", "OG-ALLOW-GRF-001" -> "ALLOW"; other ids -> "LOCAL".
pub fn group_of(id: &str) -> String {
    let mut it = id.split('-');
    match (it.next(), it.next()) {
        (Some("OG"), Some(g)) if !g.is_empty() => g.to_string(),
        _ => "LOCAL".into(),
    }
}

fn read_all(sources: &[&Path], allowlists: &[&Path]) -> Result<(Vec<SigEntry>, Vec<SigEntry>)> {
    let mut sigs = Vec::new();
    let mut allows = Vec::new();
    for p in sources.iter().chain(allowlists) {
        let text = std::fs::read_to_string(p).map_err(|e| Error::Io(p.display().to_string(), e))?;
        let f: SigFile = toml::from_str(&text).map_err(|e| Error::Parse(p.display().to_string(), e.to_string()))?;
        sigs.extend(f.signatures);
        allows.extend(f.allow);
    }
    Ok((sigs, allows))
}

/// One tool group of the signature sources (Studio list: switch off or change the action per group).
#[derive(Debug, Clone, serde::Serialize, PartialEq)]
pub struct Group {
    pub group: String,
    pub allow: bool,
    pub count: usize,
    /// client-checkable entries (the rest is analysis data the guard cannot see)
    pub active: usize,
    pub kinds: Vec<String>,
    pub actions: Vec<String>,
    pub sources: Vec<String>,
}

pub fn catalog(sources: &[&Path], allowlists: &[&Path]) -> Result<Vec<Group>> {
    let (sigs, allows) = read_all(sources, allowlists)?;
    let mut map: std::collections::BTreeMap<(bool, String), Group> = Default::default();
    for (e, allow) in sigs.iter().map(|s| (s, false)).chain(allows.iter().map(|s| (s, true))) {
        let g = group_of(&e.id);
        let x = map.entry((allow, g.clone())).or_insert_with(|| Group { group: g, allow, count: 0, active: 0, kinds: vec![], actions: vec![], sources: vec![] });
        x.count += 1;
        if wire_kind(&e.kind, allow).is_some() {
            x.active += 1;
        }
        for (v, list) in [(&e.kind, &mut x.kinds), (&e.action, &mut x.actions), (&e.source, &mut x.sources)] {
            if !v.is_empty() && !list.contains(v) && list.len() < 8 {
                list.push(v.clone());
            }
        }
    }
    Ok(map.into_values().collect())
}

pub fn build(sources: &[&Path], allowlists: &[&Path], version: u32, max_action: &str, signing_seed: &[u8; 32]) -> Result<(Vec<u8>, Report)> {
    build_selected(sources, allowlists, version, max_action, &Default::default(), &[], signing_seed)
}

/// `groups`: group -> "off" or an action replacing the action of the group's signatures; `disabled`: ids left out.
pub fn build_selected(
    sources: &[&Path],
    allowlists: &[&Path],
    version: u32,
    max_action: &str,
    groups: &std::collections::BTreeMap<String, String>,
    disabled: &[String],
    signing_seed: &[u8; 32],
) -> Result<(Vec<u8>, Report)> {
    let (mut sigs, mut allows) = read_all(sources, allowlists)?;
    let before = sigs.len() + allows.len();
    for list in [&mut sigs, &mut allows] {
        list.retain(|e| !disabled.contains(&e.id) && groups.get(&group_of(&e.id)).is_none_or(|a| a != "off"));
    }
    for e in &mut sigs {
        if let Some(a) = groups.get(&group_of(&e.id)) {
            e.action = a.clone();
        }
    }
    sigs.sort_by(|a, b| a.id.cmp(&b.id));
    allows.sort_by(|a, b| a.id.cmp(&b.id));
    let cap = if max_action.is_empty() { None } else { Some(action(max_action)?) };
    let mut rep = Report { switched_off: before - sigs.len() - allows.len(), ..Default::default() };
    let mut body = Vec::new();
    let mut n: u16 = 0;
    for (e, allow) in sigs.iter().map(|s| (s, false)).chain(allows.iter().map(|s| (s, true))) {
        let Some(kind) = wire_kind(&e.kind, allow) else {
            rep.skipped.push((e.id.clone(), e.kind.clone()));
            continue;
        };
        let (mut act, strength) = action(&e.action)?;
        if let Some((cap_act, cap_strength)) = cap
            && strength > cap_strength
        {
            act = cap_act;
            rep.capped += 1;
        }
        let pattern = if matches!(kind, 9 | 11 | 64) { e.pattern.to_ascii_lowercase() } else { e.pattern.clone() };
        if e.id.len() > 255 || pattern.len() > 255 || pattern.is_empty() {
            return Err(Error::Invalid(format!("signature {}: id or pattern too long/empty", e.id)));
        }
        n = n.checked_add(1).filter(|&n| n < 30000).ok_or_else(|| Error::Invalid("too many signatures".into()))?;
        body.extend_from_slice(&n.to_le_bytes());
        body.push(kind);
        body.push(act);
        body.push(if allow { 0 } else { score(&e.severity, &e.confidence) });
        body.push(e.id.len() as u8);
        body.extend_from_slice(e.id.as_bytes());
        body.push(pattern.len() as u8);
        body.extend_from_slice(pattern.as_bytes());
        if allow { rep.allow += 1 } else { rep.signatures += 1 }
    }
    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(body.len() + 79);
    out.extend_from_slice(b"OGSP");
    out.push(1);
    out.extend_from_slice(&version.to_le_bytes());
    out.extend_from_slice(&0u32.to_le_bytes());
    out.extend_from_slice(&n.to_le_bytes());
    out.extend_from_slice(&body);
    let sig = crate::crypto::sign(signing_seed, &out);
    out.extend_from_slice(&sig);
    Ok((out, rep))
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, serde::Serialize, PartialEq)]
pub struct Entry {
    pub id: u16,
    pub kind: u8,
    pub action: u8,
    pub score: u8,
    pub name: String,
    pub pattern: String,
}

/// Verifies and parses a package (same checks as the server). Returns version and entries.
pub fn verify(data: &[u8], public_key: &[u8; 32]) -> Result<(u32, Vec<Entry>)> {
    if data.len() < 15 + 64 || &data[..4] != b"OGSP" || data[4] != 1 {
        return Err(Error::Signature("not a signature package".into()));
    }
    let body = data.len() - 64;
    let sig: [u8; 64] = data[body..].try_into().map_err(|_| Error::Signature("short".into()))?;
    if !crate::crypto::verify(public_key, &data[..body], &sig) {
        return Err(Error::Signature("signature does not match the signing key".into()));
    }
    let version = u32::from_le_bytes(data[5..9].try_into().unwrap_or_default());
    let n = u16::from_le_bytes([data[13], data[14]]);
    let mut pos = 15;
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    let take = |pos: usize, len: usize| -> Result<&[u8]> { data.get(pos..pos + len).filter(|_| pos + len <= body).ok_or_else(|| Error::Signature("truncated".into())) };
    for _ in 0..n {
        let h = take(pos, 6)?;
        let (id, kind, act, sc, nl) = (u16::from_le_bytes([h[0], h[1]]), h[2], h[3], h[4], h[5] as usize);
        let name = String::from_utf8_lossy(take(pos + 6, nl)?).into_owned();
        let pl = take(pos + 6 + nl, 1)?[0] as usize;
        let pattern = String::from_utf8_lossy(take(pos + 7 + nl, pl)?).into_owned();
        pos += 7 + nl + pl;
        out.push(Entry { id, kind, action: act, score: sc, name, pattern });
    }
    Ok((version, out))
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    const SIGS: &str = r#"
schema = 1
[[signature]]
id = "T-002"
kind = "process"
pattern = "cheat.exe"
confidence = "high"
severity = "high"
action = "ban"
[[signature]]
id = "T-001"
kind = "grf_entry"
pattern = "data\\x.act|00"
[[signature]]
id = "T-003"
kind = "file_sha256"
pattern = "ABCDEF"
action = "flag"
"#;
    const ALLOW: &str = r#"
[[allow]]
id = "A-1"
kind = "file_sha256"
pattern = "00FF"
"#;

    fn files() -> (tempfile::TempDir, std::path::PathBuf, std::path::PathBuf) {
        let d = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let s = d.path().join("s.toml");
        let a = d.path().join("a.toml");
        std::fs::write(&s, SIGS).unwrap();
        std::fs::write(&a, ALLOW).unwrap();
        (d, s, a)
    }

    #[test]
    fn build_verify_cap_and_skip() {
        let (_d, s, a) = files();
        let seed = [3u8; 32];
        let (pack, rep) = build(&[&s], &[&a], 7, "flagban", &seed).unwrap();
        assert_eq!((rep.signatures, rep.allow, rep.capped), (2, 1, 1));
        assert_eq!(rep.skipped, vec![("T-001".to_string(), "grf_entry".to_string())]);
        let (v, e) = verify(&pack, &crate::crypto::public_key(&seed)).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(v, 7);
        assert_eq!(e[0].name, "T-002");
        assert_eq!(e[0].action, 4, "ban capped to flagban");
        assert_eq!(e[0].score, 60);
        assert_eq!(e[1].pattern, "abcdef");
        assert_eq!(e[2].kind, 64);
        // same input, same bytes (reproducible)
        assert_eq!(build(&[&s], &[&a], 7, "flagban", &seed).unwrap().0, pack);
    }

    #[test]
    fn tampered_or_foreign_package_is_rejected() {
        let (_d, s, a) = files();
        let seed = [3u8; 32];
        let (mut pack, _) = build(&[&s], &[&a], 1, "", &seed).unwrap();
        assert!(verify(&pack, &crate::crypto::public_key(&[4u8; 32])).is_err());
        pack[20] ^= 1;
        assert!(verify(&pack, &crate::crypto::public_key(&seed)).is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn repository_signatures_compile() {
        let root = crate::repo_root();
        let s = root.join("analysis/cheat-signatures/signatures.toml");
        let a = root.join("analysis/cheat-signatures/allowlist.toml");
        if !s.exists() {
            return;
        }
        let (_, rep) = build(&[&s], &[&a], 1, "flagban", &[1u8; 32]).unwrap();
        assert!(rep.signatures > 40, "{rep:?}");
    }
}
```

`studio/crates/og-core/src/update.rs`:

```rs
//! Updates of the Studio itself (Tauri updater format) and of OdinGuard core/signature packages.
//!
//! Format: the static JSON of the Tauri updater plugin `{version, notes, pub_date, platforms: {<target>:
//! {signature, url}}}`; `signature` is the minisign signature (base64 of the .sig file, as `tauri signer sign`
//! writes it). In addition the manifest itself must be signed (`<manifest>.sig` next to it), so a compromised web
//! space cannot announce versions or notes.
//!
//! Rules: only https (http only for loopback and only when the caller allows it, for tests); manifest signature and
//! artifact signature are checked before anything is stored; a version lower than the last accepted one is refused
//! (downgrade/rollback attack) unless the operator rolls back explicitly to a version kept locally; the SHA-256 of
//! every accepted manifest is pinned in the state file.

use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
use std::collections::BTreeMap;
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

use crate::{Error, Result};

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
pub struct Platform {
    pub signature: String,
    pub url: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
pub struct UpdateManifest {
    pub version: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub notes: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub pub_date: String,
    pub platforms: BTreeMap<String, Platform>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct State {
    /// highest version ever accepted per channel/artifact key
    pub accepted: BTreeMap<String, String>,
    /// SHA-256 of the manifests that were accepted
    pub pinned: Vec<String>,
    /// version in use per key and the one before it (rollback)
    pub current: BTreeMap<String, String>,
    pub previous: BTreeMap<String, String>,
}

pub struct Updater {
    pub endpoint: String,
    pub channel: String,
    pub public_key: String,
    pub dir: PathBuf,
    pub allow_loopback_http: bool,
}

/// Compares versions like 1.2.10 > 1.2.9; a pre-release (1.3.0-beta.1) is lower than the release.
pub fn version_cmp(a: &str, b: &str) -> std::cmp::Ordering {
    let split = |v: &str| {
        let (core, pre) = v.split_once('-').map_or((v, None), |(c, p)| (c, Some(p.to_string())));
        (core.split('.').map(|x| x.parse::<u64>().unwrap_or(0)).collect::<Vec<_>>(), pre)
    };
    let (ca, pa) = split(a);
    let (cb, pb) = split(b);
    ca.cmp(&cb).then_with(|| match (pa, pb) {
        (None, None) => std::cmp::Ordering::Equal,
        (None, Some(_)) => std::cmp::Ordering::Greater,
        (Some(_), None) => std::cmp::Ordering::Less,
        (Some(x), Some(y)) => x.cmp(&y),
    })
}

fn verify_minisign(public_key: &str, data: &[u8], signature_b64_or_text: &str) -> Result<()> {
    let pk = minisign_verify::PublicKey::from_base64(public_key.trim()).map_err(|e| Error::Signature(format!("public key: {e}")))?;
    // Tauri stores the .sig file base64 encoded; accept the plain text too
    let text = decode_b64(signature_b64_or_text.trim()).and_then(|b| String::from_utf8(b).ok()).unwrap_or_else(|| signature_b64_or_text.to_string());
    let sig = minisign_verify::Signature::decode(&text).map_err(|e| Error::Signature(format!("signature: {e}")))?;
    pk.verify(data, &sig, false).map_err(|e| Error::Signature(format!("{e}")))
}

fn decode_b64(s: &str) -> Option<Vec<u8>> {
    const T: &[u8] = b"ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/";
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    let (mut acc, mut bits) = (0u32, 0u32);
    for c in s.bytes().filter(|c| !c.is_ascii_whitespace() && *c != b'=') {
        let v = T.iter().position(|&x| x == c)? as u32;
        acc = (acc << 6) | v;
        bits += 6;
        if bits >= 8 {
            bits -= 8;
            out.push((acc >> bits) as u8);
        }
    }
    Some(out)
}

impl Updater {
    fn get(&self, url: &str) -> Result<Vec<u8>> {
        let loopback = url.starts_with("http://127.0.0.1:") || url.starts_with("http://localhost:");
        if !(url.starts_with("https://") || (self.allow_loopback_http && loopback)) {
            return Err(Error::Signature(format!("refusing {url}: updates only over https")));
        }
        let mut resp = ureq::get(url).call().map_err(|e| Error::Build(format!("download {url}: {e}")))?;
        resp.body_mut().with_config().limit(256 * 1024 * 1024).read_to_vec().map_err(|e| Error::Build(format!("download {url}: {e}")))
    }

    fn state_path(&self) -> PathBuf {
        self.dir.join("state.json")
    }

    pub fn state(&self) -> State {
        std::fs::read(self.state_path()).ok().and_then(|b| serde_json::from_slice(&b).ok()).unwrap_or_default()
    }

    fn save(&self, s: &State) -> Result<()> {
        std::fs::create_dir_all(&self.dir).map_err(|e| Error::Io(self.dir.display().to_string(), e))?;
        std::fs::write(self.state_path(), serde_json::to_vec_pretty(s).unwrap_or_default()).map_err(|e| Error::Io("state.json".into(), e))
    }

    /// Fetches and verifies the channel manifest. Returns it when it announces a newer version than `current`.
    pub fn check(&self, key: &str, current: &str) -> Result<Option<UpdateManifest>> {
        let url = format!("{}/{}.json", self.endpoint.trim_end_matches('/'), self.channel);
        let body = self.get(&url)?;
        let sig = self.get(&format!("{url}.sig"))?;
        verify_minisign(&self.public_key, &body, &String::from_utf8_lossy(&sig))?;
        let m: UpdateManifest = serde_json::from_slice(&body).map_err(|e| Error::Parse(url.clone(), e.to_string()))?;
        if let Some(acc) = self.state().accepted.get(key)
            && version_cmp(&m.version, acc).is_lt()
        {
            return Err(Error::Signature(format!("manifest offers {} but {acc} was already accepted (downgrade refused)", m.version)));
        }
        Ok(version_cmp(&m.version, current).is_gt().then_some(m))
    }

    /// Downloads, verifies and stores the artifact for `target`; the previous version stays for a rollback.
    pub fn apply(&self, key: &str, m: &UpdateManifest, target: &str) -> Result<PathBuf> {
        let p = m.platforms.get(target).ok_or_else(|| Error::Invalid(format!("no artifact for {target}")))?;
        let data = self.get(&p.url)?;
        verify_minisign(&self.public_key, &data, &p.signature)?;
        let name = p.url.rsplit('/').next().unwrap_or("artifact");
        let dir = self.dir.join("versions").join(key).join(&m.version);
        std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir).map_err(|e| Error::Io(dir.display().to_string(), e))?;
        let file = dir.join(name);
        std::fs::write(&file, &data).map_err(|e| Error::Io(file.display().to_string(), e))?;
        let mut s = self.state();
        if let Some(cur) = s.current.get(key).cloned() {
            s.previous.insert(key.into(), cur);
        }
        s.current.insert(key.into(), m.version.clone());
        s.accepted.insert(key.into(), m.version.clone());
        s.pinned.push(hex::encode(Sha256::digest(serde_json::to_vec(m).unwrap_or_default())));
        self.save(&s)?;
        Ok(file)
    }

    /// Records a version installed by another installer (the Tauri updater plugin) as accepted and pinned, so a later
    /// manifest cannot offer an older one.
    pub fn record_installed(&self, key: &str, m: &UpdateManifest) -> Result<()> {
        let mut s = self.state();
        if let Some(cur) = s.current.get(key).cloned() {
            s.previous.insert(key.into(), cur);
        }
        s.current.insert(key.into(), m.version.clone());
        s.accepted.insert(key.into(), m.version.clone());
        s.pinned.push(hex::encode(Sha256::digest(serde_json::to_vec(m).unwrap_or_default())));
        self.save(&s)
    }

    /// Switches back to the previous locally kept version (explicit operator action).
    pub fn rollback(&self, key: &str) -> Result<String> {
        let mut s = self.state();
        let prev = s.previous.remove(key).ok_or_else(|| Error::Invalid(format!("no previous version of {key}")))?;
        if !self.dir.join("versions").join(key).join(&prev).is_dir() {
            return Err(Error::Invalid(format!("version {prev} of {key} is not kept locally")));
        }
        if let Some(cur) = s.current.insert(key.into(), prev.clone()) {
            s.previous.insert(key.into(), cur);
        }
        self.save(&s)?;
        Ok(prev)
    }

    pub fn current_file(&self, key: &str) -> Option<PathBuf> {
        let v = self.state().current.get(key)?.clone();
        std::fs::read_dir(self.dir.join("versions").join(key).join(v)).ok()?.flatten().next().map(|e| e.path())
    }
}

/// Writes a Tauri-compatible manifest for a local release folder (release script); signatures are added by the
/// release script with `tauri signer sign` / minisign.
pub fn manifest_for(version: &str, notes: &str, artifacts: &[(&str, &str, &str)]) -> UpdateManifest {
    UpdateManifest {
        version: version.into(),
        notes: notes.into(),
        pub_date: String::new(),
        platforms: artifacts.iter().map(|(t, url, sig)| (t.to_string(), Platform { url: url.to_string(), signature: sig.to_string() })).collect(),
    }
}

/// The minisign key line ("RW...") from a key line, a minisign .pub file or its base64 form (Tauri config).
pub fn minisign_key_line(any: &str) -> Option<String> {
    let find = |t: &str| t.lines().map(str::trim).find(|l| l.starts_with("RW") && l.len() == 56).map(str::to_string);
    find(any).or_else(|| decode_b64(any.trim()).and_then(|b| String::from_utf8(b).ok()).and_then(|t| find(&t)))
}

/// Writes `<channel>.json` for a release folder: every artifact must have its minisign `.sig` next to it
/// (as `tauri build` with a signing key or `tauri signer sign` writes it). The manifest itself is signed afterwards.
pub fn write_manifest(version: &str, notes: &str, base_url: &str, artifacts: &[(String, PathBuf)], out: &Path) -> Result<UpdateManifest> {
    if !base_url.starts_with("https://") {
        return Err(Error::Invalid(format!("base url {base_url} must be https")));
    }
    let mut list = Vec::new();
    for (target, file) in artifacts {
        let sig_path = PathBuf::from(format!("{}.sig", file.display()));
        let sig = std::fs::read_to_string(&sig_path).map_err(|e| Error::Io(sig_path.display().to_string(), e))?;
        let name = file.file_name().and_then(|n| n.to_str()).ok_or_else(|| Error::Invalid(format!("{}", file.display())))?;
        list.push((target.clone(), format!("{}/{name}", base_url.trim_end_matches('/')), sig.trim().to_string()));
    }
    let mut m = manifest_for(version, notes, &list.iter().map(|(a, b, c)| (a.as_str(), b.as_str(), c.as_str())).collect::<Vec<_>>());
    m.pub_date = std::env::var("SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH").unwrap_or_default();
    std::fs::write(out, serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&m).unwrap_or_default()).map_err(|e| Error::Io(out.display().to_string(), e))?;
    Ok(m)
}

/// Offline check of a release folder before publishing: manifest signature and every artifact signature against the
/// files in the same folder.
pub fn verify_local(manifest: &Path, public_key: &str) -> Result<UpdateManifest> {
    let body = std::fs::read(manifest).map_err(|e| Error::Io(manifest.display().to_string(), e))?;
    let sig_path = PathBuf::from(format!("{}.sig", manifest.display()));
    let sig = std::fs::read_to_string(&sig_path).map_err(|e| Error::Io(sig_path.display().to_string(), e))?;
    let key = minisign_key_line(public_key).ok_or_else(|| Error::Signature("public key not recognised".into()))?;
    verify_minisign(&key, &body, &sig)?;
    let m: UpdateManifest = serde_json::from_slice(&body).map_err(|e| Error::Parse(manifest.display().to_string(), e.to_string()))?;
    let dir = manifest.parent().unwrap_or(Path::new("."));
    for (target, p) in &m.platforms {
        let name = p.url.rsplit('/').next().unwrap_or_default();
        let data = std::fs::read(dir.join(name)).map_err(|e| Error::Io(format!("{target}: {name}"), e))?;
        verify_minisign(&key, &data, &p.signature).map_err(|e| Error::Signature(format!("{target}: {e}")))?;
    }
    Ok(m)
}

pub fn is_newer(candidate: &str, current: &str) -> bool {
    version_cmp(candidate, current).is_gt()
}

pub fn path_is_safe(p: &Path) -> bool {
    !p.components().any(|c| matches!(c, std::path::Component::ParentDir))
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use std::io::{Read, Write};
    use std::net::TcpListener;
    use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};

    /// tiny HTTP server for the tests: serves files from a map, path -> body
    fn serve(files: Arc<Mutex<BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>>>) -> String {
        let l = TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").unwrap();
        let addr = l.local_addr().unwrap();
        std::thread::spawn(move || {
            for s in l.incoming().flatten() {
                let files = files.clone();
                std::thread::spawn(move || {
                    let mut s = s;
                    let mut buf = [0u8; 4096];
                    let n = s.read(&mut buf).unwrap_or(0);
                    let req = String::from_utf8_lossy(&buf[..n]);
                    let path = req.split_whitespace().nth(1).unwrap_or("/").to_string();
                    let body = files.lock().unwrap().get(&path).cloned();
                    let resp = match body {
                        Some(b) => [format!("HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Length: {}\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n", b.len()).into_bytes(), b].concat(),
                        None => b"HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found\r\nContent-Length: 0\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n".to_vec(),
                    };
                    let _ = s.write_all(&resp);
                });
            }
        });
        format!("http://127.0.0.1:{}", addr.port())
    }

    struct Keys {
        pk: String,
        sk: minisign::SecretKey,
    }

    fn keys() -> Keys {
        let kp = minisign::KeyPair::generate_unencrypted_keypair().unwrap();
        Keys { pk: kp.pk.to_base64(), sk: kp.sk }
    }

    fn sign(k: &Keys, data: &[u8]) -> String {
        let sig = minisign::sign(None, &k.sk, std::io::Cursor::new(data), None, None).unwrap();
        sig.to_string()
    }

    fn b64(s: &str) -> String {
        const T: &[u8] = b"ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/";
        let b = s.as_bytes();
        let mut o = String::new();
        for c in b.chunks(3) {
            let n = (u32::from(c[0]) << 16) | (u32::from(*c.get(1).unwrap_or(&0)) << 8) | u32::from(*c.get(2).unwrap_or(&0));
            for i in 0..4 {
                if i <= c.len() { o.push(T[(n >> (18 - 6 * i) & 63) as usize] as char) } else { o.push('=') }
            }
        }
        o
    }

    fn publish(files: &Arc<Mutex<BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>>>, k: &Keys, version: &str, artifact: &[u8], base: &str) {
        let url = format!("{base}/studio-{version}.tar.gz");
        let m = manifest_for(version, "notes", &[("darwin-aarch64", &url, &b64(&sign(k, artifact)))]);
        let body = serde_json::to_vec(&m).unwrap();
        let mut f = files.lock().unwrap();
        f.insert(format!("/studio-{version}.tar.gz"), artifact.to_vec());
        f.insert("/stable.json.sig".into(), sign(k, &body).into_bytes());
        f.insert("/stable.json".into(), body);
    }

    #[test]
    fn update_n_to_n1_tamper_downgrade_and_rollback() {
        let files = Arc::new(Mutex::new(BTreeMap::new()));
        let base = serve(files.clone());
        let k = keys();
        let dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let u = Updater { endpoint: base.clone(), channel: "stable".into(), public_key: k.pk.clone(), dir: dir.path().into(), allow_loopback_http: true };

        // N = 1.0.0 installed, 1.0.1 published
        publish(&files, &k, "1.0.0", b"old build", &base);
        let m = u.check("studio", "0.9.0").unwrap().unwrap();
        u.apply("studio", &m, "darwin-aarch64").unwrap();
        publish(&files, &k, "1.0.1", b"new build", &base);
        let m = u.check("studio", "1.0.0").unwrap().expect("newer version offered");
        let f = u.apply("studio", &m, "darwin-aarch64").unwrap();
        assert_eq!(std::fs::read(&f).unwrap(), b"new build");
        assert!(u.check("studio", "1.0.1").unwrap().is_none(), "nothing newer");

        // manipulated manifest (notes changed after signing) is refused
        files.lock().unwrap().get_mut("/stable.json").unwrap().extend_from_slice(b" ");
        assert!(u.check("studio", "1.0.1").is_err());

        // manipulated artifact is refused, the current version stays
        publish(&files, &k, "1.0.2", b"newest", &base);
        files.lock().unwrap().insert("/studio-1.0.2.tar.gz".into(), b"evil".to_vec());
        let m = u.check("studio", "1.0.1").unwrap().unwrap();
        assert!(u.apply("studio", &m, "darwin-aarch64").is_err());
        assert_eq!(u.state().current["studio"], "1.0.1");

        // downgrade offered by the server is refused
        publish(&files, &k, "1.0.0", b"old build", &base);
        assert!(u.check("studio", "1.0.1").is_err());

        // explicit rollback to the kept version
        assert_eq!(u.rollback("studio").unwrap(), "1.0.0");
        assert_eq!(std::fs::read(u.current_file("studio").unwrap()).unwrap(), b"old build");

        // a version installed by the Tauri plugin is pinned as well
        publish(&files, &k, "1.0.5", b"plugin build", &base);
        let m = u.check("studio", "1.0.1").unwrap().unwrap();
        u.record_installed("studio", &m).unwrap();
        publish(&files, &k, "1.0.4", b"older", &base);
        assert!(u.check("studio", "1.0.5").is_err());

        // foreign key
        let other = keys();
        let u2 = Updater { public_key: other.pk, ..u };
        publish(&files, &k, "1.0.3", b"x", &base);
        assert!(u2.check("studio", "1.0.1").is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn only_https_outside_tests() {
        let u = Updater { endpoint: "http://example.com".into(), channel: "stable".into(), public_key: String::new(), dir: PathBuf::from("/tmp"), allow_loopback_http: true };
        assert!(u.check("studio", "1.0.0").is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn release_folder_roundtrip_and_tamper() {
        let k = keys();
        let d = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let art = d.path().join("OdinGuard Studio.app.tar.gz");
        std::fs::write(&art, b"bundle").unwrap();
        std::fs::write(d.path().join("OdinGuard Studio.app.tar.gz.sig"), b64(&sign(&k, b"bundle"))).unwrap();
        let out = d.path().join("stable.json");
        assert!(write_manifest("1.0.1", "n", "http://x", &[("darwin-aarch64".into(), art.clone())], &out).is_err());
        write_manifest("1.0.1", "n", "https://u.example/studio", &[("darwin-aarch64".into(), art.clone())], &out).unwrap();
        std::fs::write(d.path().join("stable.json.sig"), b64(&sign(&k, &std::fs::read(&out).unwrap()))).unwrap();
        let pubfile = b64(&format!("untrusted comment: minisign public key\n{}\n", k.pk));
        assert_eq!(verify_local(&out, &pubfile).unwrap().version, "1.0.1");
        std::fs::write(&art, b"bundle!").unwrap();
        assert!(verify_local(&out, &k.pk).is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn versions() {
        assert!(is_newer("1.0.10", "1.0.9"));
        assert!(is_newer("1.1.0", "1.1.0-beta.2"));
        assert!(!is_newer("1.1.0-beta.1", "1.1.0"));
    }
}
```

```sh
#!/bin/sh
# End-to-end tests of a Studio release against local test servers (tests/e2e/server_env.sh) and the guard in a
# Windows VM (Parallels; nettest.exe loads the release odinguard.dll, logs in and types commands).
#   tests/e2e/run.sh <xathena build dir> <release dir> [other release dir for the profile-tag test]
# Every check prints PASS/FAIL; the exit code is the number of failures.
set -u
ROOT=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/../.." && pwd)
X=$1; R=$2; OTHER=${3:-}
VM=${VM:-"Tiny 11 Pro"}
HOST_IP=${HOST_IP:-10.211.55.2}
E2E="$ROOT/client/build/e2e"
WIN_E2E=${WIN_E2E:-'Z:\Dev\OdinGuard\client\build\e2e'}
FAIL=0
pass() { echo "PASS $1"; }
fail() { echo "FAIL $1"; FAIL=$((FAIL + 1)); }
check() { if eval "$2"; then pass "$1"; else fail "$1"; fi; }
sql() { docker exec ogt-db mariadb -N -uragnarok -pragnarok ragnarok -e "$1" 2>/dev/null; }
maplog() { docker exec ogt-srv sh -c 'cat /tmp/map.log' 2>/dev/null; }
vm() { for i in 1 2 3 4; do o=$(prlctl exec "$VM" --current-user cmd /c "$1" 2>&1); case "$o" in *PrlJob_Get*) sleep 2;; *) printf '%s\n' "$o"; return;; esac; done; printf '%s\n' "$o"; }
# nettest <user> <char> "<chat commands>" <hold seconds> [env assignments "A=1 & set B=2"]
nettest_once() { vm "cd /d $WIN_E2E & set OG_CHAT=$3 & set OG_HOLD=$4 ${5:+& set $5 }& nettest.exe $HOST_IP 6900 $1 ogtest 6121 5121 $2"; }
# an immediate relogin of the same account can be refused with 0x0081 (still online): wait and retry
nettest() {
	for try in 1 2 3; do
		o=$(nettest_once "$@")
		case "$o" in *"unexpected packet 0x0081"*|*"refused, code 8"*|*"no map server answer"*|*"CHAR: unexpected answer"*) sleep 8 ;; *) break ;; esac
	done
	printf '%s\n' "$o"
}
restart_map() {
	docker exec ogt-srv sh -c "true"
	pid=$(docker exec ogt-srv sh -c 'pidof map-server' | tr -d '\r')
	docker exec ogt-srv kill "$pid"; sleep 2
	docker exec -d ogt-srv sh -c './map-server > /tmp/map.log 2>&1'
	for i in $(seq 1 60); do sleep 3; docker exec ogt-srv sh -c 'grep -a -q "Map Server is now online" /tmp/map.log' 2>/dev/null && break; done
}

# the server picks the challenged protected file at random: up to four sessions until a file challenge failed
file_challenge_fails() {
	for i in 1 2 3 4; do
		nettest ogtest2 OgPlayer '!ping' 45 >/dev/null
		[ "$(sql "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM og_event WHERE type=\"challenge:file\"")" -ge 1 ] && return 0
	done
	return 1
}

stage_client() {
	rm -rf "$E2E"; mkdir -p "$E2E"
	cp "$ROOT/client/build/nettest.exe" "$1/client/odinguard.dll" "$1/client/odin.grf" "$E2E/"
	[ -f "$1/client/odin-dark.grf" ] && cp "$1/client/odin-dark.grf" "$E2E/"
	data_ini "0=odin.grf" "1=odin-dark.grf"
	return 0
}

# DATA.INI of the test client folder
data_ini() { { printf '[Data]\r\n'; for l in "$@"; do printf '%s\r\n' "$l"; done; } > "$E2E/DATA.INI"; }
events() { sql "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM og_event WHERE $1"; }
# up to three sessions until an event matching $1 exists (session timing in the emulated VM varies)
event_after_session() {
	cond=$1; shift
	for i in 1 2 3; do
		nettest "$@" >/dev/null
		[ "$(events "$cond")" -ge 1 ] && return 0
	done
	return 1
}

cat > /tmp/og_e2e.conf <<'EOF'
og_ch_nonce: yes
og_ch_nonce_interval: 20
og_ch_code: yes
og_ch_code_interval: 20
og_ch_time: yes
og_ch_time_interval: 20
og_ch_file: yes
og_ch_file_interval: 20
og_ch_honeypot: yes
og_behaviour: yes
og_bh_nodelay: 20
og_rate_limit: yes
og_rate_pps: 100
og_ban_score: 50
EOF
"$ROOT/tests/e2e/server_env.sh" "$X" "$R" /tmp/og_e2e.conf >/tmp/og_e2e_env.log 2>&1 || { echo "server start failed"; exit 99; }
stage_client "$R"

echo "== 1 handshake, commands, challenges, self integrity (GM, 60 s)"
out=$(nettest Mave OgTester '!ping;+aura;+lgp;+square 2;+aoes;+lgp off;+showauras;+showauras;+oginfo;+ogflags;+whosell' 60)
printf '%s\n' "$out" | sed 's/^/   /' | head -40
check "login and map enter with the profile guard" 'printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q "MAP: .* bytes after enter"'
check "!ping answered by the guard" 'printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q "Ping: [0-9]* ms"'
check "@aura lists the catalog with unlock conditions" 'printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q "quest:aura_t1"'
check "@square 2 selects colour set 2" 'printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q "colour set2"'
check "@aoes limits LGP to SG/LoV/MS" 'printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q "Storm Gust, Lord of Vermilion and Meteor Storm"'
check "@whosell without parameter answers in the chat (market overview)" 'printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q "No vending shop is open right now\|Market (selling)"'
check "@oginfo shows protocol v2 and signatures" 'printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q "protocol v2.*signatures v1"'
check "guard log: handshake and signatures" 'vm "type $WIN_E2E\\odinguard.log" | grep -q "signatures: [0-9]* received"'
check "no guard-code / exe-code / challenge failure for the honest client" '[ "$(sql "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM og_event WHERE type LIKE \"challenge:%\" OR type IN (\"guard-code\",\"exe-code\")")" = 0 ]'
check "honest client: no GRF manifest report" '[ "$(events "type LIKE \"grf:%\"")" = 0 ]'
check "challenges were sent (map log)" 'maplog | grep -q "enabled (required: no, log only: yes, .*challenges nonce code time file"'

echo "== 2 aura unlocks (player + GM)"
out=$(nettest ogtest2 OgPlayer '+aura green' 5)
check "player cannot wear a locked aura" 'printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q "You have not unlocked green yet"'
( nettest ogtest2 OgPlayer '+aura' 25 > /tmp/og_p.out ) &
sleep 12

wait
check "GM unlocks an aura" 'printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q "Aura unlocked."'
check "second unlock is reported as duplicate" 'printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q "already has this aura"'
check "unknown aura is refused" 'printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q "Unknown aura."'
out=$(nettest ogtest2 OgPlayer '+aura green;+aura' 4)
check "after relog the unlocked aura can be worn" 'printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q "Aura set."'
check "unlock stored once (account scope)" '[ "$(sql "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aura_unlock WHERE account_id=2000001 AND aura=\"green\"")" = 1 ]'
out=$(nettest ogtest2 OgPlayer '+auraunlock yellow, OgPlayer' 3)
check "players cannot use @auraunlock" '! printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q "Aura unlocked."'

echo "== 3 server-side detections (honeypot, no-delay, rate limit) and the ban wave"
nettest ogtest3 OgThird '!ping' 4 'OG_ATTACK=1' >/dev/null
check "honeypot hit is flagged (flagban)" '[ "$(sql "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM og_flag WHERE account_id=2000002 AND rule=\"challenge:honeypot\" AND ban=1")" = 1 ]'
nettest ogtest2 OgPlayer '!ping' 4 'OG_SKILLSPAM=60' >/dev/null
check "skill requests inside the delay are flagged (bh:nodelay)" '[ "$(sql "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM og_flag WHERE account_id=2000001 AND rule=\"bh:nodelay\"")" -ge 1 ]'
sleep 6
out=$(nettest ogtest3 OgThird '!ping' 3 'OG_FLOOD=900'); printf '%s\n' "$out" | sed 's/^/   /' | tail -3
check "packet flood is reported (rate-limit, warn mode = log)" '[ "$(sql "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM og_event WHERE account_id=2000002 AND type=\"rate-limit\"")" -ge 1 ]'
out=$(nettest Mave OgTester '+ogbanwave dry;+ogflags' 3)
check "@ogbanwave dry lists the honeypot account" 'printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q "account 2000002"'
check "warn mode never bans" '[ "$(sql "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM og_ban")" = 0 ]'
printf 'og_log_only: no\n' >> "$X/conf/import/odinguard_conf.txt"
restart_map
out=$(nettest Mave OgTester '+ogbanwave' 3)
check "ban wave bans the flagged machine" '[ "$(sql "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM og_ban WHERE reason LIKE \"ban wave%\"")" -ge 1 ]'
check "flags are closed after the ban" '[ "$(sql "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM og_flag WHERE account_id=2000002 AND state=\"banned\"")" -ge 1 ]'
out=$(vm "cd /d $WIN_E2E & nettest.exe $HOST_IP 6900 ogtest3 ogtest")

check "exe code patched in memory (exe-code)" '[ "$(events "type=\"exe-code\"")" -ge 1 ]'

if [ -n "$OTHER" ]; then
	echo "== 5 a client built for another profile"
	stage_client "$OTHER"
	# the refused guard shows a message box: run nettest detached, read the log, close it
	out=$(vm "cd /d $WIN_E2E & del odinguard.log 2>nul & start \"\" /b nettest.exe $HOST_IP 6900 ogtest2 ogtest & ping -n 9 127.0.0.1 >nul & type odinguard.log & taskkill /f /im nettest.exe")
	printf '%s\n' "$out" | sed 's/^/   /' | tail -5
	check "foreign profile is refused with a message (status 3)" 'printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q "refused (3)"'
	stage_client "$R"
fi

echo "== $FAIL failure(s)"
exit $FAIL
```

`tests/e2e/server_env.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/sh
# Local OdinGuard test servers: MariaDB + login/char/map of a built xAthena tree in Docker, configured with a Studio
# release (server package + secrets). Reachable from the Windows test VM as $HOST_IP.
#   tests/e2e/server_env.sh <xathena build dir> <release dir> [extra conf lines file]
# Accounts: Mave/ogtest (GM 99, char OgTester), ogtest2 (OgPlayer), ogtest3 (OgThird).
set -e
X=$(cd "$1" && pwd)
R=$(cd "$2" && pwd)
EXTRA=${3:-}
HOST_IP=${HOST_IP:-10.211.55.2}
docker rm -f ogt-db ogt-srv >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
. "$R/secrets/odinguard.env"
mkdir -p "$X/conf/import" "$X/conf/odinguard"
cp "$R/server/conf/odinguard_athena.conf" "$X/conf/odinguard_athena.conf"
cp "$R/server/conf/odinguard/"* "$X/conf/odinguard/"
{
	cat "$R/server/conf/import/odinguard_conf.txt"
	printf 'og_key: %s\nog_proto_salt: %s\nog_build_secret: %s\nog_alive_interval: 5\nog_alive_timeout: 20\n' "$ODINGUARD_KEY" "$ODINGUARD_PROTO_SALT" "$ODINGUARD_BUILD_SECRET"
	[ -n "$EXTRA" ] && cat "$EXTRA"
} > "$X/conf/import/odinguard_conf.txt"
cat > "$X/conf/import/inter_conf.txt" <<'X'
login_server_ip: 127.0.0.1
login_server_id: ragnarok
login_server_pw: ragnarok
login_server_db: ragnarok
char_server_ip: 127.0.0.1
char_server_id: ragnarok
char_server_pw: ragnarok
char_server_db: ragnarok
map_server_ip: 127.0.0.1
map_server_id: ragnarok
map_server_pw: ragnarok
map_server_db: ragnarok
ipban_db_ip: 127.0.0.1
ipban_db_id: ragnarok
ipban_db_pw: ragnarok
ipban_db_db: ragnarok
log_db_ip: 127.0.0.1
log_db_id: ragnarok
log_db_pw: ragnarok
log_db_db: ragnarok
X
printf 'login_port: 6900\n' > "$X/conf/import/login_conf.txt"
printf 'login_port: 6900\nchar_port: 6121\nchar_ip: %s\nlogin_ip: 127.0.0.1\nserver_name: OGTest\npincode_enabled: no\n' "$HOST_IP" > "$X/conf/import/char_conf.txt"
printf 'char_port: 6121\nmap_port: 5121\nchar_ip: 127.0.0.1\nmap_ip: %s\n' "$HOST_IP" > "$X/conf/import/map_conf.txt"
grep -q "^atcommand_symbol: +" "$X/conf/import/battle_conf.txt" 2>/dev/null || printf "\natcommand_symbol: +\n" >> "$X/conf/import/battle_conf.txt"
docker run -d --name ogt-db -e MARIADB_ROOT_PASSWORD=root -e MARIADB_DATABASE=ragnarok -e MARIADB_USER=ragnarok -e MARIADB_PASSWORD=ragnarok \
  -v "$X/sql-files/main.sql:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/1.sql" -v "$X/sql-files/logs.sql:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/2.sql" \
  -p 6900:6900 -p 6121:6121 -p 5121:5121 mariadb:11 >/dev/null
# the image imports the SQL with a temporary server and restarts: wait for the second "ready for connections"
for i in $(seq 1 90); do sleep 2; [ "$(docker logs ogt-db 2>&1 | grep -c 'ready for connections')" -ge 2 ] && break; done
docker exec -i ogt-db mariadb -uragnarok -pragnarok ragnarok <<SQL
```

`third_party/minhook/include/MinHook.h`:

```h
/*
 *  MinHook - The Minimalistic API Hooking Library for x64/x86
 *  Copyright (C) 2009-2017 Tsuda Kageyu.
 *  All rights reserved.
 *
 *  Redistribution and use in source and binary forms, with or without
 *  modification, are permitted provided that the following conditions
 *  are met:
 *
 *   1. Redistributions of source code must retain the above copyright
 *      notice, this list of conditions and the following disclaimer.
 *   2. Redistributions in binary form must reproduce the above copyright
 *      notice, this list of conditions and the following disclaimer in the
 *      documentation and/or other materials provided with the distribution.
 *
 *  THIS SOFTWARE IS PROVIDED BY THE COPYRIGHT HOLDERS AND CONTRIBUTORS
 *  "AS IS" AND ANY EXPRESS OR IMPLIED WARRANTIES, INCLUDING, BUT NOT LIMITED
 *  TO, THE IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND FITNESS FOR A
 *  PARTICULAR PURPOSE ARE DISCLAIMED. IN NO EVENT SHALL THE COPYRIGHT HOLDER
 *  OR CONTRIBUTORS BE LIABLE FOR ANY DIRECT, INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, SPECIAL,
 *  EXEMPLARY, OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES (INCLUDING, BUT NOT LIMITED TO,
 *  PROCUREMENT OF SUBSTITUTE GOODS OR SERVICES; LOSS OF USE, DATA, OR
 *  PROFITS; OR BUSINESS INTERRUPTION) HOWEVER CAUSED AND ON ANY THEORY OF
 *  LIABILITY, WHETHER IN CONTRACT, STRICT LIABILITY, OR TORT (INCLUDING
 *  NEGLIGENCE OR OTHERWISE) ARISING IN ANY WAY OUT OF THE USE OF THIS
 *  SOFTWARE, EVEN IF ADVISED OF THE POSSIBILITY OF SUCH DAMAGE.
 */

#pragma once

#if !(defined _M_IX86) && !(defined _M_X64) && !(defined __i386__) && !(defined __x86_64__)
    #error MinHook supports only x86 and x64 systems.
#endif

#include <windows.h>

// MinHook Error Codes.
typedef enum MH_STATUS
{
    // Unknown error. Should not be returned.
    MH_UNKNOWN = -1,

    // Successful.
    MH_OK = 0,

    // MinHook is already initialized.
    MH_ERROR_ALREADY_INITIALIZED,

    // MinHook is not initialized yet, or already uninitialized.
    MH_ERROR_NOT_INITIALIZED,

    // The hook for the specified target function is already created.
    MH_ERROR_ALREADY_CREATED,

    // The hook for the specified target function is not created yet.
    MH_ERROR_NOT_CREATED,

    // The hook for the specified target function is already enabled.
    MH_ERROR_ENABLED,

    // The hook for the specified target function is not enabled yet, or already
    // disabled.
    MH_ERROR_DISABLED,

    // The specified pointer is invalid. It points the address of non-allocated
    // and/or non-executable region.
    MH_ERROR_NOT_EXECUTABLE,

    // The specified target function cannot be hooked.
    MH_ERROR_UNSUPPORTED_FUNCTION,

    // Failed to allocate memory.
    MH_ERROR_MEMORY_ALLOC,

    // Failed to change the memory protection.
    MH_ERROR_MEMORY_PROTECT,

    // The specified module is not loaded.
    MH_ERROR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND,

    // The specified function is not found.
    MH_ERROR_FUNCTION_NOT_FOUND
}
MH_STATUS;

// Can be passed as a parameter to MH_EnableHook, MH_DisableHook,
// MH_QueueEnableHook or MH_QueueDisableHook.
#define MH_ALL_HOOKS NULL

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

    // Initialize the MinHook library. You must call this function EXACTLY ONCE
    // at the beginning of your program.
    MH_STATUS WINAPI MH_Initialize(VOID);

    // Uninitialize the MinHook library. You must call this function EXACTLY
    // ONCE at the end of your program.
    MH_STATUS WINAPI MH_Uninitialize(VOID);

    // Creates a hook for the specified target function, in disabled state.
    // Parameters:
    //   pTarget     [in]  A pointer to the target function, which will be
    //                     overridden by the detour function.
    //   pDetour     [in]  A pointer to the detour function, which will override
    //                     the target function.
    //   ppOriginal  [out] A pointer to the trampoline function, which will be
    //                     used to call the original target function.
    //                     This parameter can be NULL.
    MH_STATUS WINAPI MH_CreateHook(LPVOID pTarget, LPVOID pDetour, LPVOID *ppOriginal);

    // Creates a hook for the specified API function, in disabled state.
    // Parameters:
    //   pszModule   [in]  A pointer to the loaded module name which contains the
    //                     target function.
    //   pszProcName [in]  A pointer to the target function name, which will be
    //                     overridden by the detour function.
    //   pDetour     [in]  A pointer to the detour function, which will override
    //                     the target function.
    //   ppOriginal  [out] A pointer to the trampoline function, which will be
    //                     used to call the original target function.
    //                     This parameter can be NULL.
    MH_STATUS WINAPI MH_CreateHookApi(
        LPCWSTR pszModule, LPCSTR pszProcName, LPVOID pDetour, LPVOID *ppOriginal);

    // Creates a hook for the specified API function, in disabled state.
    // Parameters:
    //   pszModule   [in]  A pointer to the loaded module name which contains the
    //                     target function.
    //   pszProcName [in]  A pointer to the target function name, which will be
    //                     overridden by the detour function.
    //   pDetour     [in]  A pointer to the detour function, which will override
    //                     the target function.
    //   ppOriginal  [out] A pointer to the trampoline function, which will be
    //                     used to call the original target function.
    //                     This parameter can be NULL.
    //   ppTarget    [out] A pointer to the target function, which will be used
    //                     with other functions.
    //                     This parameter can be NULL.
    MH_STATUS WINAPI MH_CreateHookApiEx(
        LPCWSTR pszModule, LPCSTR pszProcName, LPVOID pDetour, LPVOID *ppOriginal, LPVOID *ppTarget);

    // Removes an already created hook.
    // Parameters:
    //   pTarget [in] A pointer to the target function.
    MH_STATUS WINAPI MH_RemoveHook(LPVOID pTarget);

    // Enables an already created hook.
    // Parameters:
    //   pTarget [in] A pointer to the target function.
    //                If this parameter is MH_ALL_HOOKS, all created hooks are
    //                enabled in one go.
    MH_STATUS WINAPI MH_EnableHook(LPVOID pTarget);

    // Disables an already created hook.
    // Parameters:
    //   pTarget [in] A pointer to the target function.
    //                If this parameter is MH_ALL_HOOKS, all created hooks are
    //                disabled in one go.
    MH_STATUS WINAPI MH_DisableHook(LPVOID pTarget);

    // Queues to enable an already created hook.
    // Parameters:
    //   pTarget [in] A pointer to the target function.
    //                If this parameter is MH_ALL_HOOKS, all created hooks are
    //                queued to be enabled.
    MH_STATUS WINAPI MH_QueueEnableHook(LPVOID pTarget);

    // Queues to disable an already created hook.
    // Parameters:
    //   pTarget [in] A pointer to the target function.
    //                If this parameter is MH_ALL_HOOKS, all created hooks are
    //                queued to be disabled.
    MH_STATUS WINAPI MH_QueueDisableHook(LPVOID pTarget);

    // Applies all queued changes in one go.
    MH_STATUS WINAPI MH_ApplyQueued(VOID);

    // Translates the MH_STATUS to its name as a string.
    const char *WINAPI MH_StatusToString(MH_STATUS status);

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif

```

`third_party/minhook/src/buffer.c`:

```c
/*
 *  MinHook - The Minimalistic API Hooking Library for x64/x86
 *  Copyright (C) 2009-2017 Tsuda Kageyu.
 *  All rights reserved.
 *
 *  Redistribution and use in source and binary forms, with or without
 *  modification, are permitted provided that the following conditions
 *  are met:
 *
 *   1. Redistributions of source code must retain the above copyright
 *      notice, this list of conditions and the following disclaimer.
 *   2. Redistributions in binary form must reproduce the above copyright
 *      notice, this list of conditions and the following disclaimer in the
 *      documentation and/or other materials provided with the distribution.
 *
 *  THIS SOFTWARE IS PROVIDED BY THE COPYRIGHT HOLDERS AND CONTRIBUTORS
 *  "AS IS" AND ANY EXPRESS OR IMPLIED WARRANTIES, INCLUDING, BUT NOT LIMITED
 *  TO, THE IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND FITNESS FOR A
 *  PARTICULAR PURPOSE ARE DISCLAIMED. IN NO EVENT SHALL THE COPYRIGHT HOLDER
 *  OR CONTRIBUTORS BE LIABLE FOR ANY DIRECT, INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, SPECIAL,
 *  EXEMPLARY, OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES (INCLUDING, BUT NOT LIMITED TO,
 *  PROCUREMENT OF SUBSTITUTE GOODS OR SERVICES; LOSS OF USE, DATA, OR
 *  PROFITS; OR BUSINESS INTERRUPTION) HOWEVER CAUSED AND ON ANY THEORY OF
 *  LIABILITY, WHETHER IN CONTRACT, STRICT LIABILITY, OR TORT (INCLUDING
 *  NEGLIGENCE OR OTHERWISE) ARISING IN ANY WAY OUT OF THE USE OF THIS
 *  SOFTWARE, EVEN IF ADVISED OF THE POSSIBILITY OF SUCH DAMAGE.
 */

#include <windows.h>
#include "buffer.h"

// Size of each memory block. (= page size of VirtualAlloc)
#define MEMORY_BLOCK_SIZE 0x1000

// Max range for seeking a memory block. (= 1024MB)
#define MAX_MEMORY_RANGE 0x40000000

// Memory protection flags to check the executable address.
#define PAGE_EXECUTE_FLAGS \
    (PAGE_EXECUTE | PAGE_EXECUTE_READ | PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE | PAGE_EXECUTE_WRITECOPY)

// Memory slot.
typedef struct _MEMORY_SLOT
{
    union
    {
        struct _MEMORY_SLOT *pNext;
        UINT8 buffer[MEMORY_SLOT_SIZE];
    };
} MEMORY_SLOT, *PMEMORY_SLOT;

// Memory block info. Placed at the head of each block.
typedef struct _MEMORY_BLOCK
{
    struct _MEMORY_BLOCK *pNext;
    PMEMORY_SLOT pFree;         // First element of the free slot list.
    UINT usedCount;
} MEMORY_BLOCK, *PMEMORY_BLOCK;

//-------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Global Variables:
//-------------------------------------------------------------------------

// First element of the memory block list.
static PMEMORY_BLOCK g_pMemoryBlocks;

//-------------------------------------------------------------------------
VOID InitializeBuffer(VOID)
{
    // Nothing to do for now.
}

//-------------------------------------------------------------------------
VOID UninitializeBuffer(VOID)
{
    PMEMORY_BLOCK pBlock = g_pMemoryBlocks;
    g_pMemoryBlocks = NULL;

    while (pBlock)
    {
        PMEMORY_BLOCK pNext = pBlock->pNext;
        VirtualFree(pBlock, 0, MEM_RELEASE);
        pBlock = pNext;
    }
}

//-------------------------------------------------------------------------
#if defined(_M_X64) || defined(__x86_64__)
static LPVOID FindPrevFreeRegion(LPVOID pAddress, LPVOID pMinAddr, DWORD dwAllocationGranularity)
{
    ULONG_PTR tryAddr = (ULONG_PTR)pAddress;

    // Round down to the allocation granularity.
    tryAddr -= tryAddr % dwAllocationGranularity;

    // Start from the previous allocation granularity multiply.
    tryAddr -= dwAllocationGranularity;

    while (tryAddr >= (ULONG_PTR)pMinAddr)
    {
        MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION mbi;
        if (VirtualQuery((LPVOID)tryAddr, &mbi, sizeof(mbi)) == 0)
            break;

        if (mbi.State == MEM_FREE)
            return (LPVOID)tryAddr;

        if ((ULONG_PTR)mbi.AllocationBase < dwAllocationGranularity)
            break;

        tryAddr = (ULONG_PTR)mbi.AllocationBase - dwAllocationGranularity;
    }

    return NULL;
}
#endif

//-------------------------------------------------------------------------
#if defined(_M_X64) || defined(__x86_64__)
static LPVOID FindNextFreeRegion(LPVOID pAddress, LPVOID pMaxAddr, DWORD dwAllocationGranularity)
{
    ULONG_PTR tryAddr = (ULONG_PTR)pAddress;

    // Round down to the allocation granularity.
    tryAddr -= tryAddr % dwAllocationGranularity;

    // Start from the next allocation granularity multiply.
    tryAddr += dwAllocationGranularity;

    while (tryAddr <= (ULONG_PTR)pMaxAddr)
    {
        MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION mbi;
        if (VirtualQuery((LPVOID)tryAddr, &mbi, sizeof(mbi)) == 0)
            break;

        if (mbi.State == MEM_FREE)
            return (LPVOID)tryAddr;

        tryAddr = (ULONG_PTR)mbi.BaseAddress + mbi.RegionSize;

        // Round up to the next allocation granularity.
        tryAddr += dwAllocationGranularity - 1;
        tryAddr -= tryAddr % dwAllocationGranularity;
    }

    return NULL;
}
#endif

//-------------------------------------------------------------------------
static PMEMORY_BLOCK GetMemoryBlock(LPVOID pOrigin)
{
    PMEMORY_BLOCK pBlock;
#if defined(_M_X64) || defined(__x86_64__)
    ULONG_PTR minAddr;
    ULONG_PTR maxAddr;

    SYSTEM_INFO si;
    GetSystemInfo(&si);
    minAddr = (ULONG_PTR)si.lpMinimumApplicationAddress;
    maxAddr = (ULONG_PTR)si.lpMaximumApplicationAddress;

    // pOrigin ± 512MB
    if ((ULONG_PTR)pOrigin > MAX_MEMORY_RANGE && minAddr < (ULONG_PTR)pOrigin - MAX_MEMORY_RANGE)
        minAddr = (ULONG_PTR)pOrigin - MAX_MEMORY_RANGE;

    if (maxAddr > (ULONG_PTR)pOrigin + MAX_MEMORY_RANGE)
        maxAddr = (ULONG_PTR)pOrigin + MAX_MEMORY_RANGE;

    // Make room for MEMORY_BLOCK_SIZE bytes.
    maxAddr -= MEMORY_BLOCK_SIZE - 1;
#endif

    // Look the registered blocks for a reachable one.
    for (pBlock = g_pMemoryBlocks; pBlock != NULL; pBlock = pBlock->pNext)
    {
#if defined(_M_X64) || defined(__x86_64__)
        // Ignore the blocks too far.
        if ((ULONG_PTR)pBlock < minAddr || (ULONG_PTR)pBlock >= maxAddr)
            continue;
#endif
        // The block has at least one unused slot.
        if (pBlock->pFree != NULL)
            return pBlock;
    }

#if defined(_M_X64) || defined(__x86_64__)
    // Alloc a new block above if not found.
    {
        LPVOID pAlloc = pOrigin;
        while ((ULONG_PTR)pAlloc >= minAddr)
        {
            pAlloc = FindPrevFreeRegion(pAlloc, (LPVOID)minAddr, si.dwAllocationGranularity);
            if (pAlloc == NULL)
                break;

            pBlock = (PMEMORY_BLOCK)VirtualAlloc(
                pAlloc, MEMORY_BLOCK_SIZE, MEM_COMMIT | MEM_RESERVE, PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE);
            if (pBlock != NULL)
                break;
        }
    }

    // Alloc a new block below if not found.
    if (pBlock == NULL)
    {
        LPVOID pAlloc = pOrigin;
        while ((ULONG_PTR)pAlloc <= maxAddr)
        {
            pAlloc = FindNextFreeRegion(pAlloc, (LPVOID)maxAddr, si.dwAllocationGranularity);
            if (pAlloc == NULL)
                break;

            pBlock = (PMEMORY_BLOCK)VirtualAlloc(
                pAlloc, MEMORY_BLOCK_SIZE, MEM_COMMIT | MEM_RESERVE, PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE);
            if (pBlock != NULL)
                break;
        }
    }
#else
    // In x86 mode, a memory block can be placed anywhere.
    pBlock = (PMEMORY_BLOCK)VirtualAlloc(
        NULL, MEMORY_BLOCK_SIZE, MEM_COMMIT | MEM_RESERVE, PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE);
#endif

    if (pBlock != NULL)
    {
        // Build a linked list of all the slots.
        PMEMORY_SLOT pSlot = (PMEMORY_SLOT)pBlock + 1;
        pBlock->pFree = NULL;
        pBlock->usedCount = 0;
        do
        {
            pSlot->pNext = pBlock->pFree;
            pBlock->pFree = pSlot;
            pSlot++;
        } while ((ULONG_PTR)pSlot - (ULONG_PTR)pBlock <= MEMORY_BLOCK_SIZE - MEMORY_SLOT_SIZE);

        pBlock->pNext = g_pMemoryBlocks;
        g_pMemoryBlocks = pBlock;
    }

    return pBlock;
}

//-------------------------------------------------------------------------
LPVOID AllocateBuffer(LPVOID pOrigin)
{
    PMEMORY_SLOT  pSlot;
    PMEMORY_BLOCK pBlock = GetMemoryBlock(pOrigin);
    if (pBlock == NULL)
        return NULL;

    // Remove an unused slot from the list.
    pSlot = pBlock->pFree;
    pBlock->pFree = pSlot->pNext;
    pBlock->usedCount++;
#ifdef _DEBUG
    // Fill the slot with INT3 for debugging.
    memset(pSlot, 0xCC, sizeof(MEMORY_SLOT));
#endif
    return pSlot;
}

//-------------------------------------------------------------------------
VOID FreeBuffer(LPVOID pBuffer)
{
    PMEMORY_BLOCK pBlock = g_pMemoryBlocks;
    PMEMORY_BLOCK pPrev = NULL;
    ULONG_PTR pTargetBlock = ((ULONG_PTR)pBuffer / MEMORY_BLOCK_SIZE) * MEMORY_BLOCK_SIZE;

    while (pBlock != NULL)
    {
        if ((ULONG_PTR)pBlock == pTargetBlock)
        {
            PMEMORY_SLOT pSlot = (PMEMORY_SLOT)pBuffer;
#ifdef _DEBUG
            // Clear the released slot for debugging.
            memset(pSlot, 0x00, sizeof(MEMORY_SLOT));
#endif
            // Restore the released slot to the list.
            pSlot->pNext = pBlock->pFree;
            pBlock->pFree = pSlot;
            pBlock->usedCount--;

            // Free if unused.
            if (pBlock->usedCount == 0)
            {
                if (pPrev)
                    pPrev->pNext = pBlock->pNext;
                else
                    g_pMemoryBlocks = pBlock->pNext;

                VirtualFree(pBlock, 0, MEM_RELEASE);
            }

            break;
        }

        pPrev = pBlock;
        pBlock = pBlock->pNext;
    }
}

//-------------------------------------------------------------------------
BOOL IsExecutableAddress(LPVOID pAddress)
{
    MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION mi;
    return VirtualQuery(pAddress, &mi, sizeof(mi)) && mi.State == MEM_COMMIT &&
           (mi.Protect & PAGE_EXECUTE_FLAGS);
}
```
